officialNames.scope: Six independently matched global homepage creature names only.

entries.zh: 这是关于勇气的故事，他很脆弱却也不曾退缩；这是关于梦想的故事，梦很简单却也执着。这就是我，迪莫。
entries.en: It's a story of courage, and he's fragile but never retreated; it's a story of dreams that are simple and stubborn. That's me, Dimo.

entries.zh: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，并回复2能量。
entries.en: After dealing super-effective damage, gain +20% attack, defence and speed, and restore 2 energy.

entries.zh: 身体中蕴含着光之魔法的力量。有着光一般的勇气，无论什么情况下都会守护同伴。 “这一次，带着光明回来”。
entries.en: There's the power of the magic of light in your body. There's the courage of light to protect your companions under any circumstances. “This time, come back with light”.

entries.zh: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，回复2能量，首个技能替换为光系愿力冲击。
entries.en: After dealing super-effective damage, gain +20% attack, defence and speed, restore 2 energy, and replace the first skill with Light-type Wishpower Impact.

entries.zh: 身体中蕴含着草之魔法的力量。有着草一般的坚韧，无论什么情况下都会守护同伴。 “这一次，带着梦想回来”。
entries.en: The body has the power of the magic of grass. It has the strength to defend its companions under any circumstances. "This time, come back with dreams."

entries.zh: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，回复2能量，首个技能替换为草系愿力冲击。
entries.en: After dealing super-effective damage, gain +20% attack, defence and speed, restore 2 energy, and replace the first skill with Flora-type Wishpower Impact.

entries.zh: 身体中蕴含着火之魔法的力量。有着火一样的热情，无论什么情况下都会守护同伴。 “这一次，带着荣耀回来”。
entries.en: There's the power of fire in your body. There's fire-like passion to protect your companions under any circumstances. "This time, come back with honor."

entries.zh: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，回复2能量，首个技能替换为火系愿力冲击。
entries.en: After dealing super-effective damage, gain +20% attack, defence and speed, restore 2 energy, and replace the first skill with Fire-type Wishpower Impact.

entries.zh: 身体中蕴含着水之魔法的力量。有着水一样的澎湃，无论什么情况下都会守护同伴。 “这一次，带着智慧回来”。
entries.en: The body has the power of the magic of water. It's like water, and in every case it protects its companions. "This time, come back with wisdom."

entries.zh: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，回复2能量，首个技能替换为水系愿力冲击。
entries.en: After dealing super-effective damage, gain +20% attack, defence and speed, restore 2 energy, and replace the first skill with Water-type Wishpower Impact.

entries.zh: 喜欢阳光，喜欢新鲜的空气，会摇晃尾巴，受到惊吓会快速逃跑。虽然很胆小，但有时候也很调皮。
entries.en: Likes the sun, likes fresh air, shakes its tail, gets scared and runs fast. It's timid, but sometimes naughty.

entries.zh: 喵喵的果实 来源：完成风眠省魔法手册第一章必修课程获得
entries.en: Meevy fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Fengmian Province Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 使用草系技能后，回复10%生命。
entries.en: After using a Flora-type skill, restore 10% HP.

entries.zh: 爱在泉水边嬉戏，是喵喵的进化型，芭蕉叶状的尾巴变成了两条。胆量变大了，会经常吐舌头挑衅对手。
entries.en: Love plays by the springs, it's an evolutionary form of gills, and the tails of the baboons are turned into two. The guts get bigger, and the tongues of the opponents are often provoking them.

entries.zh: 普遍性情温和，体型巨大，据说深吸一口气能呼出将洛克都吹走的狂风，但通常情况下举止动作十分轻柔。“长了三条锋利的尾巴，经常会用身体冲撞碾压对手”。
entries.en: Universal tenderness and great size are said to sound a deep breath of the wind that will blow Locke away, but it is usually very gentle. “Three sharp tails are grown, often crushing their opponents with their bodies”.

entries.zh: “每天尽情地吃可可果，和喜欢的小洛克一起冒险，是很开心的生活。”
entries.en: "Eat cocoa every day and take a risk with little Locke, who likes it, is a happy life."

entries.zh: 使用草系技能后，回复15%生命。
entries.en: After using a Flora-type skill, restore 15% HP.

entries.zh: 叶脉——可有一个开端？ 枝桠——是否不断新生？ 一切关于生命的力量不断疯长，草的精灵以另一种身份与洛克重逢。
entries.en: Are the veins — can there be a beginning? . ..the branches ..are reborn, and all the power of life continues to grow and the elves of grass meet Locke in another capacity.

entries.zh: 每回复1能量，物攻和魔攻永久+20%，攻击后重置。
entries.en: For every 1 energy restored, permanently gain +20% physical and magical attack. Reset after attacking.

entries.zh: 像一团迸发的小火花，坦诚炙热，生性勇敢无畏。能熟练运用火元素，偶尔有点冒失，是值得信赖的伙伴。
entries.en: It's like a little spark, open and brave. Skilled with the elements of fire, sometimes a bit risky, it's a trusted partner.

entries.zh: 火花的果实 来源：完成风眠省魔法手册第一章必修课程获得
entries.en: Sparka fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Fengmian Province Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 使用火系技能后，获得双攻+20%。
entries.en: After using a Fire-type skill, gain +20% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 长出了一对大翅膀，但似乎并不是用来飞行的。能用双手释放出更加强力的火焰，但不太熟练。
entries.en: A big pair of wings is grown, but it doesn't seem to fly. You can release a more powerful flame with your hands, but not very skilled.

entries.zh: 强大的火焰之灵，只是靠近它就能够感受到温度的急剧变化。如果没有脖子上的项圈，它的火焰可能会暴走。“在磨练中成长，在烈火中重生，用意志在战斗，用生命在燃烧，永远的火神”。
entries.en: A powerful spirit of fire, which is close to it, can sense a dramatic change in temperature. Without the collars around its neck, its flame could burst. “Growing up in grinding, reborn in the flames, fighting with will, burning with life, God of Fire forever”.

entries.zh: “在磨练中成长，在烈火中重生，用意志在战斗，用生命在燃烧，永远的火神。”
entries.en: “To grow in grind, to be reborn in a fire, to fight with will, to burn with life, the God of Fire forever.”

entries.zh: 使用火系技能后，获得双攻永久+30%。
entries.en: After using a Fire-type skill, permanently gain +30% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 漂浮在水面上的精灵，没事吐个泡泡，头顶有一个红色的蝴蝶结。不在水中的时候，身体上也覆盖了一层液体薄膜。
entries.en: Smurfs floating on the surface, spitting out a bubble with a red bow over their heads. When they're not in the water, they also cover a liquid film.

entries.zh: 水蓝蓝的果实 来源：完成风眠省魔法手册第一章必修课程获得
entries.en: Cerulla fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Fengmian Province Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 使用水系技能后，全技能能耗-1。
entries.en: After using a Water-type skill, reduce all skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 在水中自如地游动，头上的触角可以感受水中的变化，总是带着一颗球一样的东西。身旁环绕着特殊的水元素，水元素凝结体中蕴含魔法能量的波动。
entries.en: The water moves like the surface, and the tentacles of the head can feel changes in the water, always carrying a ball of things. There's a special water element around which the water condensed with magical energy fluctuations.

entries.zh: 将刚刚孕育的胚胎顶在头上，胚胎由特殊水元素包裹着。能将身边的水元素汇集在一起喷射出去，产生强大的冲击力。“无论是云中落下的一滴水，还是湖面中微风吹起的一道涟漪，都有她的身影”。
entries.en: Putting a newly conceived embryo on its head, the embryo is wrapped in special water elements. It can spray the water around it and create a powerful shock. “There's a trace of her, whether a drop of water falls from the clouds or a tumble from a breeze in the lake.”

entries.zh: “无论是云中落下的一滴水，还是湖面中微风吹起的一道涟漪，都有她的身影。”
entries.en: "She is present in a drop of water from the clouds, or in a tremor from a breeze in the lake."

entries.zh: 使用水系技能后，全技能能耗-2。
entries.en: After using a Water-type skill, reduce all skill energy costs by 2.

entries.zh: 拥有蓬松的被毛，非常柔软。似乎很讨厌肢体接触，抗拒被抚摸。非常聪慧的物种，对环境中与众不同的东西十分敏感，尤其对于闪光的物体和新奇的事物格外感兴趣。
entries.en: It's very soft, with a fluffy hair. It seems to hate physical contact and resistance to touching. Very intelligent species are sensitive to things that are different in the environment, especially those that are glittered and new.

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉的果实 来源：完成鸭吉吉的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Duckiji fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Duckiji.

entries.zh: 携带的能耗为1的技能，威力+50%。
entries.en: Carried skills with an energy cost of 1 gain +50% power.

entries.zh: 非常急躁的鸭吉吉，虽然拿着表，但是来不及看时间，似乎一直在赶路，走路速度极快，所到之处有“啪嗒啪嗒”的响声。
entries.en: The very impatience duck Jiji, despite the watch, seems to have been on his way in time and walking so fast that there is a sound of “cracking” wherever he goes.

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉的果实 来源：测试纪念
entries.en: Duckiji fruit. Source: Test commemorative reward.

entries.zh: 因为等待太久，焦急的心情让它的脸涨得通红，光滑的毛发也因为缺水而翘起，会专注地一直看着沙漏计时，内心的渴望支撑着它，相信前方总会有好事发生。
entries.en: Because of the long wait, the anxiousness has made its face red and its smooth hair rises because of a lack of water. It has focused on the hour of the sandglass count, which is sustained by the desire to believe that good things will always happen in front.

entries.zh: “嘎！嘎！”火烧鸭屁股了，快让一让。燃了鸭总是处于紧张炸毛的状态，立毛反射会增大它自身的轮廓，看起来体型更大，因此，在鸭吉吉种族里，燃了鸭是不好惹的代名词。
entries.en: "Gah!" The fire burns the duck's ass. It's always in a state of tension and furry hair, and scuffle reflection increases its own contour, looks bigger, so it's not easy to make fun of ducks in ducks.

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉的果实 来源：预约活动获取
entries.en: Duckiji fruit. Source: Pre-registration event reward.

entries.zh: 它的眼皮开始打架，脑袋一点一点前倾——虽然随时能睡，但是也随时能醒。当你以为它睡着了，它能猛地抖翅，把自己从瞌睡里吓醒，大喊“嘎嘎——！”
entries.en: His eyelids start fighting and his head leans a little bit forward -- sleepy, but wakes up. When you think it's asleep, it shakes its wings so hard, wakes itself from the slumber and shouts, "Gaga!"

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉国王（蓬松的样子）
啪嗒啪嗒，鸭吉吉国王来了。那边的，别看怀表了，让时间听国王的；这边的毛太蓬松了，站紧实一点，别挡着国王的道了。嗯？还有你，既然来了我们鸭吉吉王国，记得要给过路费鸭！
entries.en: The king of ducks has come. Don't look at the watch, let the time listen to the king. The hair is too loose, stand tight and stay out of the king's way.

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉国王的种族资质大幅增加，能耗为1的技能威力+50%。
entries.en: King Duckiji's base attributes increase significantly. Skills with an energy cost of 1 gain +50% power.

entries.zh: 鸭吉吉国王（紧实的样子）
平时看似懒懒的，感到危险时，柔软的身体会迅速缩回壳里。柔韧的尾巴看起来像海草，偶尔会被饥饿的水生精灵咬一口。
entries.en: When you look lazy and feel dangerous, the soft body quickly shrinks back into your shell. A soft tail looks like seaweed, and sometimes a hungry aquatic elf bites it.

entries.zh: 板板壳的果实 来源：完成水泡壳的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Plank Shell fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Bubble Shell.
Carried Defence skills cost 2 less energy.

entries.zh: 很少再缩进壳里，即使遇到危险也会勇敢面对。甲壳内一部分是空气，一部分是水，通过喷嘴来调节重量从而在水中下潜和上浮。
entries.en: Very rarely indents into the shell, even if it is dangerous to face. Part of the crust is air and part water, which adjusts the weight through nozzles so as to dive and float under the water.

entries.zh: 进化之后体重增长到原来的数倍，前肢的力量也变得十分发达。前面有坚硬的尖角，背后有甲壳和水炮的泵口，是像堡垒一样可靠的存在。
entries.en: After evolution, the body weight has grown several times over, and the power of the front limbs has become very strong. There are hard horns ahead, and pump points with shells and water cannons behind them, which are as reliable as forts.

entries.zh: 白色的毛十分蓬松，脚掌柔软，移动时悄无声息，因此很擅长藏身草原与坡地。它性格安静，同类之间常用轻轻顶犄角的方式交流。
entries.en: The white hair is very loose, its feet soft and it moves silently, so it's good at hiding from the meadows and the slopes. It has a quiet character, and it communicates with the same people in a light manner.

entries.zh: 锥尾羊的果实 来源：完成花影羚羊的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Cone-Tailed Sheep fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Flower-Shade Antelope.

entries.zh: 自己使用恶系技能后，敌方失去2能量。
entries.en: After you use a Havoc-type skill, the opponent loses 2 energy.

entries.zh: 白天会懒洋洋地趴在草原上休息，主要在早晨和黄昏行动，一般会脱离种群独自生活。跳跃力惊人，在山坡上如履平地，从100米的高度一跃而下也没事。
entries.en: In the daytime, they lie idle and rest on the grasslands, mostly in the morning and at dusk, and usually live alone from the population. Jumping is amazing, flying down the hill like a flat ground, jumping down 100 metres from an altitude.

entries.zh: 进化后，分叉的角更为锋利，中间盛开一朵蓝色花朵，花瓣能体现它们的身体状态，疲劳时，花瓣会略微下垂。花朵在夜晚能发出怪异的微光，能够迷惑对手。
entries.en: After evolution, the fork is sharper, with a blue flower blooming in the middle, the petals reflect their physical state, and when we're tired, the petals fall slightly down. Flowers can create strange light at night and confuse rivals.

entries.zh: 春天诞生的小鸟精灵，圆滚滚的身子常沾着露水和草籽，没有太多御寒的绒毛，气温低时可能会钻进小洛克的种植园里取暖。
entries.en: The spring-born bird spirits, whose rounded bodies are often covered with dew water and grass seeds, have not much velvet to keep them cold and may enter Little Rock's plantations to warm up when temperatures are low.

entries.zh: 雪绒鸟的蛋 来源：精灵首领·霜翼领主掉落
entries.en: Snowdown Bird egg. Source: Drop from the creature boss Frostwing Lord.

entries.zh: 若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
entries.en: If you attack before the opponent, this use of the skill gains +50% power.

entries.zh: 夏天诞生的小鸟精灵，热而潮湿的夏季风让它们更快学会飞行，飞羽更长更坚韧。正午热空气升腾的时候从高处跳下，瞬间就学会了滑翔。
entries.en: Little bird elves born in summer, warm and wet summer winds make them learn to fly faster, flying feathers longer and more tenacity. When the hot air rises at noon, they learn to glide at once.

entries.zh: 秋天诞生的小鸟精灵，喜欢高糖分的可可果，吃饱后身体散发出类似焦糖的气味。糖分带来的高能量让它拥有更好的体力，即使和一窝蜂赛跑一整天也不会累。
entries.en: The little bird-smurfs who are born in the autumn, like high-sweet cocoa fruit, eat up and smell like caramel in their bodies. The high energy from sugar gives them better physical strength, even if they run with a nest of bees all day long.

entries.zh: 冬天诞生的小鸟精灵，常把身体缩成球状减少散热。喜欢用幼嫩的喙啄刚落地的新雪，既是食用也是玩耍。
entries.en: Little bird elves born in winter tend to shrink their bodies into spherical forms to reduce evaporation. They like fresh snow that's just falling off the ground with young twigs, both to eat and to play.

entries.zh: 体型又小又圆，眼睛周围生长着一层柔软绒毛。羽绒非常厚，为了抵御寒冷的冬夜，常与同伴挤在一起栖息。
entries.en: Small and round, with a soft fur growing around your eyes. The feathers are thick and often squeezing with your companions to withstand cold winter nights.

entries.zh: 演化出适合春季的伪装色羽毛，换羽期掉下的灰白羽常被孩子捡去做小玩具。它自己则借着风，在田野里蹦跶，能借风力在草甸上滑浪。
entries.en: The grey feathers fall during the exchange period are often picked up by children as little toys, and they do so by the wind, by jumping in the fields and by the wind.

entries.zh: 它看起来像一枚会飘的热气球，似乎吸一口气就可以轻松飘起来，不用费力扇动翅膀就可以乘着风飘出去很远。
entries.en: It looks like a floating balloon, and it seems that one breath can float easily, so that the wind can fly far away without having to flap its wings.

entries.zh: 这段时期它们的食量明显上升，精力异常旺盛，因为摄入了足够的营养而长出有光泽的硬羽，常与同伴展开追逐游戏，以此锻炼长途飞行所需的耐力。
entries.en: During this period, their diets increased markedly and their energy was exceptionally high, as they grew with light plumes because of the ingestion of adequate nutrition, often playing chase games with their peers as a way to exercise the durability required for long-distance flights.

entries.zh: 眼神锐利，有着绅士般冷静而又端庄的非凡气质，让它在贵族当中颇有人气。胸腹绒羽形成稳定的隔热层，能在强风中维持体温，拥有较强的耐力。
entries.en: The sharpness of the eye, with a calm and decent character, makes it more human among the nobles. The chest velvet feathers form stable insulations that maintain warmness in strong winds and have greater patience.

entries.zh: 它在春天迁徙而来时，出现的时间常与播种期接近，因此被视作开耕的信号。它的喉羽呈嫩黄，鸣声清脆婉转。播种后，它会在田埂与水渠边玩耍，用歌声和行动提醒：春天正在到来。
entries.en: When it migrates in spring, it often emerges close to the seeding period and is therefore seen as a sign of tilling. Its throat feathers are yellow and its sound is clear and soft. After planting, it plays along the fields with the water canals, singing and acting: spring is coming.

entries.zh: 羽毛出现火红渐变，吸热更快、升空更容易。在夏雷与烈日交替的午后，它常沿固定路线巡查领地。翅缘与体表容易积累静电与热感，让它在驱离入侵者时更具压迫感
entries.en: Feathers are turning red and it's easier to absorb heat. In the midday of the turn-up between Charret and the sun, it visits territory along fixed routes. The wings and surfaces tend to accumulate static power and heat, making it more oppressive when driving off the invaders.

entries.zh: 羽片边缘被秋风磨出细锯齿，既利于稳定滑翔，也像一片会飞的枫叶。进入大迁徙时，它会担任领航者，它的尾羽扫过枯枝时能留下整齐的断痕，当洛克看到一排排整齐的枯枝剪影，就知道它们刚飞过。
entries.en: The edges of the plume are sharpened by the autumn wind, which is good for stability and glide, as well as a flying maple leaf. When it enters the great migration, it acts as a pilot, and its tails leave a neat scar when they sweep through the dead branch, and when Locke sees a row of neat cutlets, he knows that they just flew.

entries.zh: 传说霜翼领主会在冬季的末尾巡视领地，当它最后一次掠过雪线，天空便不再下雪——所有雪花都被它收进了冰蓝色的羽翼。只需一次振翅，零下五十度的寒潮便顺着羽脉倾泻，瞬间把战场变成镜面。
entries.en: Legend says the Frostwing Lord patrols its territory at the end of winter. After its last flight over the snow line, snow no longer falls: it has gathered every snowflake into its icy blue wings. With a single wingbeat, cold air at minus fifty degrees pours along its feathers, instantly turning the battlefield into a mirror.

entries.zh: 若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+75%。
entries.en: If you attack before the opponent, this use of the skill gains +75% power.

entries.zh: 可能在任何潮湿的阴冷角落出现，看到蓝色荧光不要贸然接近。吸食其他生物的情绪作为养分，吃饱后会发出轻轻的叹气声。
entries.en: It's possible to appear in any wet, cold corner and see blue fluorescent light that doesn't come close. Eat the emotions of other organisms as nutrients and then sigh lightly.

entries.zh: 小灵菇的果实 来源：完成幻影灵菇的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Spirit Mushroom fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Phantom Mushroom.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，偷取敌方场上所有精灵1能量。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, steal 1 energy from every opposing creature on the field.

entries.zh: 头顶的触角比隐藏在伞盖下的面目更能够表达出心情，悄无声息地飘来飘去，通常出现在后半夜。在森林深处大量聚集，散发着淡淡荧光，会吸收周围植物和小型动物的情绪。
entries.en: The tentacles of the head are more expressive than the faces hidden under the umbrella, floating silently, often in the middle of the night. In the forest, there is a large concentration of light fluorescent light that absorbs the emotions of surrounding plants and small animals.

entries.zh: 仅仅看到它触角上闪烁的荧光就会头痛难耐，对其研究很难有进展。没有生命迹象但是可以自如活动，无法判定是植物还是动物，唯独颈间圆环中似乎蕴含强大生命力。
entries.en: It is difficult to make progress in its research by simply seeing the fluorescent glow on its tentacles. There are no signs of life, but it is not possible to determine whether it is a plant or an animal, except that there seems to be a powerful life in the circle between the necks.

entries.zh: 常在半山腰处被发现，独立生活，会收集细小的石头筑巢。背上的石头是体内生长出来的一种分泌物，喜欢钻到石头堆里蹭背，可以把背上的石头打磨得更锋利。
entries.en: Often found at the waist of a half mountain, living independently, collects small stones to nest. The stone on the back is a secretion that grows in the body and likes to crawl through a pile of rocks that can be sharpened even more sharply.

entries.zh: 石肤蜥的果实 来源：完成石冠王蜥的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Stone-Skinned Lizard fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Stone-Crowned King Lizard.

entries.zh: 每受到1次攻击伤害，对攻击自己的精灵造成50威力物理伤害。
entries.en: For every 1 damaging attack you take, deal 50-power physical damage to the attacker.

entries.zh: 石肤蜥（球球尾巴的样子）
背上的石头似乎会与身上的棘刺融为一体，成为自己的武器。石头会周期性脱落，脱落下来的石头苍白易碎，捏一下就会粉碎成细砂状。
entries.en: The stones on the back seem to be integrated with the thorns of their bodies and become their own weapons. The stones will fall periodically, the falling stones will be pale and fragile, and they will be crushed into thin sand.

entries.zh: 石刺蜥（球球尾巴的样子）
普遍性情暴躁，攻击性强，会发射岩石来划清自己的地盘。它背上石头与身体融合的原理至今仍是研究协会重要的研究课题。
entries.en: Universal rage, aggressiveness, and the firing of rocks to define their own territory. The principle of integration of stones and bodies on their backs is still an important subject for research associations today.

entries.zh: 石冠王蜥（球球尾巴的样子）
如果感觉岩石的缝隙中有目光注视着你，那很可能就是布是石。身体非常坚硬，喜欢成群结队地从斜坡上滚下来，也许只有它们能感受这种快乐吧。
entries.en: If you feel that there's a look at you in the crack of the rock, it's probably a stone. The body is very hard, and it likes to roll down the slopes in groups, so maybe only they can feel this joy.

entries.zh: 布是石的果实 来源：完成布克棱岩的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Bushishi fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Book Prismrock.

entries.zh: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每放1次地系技能，回复3能量。
entries.en: Start with 0 energy. Before entering, restore 3 energy for every 1 Earth-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 脑袋部分的坚硬度接近基岩，普通的岩石对它来说就像泥土一样柔软。它的头好像完全感觉不到疼，受到击打很久之后才能明白刚才发生了什么。
entries.en: The hardness of the head is close to the bedrock, and ordinary rocks are as soft for it as dirt. Its head does not seem to feel pain at all. It takes a long time to understand what just happened.

entries.zh: 颇具威慑力的精灵，身形巨大，不经常远离驻地。看上去很重，但其实身体的主要重量都集中在头和手上的岩石部分。
entries.en: Smurfs with a lot of deterrence, big shapes and not very often far from the site. They look heavy, but the body's weight is concentrated on the head and the rock part of the hand.

entries.zh: 迷嶂布莱克的体型与山脉规模呈正相关，其骨骼密度可达普通岩石矿物的3倍以上，且骨骼内部存在类似蜂窝结构的减重设计——这种结构能在保持高承重能力的同时，减轻自身体重，迷嶂布莱克能承受的重量约为自身体重的100-150倍。
entries.en: Mistpeak Blake grows in proportion to the mountain range it inhabits. Its bones can be more than 3 times as dense as ordinary rock minerals. Honeycomb-like structures inside reduce weight while maintaining a high load-bearing capacity. It can support roughly 100–150 times its own weight.

entries.zh: 突破能量上限并立即回复10能量，入场前己方精灵每使用1次地系技能，回复3能量。
entries.en: Exceed the energy cap and immediately restore 10 energy. Before entering, restore 3 energy for every 1 Earth-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 身体里似乎装满了坏心思，很轻松就能从试图抓住它的洛克手中挣脱。会三五成群地从洛克手上抢走东西，把东西丢下之后嘻嘻哈哈地飞走。如果惹怒它们的话，会气呼呼地撞向洛克。
entries.en: The body seems to be filled with bad thoughts and can easily escape from Locke, trying to grab it. Thirty-five groups of people take things away from Locke's hands, drop them and fly away. If they get angry, they crash into Locke.

entries.zh: 恶魔叮的果实 来源：完成叮叮恶魔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Demon Ding fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dingding Demon.

entries.zh: 一直在思考如何恶作剧，还会每天进行吓人的练习。总是歪嘴笑着，一副玩世不恭的样子，其实非常害怕失去别人的注意力。非常重视诺言，会坚定地完成自己的约定。
entries.en: I've been thinking about pranks, and I practiced scary things every day. Always grinning and cynicism, I'm afraid to lose the attention of others.

entries.zh: 统领所有恶魔叮和叮叮恶魔，幼年时害怕失去注意力的特质进化成了强烈的支配欲，它的领地内不允许有比它更显眼的存在。继承了族群重视诺言的传统，一旦认定效忠对象就绝不背叛，但它的忠诚只给被它认可的主人。
entries.en: To all the devils and the devils, the traits of fear of losing attention at an early age have evolved into a strong desire to dominate, and its territory does not allow for more visible presence than it does. The tradition of community attachment to promises has been inherited, and there is no betrayal of allegiance once identified, but its loyalty is given only to those whom it recognizes.

entries.zh: 入场时获得50% 吸血 ，每过量回复5%生命转化为10%物攻。
entries.en: Gain 50% lifesteal on entry. Every 5% HP of excess healing converts into 10% physical attack.

entries.zh: 喜欢藏在地下，靠形似耳朵的触角感知周围环境。几乎观察不到它们进食行为，吃很少的东西就能存活很久。
entries.en: Like to hide under the ground and feel the surroundings with tentacles like ears. They can barely see their feeding behavior, and they can survive for a very long time.

entries.zh: 毛毛的果实 来源：完成化蝶的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Maomao fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Butterfly.

entries.zh: 受到致命伤害时，获得1层 萌化 ，并免疫此次伤害。（最多触发2次）
entries.en: When taking lethal damage, gain 1 stack of Cutification and negate that damage. Triggers at most 2 times.

entries.zh: 外壳硬化，缩腹在各种物体的表面爬行。背面艳丽的斑点看似有毒，实际上是鳞翅根。
entries.en: The outer shell is hardened, and the abdominal crawls on the surface of all kinds of objects. The glamour spots on the back look toxic and actually staircase roots.

entries.zh: 极其聪慧的种族，大脑占去整个身体的三分之二。翅膀有力，充满魔力的鳞粉形成了翅膀上的花纹，用以迷惑其他精灵。
entries.en: The most intelligent race, the brain, accounts for two-thirds of the body. The wings are strong and the magic powders form the colours on their wings to confuse other elves.

entries.zh: 极其聪慧的种族，大脑占去整个身体的三分之二。翅膀有力，充满魔力的鳞粉形成了翅膀上的花纹，看起来似乎是幽冥眼的样子。
entries.en: The most intelligent race, the brain, accounts for two-thirds of the body. The wings are strong and the magic powders form the twilights on their wings, which seem to look like dark eyes.

entries.zh: 极其聪慧的种族，大脑占去整个身体的三分之二。翅膀有力，充满魔力的鳞粉形成了翅膀上的花纹，看起来似乎是喵喵的样子。
entries.en: The most intelligent race, the brain, accounts for two thirds of the body. The wings are strong, and the magic powders form the colours on their wings, and they look like twigs.

entries.zh: 极其聪慧的种族，大脑占去整个身体的三分之二。翅膀有力，充满魔力的鳞粉形成了翅膀上的花纹，看起来似乎是奇丽花的样子。
entries.en: The most intelligent race, the brain accounts for two-thirds of the body. The wings are strong and the magic powders form the colours on them, which look like miraculous flowers.

entries.zh: 左手和右手似乎有各自的想法，在黑暗中看起来就像三只精灵。虽然伪装拙劣到谁都能看穿的程度，但依旧喜欢伪装成普通树木的样子，跟在洛克身后，但是对洛克并没有恶意。
entries.en: The left hand and the right hand seem to have their own ideas, and they look like three elves in the dark. Although the disguise is so bad that anyone can see through it, it still prefers to pretend to be ordinary trees, behind Locke, but there is no malice towards Locke.

entries.zh: 幽影树的果实 来源：完成幽影树的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Shadow Tree fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Shadow Tree.

entries.zh: 入场时偷取敌方场上所有精灵2能量。
entries.en: On entry, steal 2 energy from every opposing creature on the field.

entries.zh: 拥有族群特有的魔法诱导型次生生长手臂，左臂与右臂化作两根巨大的带刺藤蔓，可以自主做出抓取、摆动等动作。远远看去，像三棵高低不同的枯树一起挪动。
entries.en: With a group-specific magic-guided secondary-growth arm, the left and right arms are two giant vines that can take, swing, and so on. From now on, they move like three tall, different trees.

entries.zh: 入场时偷取敌方场上所有精灵3能量。
entries.en: On entry, steal 3 energy from every opposing creature on the field.

entries.zh: 总是在啃着什么，包括自己的手和尾巴。扒开小鼠獭的嘴巴仔细观察也找不到牙，牙床嫩嫩的，还没有牙的痕迹。
entries.en: Always chewing on something, including its own hands and tails. You can't find teeth when you open the otter's mouth, and you can't see them.

entries.zh: 小鼠獭的果实 来源：完成卷胡巨獭的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Mouse Otter fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Curly-Whiskered Giant Otter.

entries.zh: 总技能能耗小于4时，自己获得双防+80%。
entries.en: If the total energy cost of your skills is less than 4, gain +80% to both defence stats.

entries.zh: 牙齿锋利，非常喜欢啃一些坚硬的木头。手掌心非常坚硬粗糙，常看到它们用手在脸上搓来搓去，并不是在洗脸，而是在用掌心磨牙齿。
entries.en: The teeth are sharp, they like to eat hard wood. The palms are very strong and rough, and they're rubbed in the face, not wash their faces, but grind their teeth with their hands.

entries.zh: 对外表有很高的追求，除了磨牙的习惯之外，体内分泌的油脂会被用来保养胡须。蓬松的胡须和锋利的牙齿代表其在族群中的地位，部分獭会去寻找枯草装作假胡子戴着。普遍不喜欢和洛克亲近。
entries.en: There is a high level of desire on the external surface, where, in addition to the habit of grinding teeth, internally secretive fats are used to maintain beards. Fluffy moustaches and sharp teeth represent their place in the community, with some otters looking for moustaches to wear. Locke is generally not liked.

entries.zh: 喜欢攀附于潮湿的岩层，以土壤中的矿粒为食，常被用作衡量矿产资源丰富度的标志。身上的晶体可以将细小的光线通过折射放大数倍，四只矿晶虫便能照亮一整个矿洞，是备受矿工喜爱的精灵。
entries.en: The crystals are used to measure the abundance of mineral resources. They can magnify small light by refraction, so that four ores can brighten an entire minehole and be popular with miners.

entries.zh: 矿晶虫的果实 来源：完成晶石蜗的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Mineral Crystal Bug fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Crystal Snail.

entries.zh: 受到自己携带技能系别的攻击伤害-40%。
entries.en: Take 40% less attack damage from types matching your carried skills.

entries.zh: 晶石蜗（西瓜碧玺的样子）
在资源丰富的矿洞中能遇见的罕见蜗类，周身的矿石与斑纹会因摄入矿物类型的不同，而呈现出不同的色彩。进食时，它会直接吞下成块矿石，并通过特殊的消化结构，将其转化并沉积为自身躯体的一部分。
entries.en: The rare snail that can be encountered in resource-rich caves, the ore and the stripes are different colours because of the type of minerals they take. When you eat, it swallows directly into a piece of ore, which is transformed and deposited into part of your body through a special digestive structure.

entries.zh: 晶石蜗（莲花刚玉的样子）
罕见的矿石精灵之一，外壳酷似莲花刚玉。常出没于矿层复杂的交界区域，其绚烂如花的晶体，常让初来乍到的矿工误以为矿脉开花了，而对熟练的矿工来说，这代表此处可能有多种不同矿脉，值得进一步勘察。
entries.en: One of the rare ore elves, the outer crust is like a lot of roses. Often out of a complex frontier area of the mineral layer, it has rotted like flower crystals that often allow fresh miners to misunderstand their pulses, which for skilled miners may represent a variety of different veins that deserve further exploration.

entries.zh: 晶石蜗（星彩榴石的样子）
罕见的矿石精灵之一，外壳酷似星彩榴石。有研究员专门研究它的晶体中生物发光现象与星光魔法的关联，其星芒纹在矿灯光束下清晰可辨，常被老矿工们当作夜班巡逻搭档。
entries.en: One of the rare ore elves, the outer crust is like a star-colored grenade. There are researchers specializing in the association between biological light phenomena and starlight magic in its crystals, whose glitters are clearly visible under the beams of mineral lights, often used as night shifts by old miners.

entries.zh: 晶石蜗（火山琉璃的样子）
罕见的矿石精灵之一，外壳酷似火山琉璃。因它们的晶体硬度较高，常被洛克称为活砂纸，它们蹭过的岩壁表面会从粗糙变得平滑，在矿区，它们会帮忙协助打磨洛克的挖掘装备。
entries.en: One of the rare ore elves, the outer crust is like a volcano. As their crystals are more hard, they are often called live sandpaper by Locke, and the surfaces of the walls they rub down are smooth from rough to smooth, and in the mines they help grind Locke's excavation equipment.

entries.zh: 罕见的矿石精灵之一，外壳酷似蓝锥矿。晶石蜗爬行时留下的矿质黏液，干燥后会形成纤细的蓝锥矿晶丝，在暗处持续发出微弱磷光，形成短暂的痕迹，可用于导航，但路径会随空气氧化逐渐失去光泽。
entries.en: One of the rare ore elves, the outer shell is like a blue cone. The mineral slime left by the crystal snails as they climb, drying it into a thin blue cone crystal line that continues to produce faint phosphorus light in the dark and can be used for navigation, but the path gradually loses light with air oxidation.

entries.zh: 晶石蜗（烧蓝黄金的样子）
罕见的矿石精灵之一，外壳酷似烧蓝黄金。硫磺味重、容易腐蚀工具的矿段里，烧蓝黄金蜗是少数愿意常驻的精灵，采矿队也会把废弃的金属零件丢给它们，它们会帮忙咬掉表层锈斑。
entries.en: One of the rare ore elves, the outer shell is like burning blue gold. In a sulfur-flavored and corrosive mine, the burning of blue gold snail is a small group of elves willing to live in the country. The mining team also throws waste metal parts at them, and they help to bite off surface rust.

entries.zh: 钻石蜗（西瓜碧玺的样子）
极其稀少且强大的精灵，见到它时，洛克的第一反应不是抓起来，而是先停手——它的壳太硬，硬到任何挖掘工具碰到它都会立刻坏掉。凡是矿区附近有钻石蜗出现，都需要先报告给魔法学院的研究员。
entries.en: Very rare and powerful elves, when they see it, Locke's first reaction is not to catch them, but to stop — it's too hard-shelled to get any digging tools to touch it. Any diamond snail near the mine needs to be reported to a fellow at the Academy of Magic first.

entries.zh: 抵抗自己携带技能系别的攻击伤害。
entries.en: Resist attack damage from types matching your carried skills.

entries.zh: 钻石蜗（莲花刚玉的样子）
钻石蜗（星彩榴石的样子）
钻石蜗（火山琉璃的样子）
钻石蜗（烧蓝黄金的样子）
头顶着花苞爬着前进，总会朝着太阳光的方向。花苞里面似乎孕育着什么，要是长期照不到太阳，花苞就会萎缩。
entries.en: And they're crawling on their heads, always in the direction of the sun. They seem to have something in them. If they don't see the sun for a long time, they shrink.

entries.zh: 奇丽草的果实 来源：完成奇丽花的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Qili Grass fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Qili Flower.
At the end of the turn, restore 3 energy.

entries.zh: 头顶的花苞十分巨大，花苞成长速度已经超过身体，头部上方是视野盲区，由身体下面五个足状的突起维持平衡。
entries.en: The ceilings on the head are huge, they have grown faster than the body, and above the head is a blind area of vision, with a balance maintained by five foot bumps below the body.

entries.zh: 巨大的花朵盛开了，花瓣像是一顶遮阳帽，粗大的花蕊像触角一样，花朵很好闻，有类似柑橘的香甜气味，对小型精灵有强烈吸引力。
entries.en: The huge flower blooms, the petals are like a suncap, the thick gravy is like a tentacle, the flowers smell good, they smell like citrus sweets and have a strong appeal to small elves.

entries.zh: 头顶结出了橙红色的果实，散发出甜腻的香味，小鸟精灵可能会被吸引。但贸然接近是得不到好果子吃的，它分泌的糖胶不仅黏还有毒，无声拒绝着每一个不速之客。
entries.en: With orange and red fruit coming out of the head, little bird spirits may be attracted. But closeness is not good fruit to eat; its secretive gum is not only sticky but toxic, and silently rejects every uninvited customer.
At the end of the turn, restore 6 energy.

entries.zh: 有看到什么都会去舔一下试试看的习惯，经常忘记把舌头收回去。双眼对强光非常敏感，白天会老老实实躲在室内或者阴凉的地方。
entries.en: There's a habit of licking everything, often forgetting to take back your tongue. The eyes are very sensitive to strong light and they hide indoors or in the dark during the day.

entries.zh: 丢丢的果实 来源：完成卡瓦重的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Diudiu fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Kawazhong.

entries.zh: 自己力竭时，少损失1点魔力。
entries.en: Lose 1 less Magic when you become exhausted.

entries.zh: 火山地区的丢丢保留了什么都要舔一下的习惯，最喜欢舔岩壁上析出的矿物结晶。长期摄入火山矿物后，原本的体色逐渐被铁质色素染成暗红。
entries.en: The debris of volcanic areas keeps the habit of licking everything, and it's a favorite thing to do with the crystallization of minerals coming out of the rock walls. After long-term ingestion of volcanic minerals, the original color is gradually dyed by iron pigment.

entries.zh: 沙地生活的丢丢，它们更加谨慎，通过舌尖带回的信息判断风中同类留下的痕迹，嘴里偶尔会被带入细沙。
entries.en: Sand life was lost, they were more cautious and judged by the information brought back from their tongues the traces of the same kind left in the wind, which were occasionally taken into the sand.

entries.zh: 雪山生活的丢丢，它们会用舌尖短促地舔一下霜层或新雪，补充水分，动作很短很快，以免舌头被冻伤。体表的温度下降很快，需要不停地移动和进食来维持体温。
entries.en: Snow Mountain lives are lost and they lick the cream or fresh snow with short tongues, replenish water, and move quickly to avoid freezing of their tongue. The temperature on the surface is falling rapidly, and they need constant movement and feeding to keep the body warm.

entries.zh: 卡卡虫（草地附近的样子）
用四只吸盘在任何地形快速地移动，静止不动的时候很难分辨。尾巴牢牢抓着植物的茎，没事就会拿下来舔，它的唾液似乎会让果实越变越硬。
entries.en: It's hard to tell when you move fast in any terrain with four straws. You hold on to the plant's runner, you take it down and lick it. Its saliva seems to make the fruit harder.

entries.zh: 卡卡虫（火山附近的样子）
吸盘能牢牢贴住滚烫的岩面而毫无不适，唾液在长期接触高温矿物后发生了变化，变得粘稠且带有腐蚀性，舔过的岩面会留下明显的溶蚀痕迹，在昏暗的洞穴中格外显眼。
entries.en: The saliva changes after prolonged exposure to high-temperature minerals and becomes sticky and corrosive, leaving visible signs of soaking through the licked rock surfaces, which are visible in dim caves.

entries.zh: 卡卡虫（沙地附近的样子）
锁定气味后会贴着沙面短促冲刺，并在奔跑间不断吐舌更新，顺着风向与沙面追踪。尾巴卷着的枝条能敲击沙地，这种清脆节奏是它们发出的威吓。
entries.en: The smell is locked up with a short sand bump, and it's constantly refreshing during the run, following the wind towards the sand. The tail-rolled branches can knock on the sand, and this crisp rhythm is their shock.

entries.zh: 卡卡虫（雪山附近的样子）
脚上的吸盘可以有力地吸附在雪山岩壁上，雪面反光强，它们经常在日照较好的岩壁上短暂晒暖，提高体温后再迅速外出觅食。
entries.en: Sorrows on the feet can be strongly adsorbed to snowy mountain walls, with snowy surfaces reversible and often warm for a short period of time on better sun-shine rock walls, increasing body temperature before going out quickly to find food.

entries.zh: 卡瓦重（草地附近的样子）
手里拿的是生长着果实的枝条，既是武器也是乐器，需要时还能解解嘴馋。战斗像舞蹈一样，用细长灵活的舌头和尾巴表演，让人眼花缭乱。
entries.en: With branches with fruit in their hands, both weapons and instruments, they're able to solve the masquerade when needed. Fighting is like dancing, playing with a long, flexible tongue and tail, and it's confusing.

entries.zh: 卡瓦重（火山附近的样子）
皮肤下沉积的矿物层越来越厚，能短暂隔绝极端高温，唾液的腐蚀性强到能溶解部分数矿石，溅落的唾液会在地面嗞嗞冒烟。它们趴在温热的岩面上就能维持体温，比其他地区的同类懒散得多。
entries.en: The mineral layers that are deposited under the skin are thicker and can be isolated for a short period of time from extreme temperatures, saliva is so corrosive that it dissolves parts of the ore that salivated saliva smokes on the ground. They can keep warm on hot rock surfaces, much more lazy than their counterparts elsewhere.

entries.zh: 卡瓦重（沙地附近的样子）
能从被热沙扰乱的气味里读出想要的信息，它的追击更难被甩脱。手上的枝条能敲出更复杂的节拍，不同节奏代表不同追击策略，如果节奏突然变得更密、更短，那意味着它要开始收网了。
entries.en: It's harder to get rid of the message that you want from the smell of hot sand. The branch on your hand is more complicated, and different rhythms represent different pursuit strategies, which means it's starting to close if the rhythm suddenly gets thicker and shorter.

entries.zh: 卡瓦重（雪山附近的样子）
进化后，它们可以在最短时间内把体温抬升到正常水平，维持每天的必要活动。当天气转冷或日照不足时，它们会显著降低活动，进入近似蛰伏的节能状态，把热量留给下一次必要的出动。
entries.en: As a result of evolution, they can raise their body temperature to normal levels in the shortest time possible and maintain the necessary daily activity. When the weather turns cold or the sun is inadequate, they significantly reduce their activity, moving into a state of near-volatile energy conservation, leaving the heat for the next necessary move.

entries.zh: 时刻保持着警觉，任何危险都无法逃过它的眼睛。虽然身形小巧，但面对无论多么凶猛庞大的敌人都会勇敢地燃起斗志。
entries.en: Keeping constant vigilance, no danger can escape its eyes. Though small in shape, it is brave to rise up in the face of an enemy, however ferocious.

entries.zh: 护主犬的果实 来源：完成音速犬的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Loyal Hound fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sonic Hound.
On the first turn after entry, gain +100% physical attack.

entries.zh: 昂起斗志时，冠毛和尾巴会像熊熊燃烧的火焰一样摇曳。身上的围巾蕴含魔法能量，似乎有增强火元素的效果。
entries.en: When you're fighting, the hair and tail move like a flame of bears. The scarf contains magic energy that seems to enhance the elements of fire.

entries.zh: 它的冠毛与尾巴像火焰一样摇曳，这代表它体内的火元素的热流外显。它的斗志一旦被点燃，会化作更强的火势与更可靠的压制力。
entries.en: Its coronary hair and tail move like a flame, which represents the heat of the elements of fire in its body. Once it is lit up, it becomes more intense fire and more reliable suppression.

entries.zh: 入场时，获得物攻+100%，每次行动后-20%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +100% physical attack. Reduce this by 20% after each action.

entries.zh: 能靠有力的尾巴弹跳，如果摔倒了，要花一阵子才能重新靠尾巴站立，有研究猜测它们足部功能有所退化，尾部功能非常发达，部分取代了双脚的作用。
entries.en: It would take a while for them to get back on their tails if they fell, and there were studies to guess that their foot functions had deteriorated and the tail was very well developed, partly replacing both feet.

entries.zh: 绿耳松鼠的果实 来源：完成蹦床松鼠的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Green-Eared Squirrel fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Trampoline Squirrel.
For every 1 energy you have, gain +10% to both defence stats.

entries.zh: 骑着自己的尾巴，已经不需要靠双脚走路。偶尔把头埋进身体，看上去像一颗巨大的果实。
entries.en: You don't have to walk by your feet on your tail. Sometimes you bury your head in your body and look like a giant fruit.

entries.zh: 尾巴的力量非常强，巨大的尾部并不是蓬松的，内部有着强健的肌肉，实心并且富有弹性。可以用尾巴把自己弹射到三层楼那么高的地方。
entries.en: The tails are very powerful, the giant tails aren't loose, they have strong muscles inside, they're solid and resilient. They can be ejected up to three stories.

entries.zh: 体内的粘液有毒性，总是黏糊糊的，一旦沾上很难洗掉，粘液的沸点十分低，常处于沸腾状态。
entries.en: The slime in the body is toxic, it is always sticky, and once contaminated it is difficult to wash it off, the boiling point of the slime is very low and it is often boiling.

entries.zh: 嘟嘟煲的果实 来源：完成嘟嘟锅的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Dudu Casserole fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dudu Pot.

entries.zh: 在场时，双方回合结束时的 中毒效果 会额外触发1次。
entries.en: While on the field, Poison effects on both sides trigger 1 additional time at the end of the turn.

entries.zh: 一直在咕嘟咕嘟，分不清是因为沸腾导致，还是在喋喋不休。似乎有意四处散播谣言，说自己是炼金教室里大炼金锅的嫡系子嗣，研究人员在进行研究观测的时候每天要听五十遍它们讲的辉煌家史。
entries.en: It is always bubbling, though nobody can tell whether it is boiling or chattering. It seems intent on spreading the rumour that it descends directly from the great cauldron in the alchemy classroom. Researchers observing it must listen to its glorious family history fifty times a day.

entries.zh: 面具似乎可以摘下，进食的时候会避开所有生物。一层闪着荧光的神秘物质覆盖着身体，内部可能是液体。
entries.en: The mask seems to be able to take off, and when you eat it, you avoid all living things. One layer of mysterious matter that flashes with fluorescent light covers the body and may be internal liquids.

entries.zh: 小灵面的果实 来源：完成幽冥眼的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Spirit Mask fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Nether Eye.

entries.zh: 能量等于0的精灵，无法对自己造成伤害。
entries.en: Creatures with 0 energy cannot damage you.

entries.zh: 被两团冷火环绕着，从头到脚都充满了谜团。进食之后重量也毫不增加，被它面具下的嘴吞下的食物仿佛消失了一样。
entries.en: It's surrounded by two sets of cold fire, full of puzzles from head to foot. Eating doesn't add any weight, swallowing food from its masked mouth as if it were gone.

entries.zh: 常在空中徘徊，来去几乎无声，靠近它时会明显感觉变冷，像是体表的温度不断地被抽走。它们不进食也不说话，面具上闭着的眼睛图案似乎代表着什么。
entries.en: It's always in the air, it's almost silent, and it gets colder when it comes close to it, like the temperature of the body table is constantly being pulled away. They don't eat or talk, and closed eyes on the mask seem to represent something.

entries.zh: 传说幽冥眼一族在生命终结的时候能窥见生命与宇宙的奥秘。对灵魂与星辰抱有极其虔诚的信仰，面具上刻着的眼睛形状图腾似乎象征着种族的信仰。
entries.en: The legends say that a community of the Eye of the Underworld sees the mystery of life and the universe at the end of their lives. A belief in the soul and stars is extremely pious, and the image of the eye engraved on the mask seems to symbolize the faith of race.

entries.zh: 面具上刻着的闭眼图腾是它们族群的信仰符号，闭眼代表守戒与克制。传说它们能看见灵魂与秘密，却从不干涉现在发生的事情。
entries.en: The blind-eyed totems engraved on the mask are symbols of their community’s faith, which closes their eyes as a sign of respect and restraint. Legend tells them that they can see souls and secrets without interfering in what is happening now.

entries.zh: 不吃不喝，大部分时间都在睡觉的奇怪生物，常呆在旧衣服堆里。喜欢群居生活，如果太长时间没有感受到其他生物的活动痕迹，会变得非常怨恨和暴躁。
entries.en: Strange creatures who sleep for most of their time, often stay in the old clothes piles. They like living together, and if they don't feel any signs of other organisms for too long, they get very angry and angry.

entries.zh: 梦游的果实 来源：完成梦悠悠的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sleepwalker fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dream Drifter.

entries.zh: 敌方精灵 离场 后，更换入场的精灵失去3能量。
entries.en: After an opposing creature leaves the field, its replacement loses 3 energy.

entries.zh: 梦游（穿星星睡衣的样子）
旧睡衣曾经的样子，主人把夜晚缝了进来，每一针、每一线都是对它的美好祝愿。它们收到了很多的爱，抱着自己时，能感受到属于主人的温暖，那是存在的全部理由。
entries.en: The old pyjamas used to look like the master sewn the night in and every needle, every line is a wish for it. They get so much love, they feel the warmth of their owners when they hold them. That's all there is.

entries.zh: 梦悠悠（穿旧睡衣的样子）
被遗忘的旧睡衣，因为孤单和思念而死，死后变成了幽灵。明明是毛绒绒的，但是体表温度极低，摸起来很凉，即使一直抱着它，它也很难变暖。
entries.en: The forgotten old nightgown, died of loneliness and thoughts, and became a ghost. It was furry, but it was extremely cold, and it was difficult to warm up, even if it kept holding it.

entries.zh: 梦悠悠（穿星星睡衣的样子）
梦悠悠也学会了去爱别人，喜欢和毛茸茸的伙伴们挤作一团，让大家靠着它打盹，不那么毛茸茸的小洛克也可以一起。尾尖的星星整夜亮着，是守护安眠的小夜灯。
entries.en: Dreams are learning to love people, to snore with furry partners, and not so hairy little Rock together. The tail stars are lit all night long, a light that protects sleep.

entries.zh: 稀兽花种的幼年形态，非常轻，会随风而动，身后有像翅膀一样的苞片，苞片上有特殊的薄膜，可以起到防风防水的效果，保护它们健康成长。
entries.en: The young form of rare flower species is very light and moves with the wind. Behind them there are flaps like wings, with special films that can protect them from wind and water and protect them from healthy growth.

entries.zh: 兽花蕾的果实 来源：完成兽花蕾的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Beast Bud fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Beast Bud.

entries.zh: 根据自己的血脉，入场时获得不同效果。
entries.en: Gain a different effect on entry according to your bloodline.

entries.zh: 柔韧的吻部十分有弹性，没有牙齿，用舌头和吻部配合嘬取食物。每天吃几十只蚂蚁就可以存活，能量消耗很小，多数时间在睡觉。
entries.en: Soft kisses are so elastic, they have no teeth, they eat with their tongues and kisses. Dozens of ants can survive every day, their energy is very small and most of the time they sleep.

entries.zh: 伏地兽的果实 来源：通过风眠省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Ground-Hugging Beast fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Fengmian Province.

entries.zh: 队伍存在虫系精灵，自己获得双攻+50%。
entries.en: If the team contains a Bug-type creature, gain +50% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 吻部变得坚硬，形状如同吸管，舌头又长又黏。没有嗅觉器官，通过舌头来感知气味，经常舔舐各种味道刺激的东西。
entries.en: The kisses are hard, shaped like straws, long and sticky tongues. No smell organs, smell through tongues, often licking all kinds of stimuli.

entries.zh: 体表坚硬的鬃毛能够防御风吹日晒和敌人的攻击。长舌灵活而柔韧，能够绊倒猎物或者缠绕颈部使其窒息，吻部如同长矛一般刺穿猎物的要害，甚至可以击穿岩石。
entries.en: Strong hair can protect against the wind and the enemy's attack. Long tongues are flexible and flexible, tripping their prey or suffocating it around their necks, kissing like spears piercing the essence of their prey and even hitting rocks.

entries.zh: 总是蹦蹦跳跳的，会用滚动的方式攻击。对温度和湿度都很敏感，但就算冷得发抖也不抱团取暖。
entries.en: It's always bouncing and rolling. It's sensitive to temperature and humidity, but it doesn't warm up even if it's cold.

entries.zh: 蹦蹦种子的果实 来源：完成蹦蹦花的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Bouncing Seed fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Bouncing Flower.

entries.zh: 使用草系技能时，敌方获得2层 中毒 。
entries.en: When using a Flora-type skill, inflict 2 stacks of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 和其他蹦蹦种子相比，更加不耐旱。这可能和头顶的花朵会变成粉紫色有关，蹦蹦种子家族体内很难合成紫色色素，付出更多努力才能长出紫色花朵。
entries.en: And it's less drought-resistant than other bouncing seeds. This may be related to the fact that the flower on the head turns pink, that it is difficult to synthesize purple pigment in a jumping seed family and that more effort can be made to grow purple flowers.

entries.zh: 体内90%都是储水组织，体表的蜡质层能高效转化光能，并将多余水分锁在体内。经过连续日晒后，身体会微微散发出清甜的瓜果香气，这种挥发性物质有一定抗菌和防晒的功能。
entries.en: 90% of the body is water-storage, and the wax layer on the watch efficiently converts light energy and locks excess water into the body. After sunbathing, the body slightly emits sweet melon fragrance, which has a certain antibacterial and prosthesis function.

entries.zh: 生长在干旱地区强烈的紫外线下，这种形态的蹦蹦种子演化出奶油白花朵。日间活动迟缓，主要依赖夜间温度下降时吸收空气中的微量水分。
entries.en: This form of bouncing seeds evolves into buttered white flowers, growing under strong ultraviolet light in arid areas. Daytime activity is slow and depends mainly on the absorption of trace water from air when temperatures decline at night.

entries.zh: 挥舞着长满刺的双手跳来跳去，要小心地接近。在太阳光下变得格外兴奋，情绪波动时头顶的花苞有可能突然绽放。
entries.en: Swinging with your prickly hands and dancing, you have to get close. In the light of the sun, it becomes particularly exciting, and the bouquets above your head may suddenly burst.

entries.zh: 表皮变得更厚实，需要消耗大量的能量和水分来合成紫色色素。这种头上有粉紫色花苞的蹦蹦草们偶尔有群体聚集的行为倾向，这是为了减少个体受光面积，维持身体湿度。
entries.en: The skins are thicker and require a great deal of energy and water to synthesize purple pigments. These bouncing herbs with pink purple twigs occasionally tend to congregate in order to reduce individual exposure to light and maintain body moisture.

entries.zh: 每到干旱的时候，身体内水分相对减少，而这时花瓣会凝结出少量花蜜，散发的瓜果香气更加浓郁，这是其光合作用达到巅峰的标志，能吸引到一些虫系精灵和馋嘴的小洛克。
entries.en: At times of drought, there is a relative reduction in the internal water fractions of the body, where petals condensate a small amount of nectar and elevate the fragrance of guacamole, which is the symbol of its photo-cooperative reach to peaks and attract some vermin and mothy little Rock.

entries.zh: 白色的花朵能有效反射午间过强的紫外线。花苞外瓣的蜡质层是高效的阳光反射板，内部花粉因此得到保护。仅在日落后，花苞才会微微打开。
entries.en: A white flower can effectively reflect an overmedicated UV in the midday. The wax layer of a petal is an efficient sunlight reflector, so the internal pollen is protected. Only after sunset, the flower will be slightly opened.

entries.zh: 休息的时候会把脚插入地下一动不动，但似乎随时能够进入战斗状态。头上的花不允许任何人触碰，那似乎是它生命力量的来源。
entries.en: The foot is inserted into the ground during the rest, but it seems to be ready for combat at any time. The flower on your head does not allow anyone to touch it, which seems to be the source of its life force.

entries.zh: 头顶绽放出粉紫色花朵。研究证实，虫系精灵的复眼对紫色波段异常敏感，为了更好地吸引虫系精灵为蹦蹦种子家族传粉，这个种类的蹦蹦花努力了很久终于开出了紫色的花。
entries.en: The head blooms pink flowers. Research has confirmed that the nematode eye of the sphinx is particularly sensitive to the purple band, and that this type of bouncing flower has worked for a long time to finally turn it on in order to better attract the elves to pollute the family of jumping seeds.

entries.zh: 长出肉质的橘粉色花朵，短而厚的花瓣能储存身体水分，让它在干旱的地方也能大摇大摆地出现。花瓣中心储藏着香甜可口的露水，冒险的洛克会把它的花朵当作应急水源，清凉又解渴。
entries.en: Orange pink flowers that grow meat, short and thick petals store body moisture so that they can be found in dry places. The petals contain sweet dews, and the risk-taking Locke uses their flowers as an emergency source of water, cool and thirsty.

entries.zh: 巨大的白色花冠多在月光下绽放，它们喜欢夜间相对凉爽的环境，其花粉在夜间会释放微弱荧光，在月光下吸引夜行性精灵完成授粉。花瓣在日出前会闭合，规避日间的干旱与高温。
entries.en: The vast white crowns bloom under the moon, and they prefer a relatively cool environment at night, where their pollen releases small fluorescent light and attracts nightly elves to finish pollinating under the moonlight. The petals close before sunrise to avoid the sun’s drought and heat.

entries.zh: 手中的果实能将吸收的光能转化为能量，因此日照时间越长，果实积累的能量就越高。据野外观察记录，在日光、月光或特定魔法光环境下成熟的蹦蹦果，会呈现出明显不同的果香味道。
entries.en: The fruits in hand transform the light that is absorbed into energy, so the longer the sun shines, the higher the energy accumulates. Field observations record a distinct smell of fruit fragrance when it matures under daylight, moonlight or certain magic conditions.

entries.zh: 使用草系技能时，敌方获得3层 中毒 。
entries.en: When using a Flora-type skill, inflict 3 stacks of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 在阳光的持续倾泻下，它终于结出了鲜艳的果实，它把一生的光热封存在果实里，白天越长，果肉越甜，鳞片般的果皮微微翘起，像披了层带刺的轻甲。它还是爱蹦，但是每次起跳会让果肉里储存的清甜汁水溅出。
entries.en: In the light of its continuous pouring, it finally brings forth fresh fruit, and it fills a lifetime of light in its fruit, the longer it grows during the day, the sweeter it gets, the smaller its skin rises, as if it were a lair with thorns. It still loves to jump, but every time it jumps, it spills out the sweet water stored in the meat.

entries.zh: 整个咩咩非常蓬松，每一根蓬松的毛都带电，稍微靠近它就要被静电“哔哩”一下。释放能量之后会进入低电量状态，低电量时会没精打采并吃很多。
entries.en: The whole thing is very fluffy, every fluffy hair carries electricity, and a little closer to it is going to be electrostatic "beep." When the energy is released, it goes into low-power condition, and when it's low, it goes down and eats a lot.

entries.zh: 电咩咩的果实 来源：完成电球咩咩的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Electric Baa fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Electroball Baa.
Restore 10 energy when leaving the field.

entries.zh: 经常看到它们聚在一起胡乱放电，放电的时候会跳奇怪的舞蹈，十分开心的样子。如果埋进它们的毛里猛吸一口，被电很惨同时会闻到糊糊的怪味。
entries.en: It's always fun to see them come together and release their electricity in a strange dance. If they're buried in their hair, they suck at it, and it's so bad that they can smell it all at once.

entries.zh: 头顶的毛团会定期脱落并瞬间萌发出新的一团，当遇到危险的时候，电球咩咩会快速脱落掉头顶毛团，以达到吸引敌人注意力的效果。
entries.en: The hairballs on the top of their heads will fall regularly and a new one will suddenly emerge, and when they are in danger, what is a ball that quickly falls off the hair over its head to attract the attention of the enemy?

entries.zh: 喜欢阳光，可爱的圆形精灵，三只一起在草丛中随风飘动。风吹到哪就会飞到哪，总是无忧无虑的。
entries.en: Like the sun, sweet round elfs, all three of them moving with the wind in the grass. The wind will fly wherever it blows, and there is no fear.

entries.zh: 蒲公英的果实 来源：完成蒲公英娃娃的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Dandelion fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dandelion Doll.

entries.zh: 携带的能耗大于3的技能，威力+40%。
entries.en: Carried skills with an energy cost greater than 3 gain +40% power.

entries.zh: 三个可爱的小家伙簇拥着一团轻盈的绒球，绒球的内部构造不得而知。协同发力的话，能够随心所欲地借助风力飞往任何地方。
entries.en: Three cute little guys with a light velvet ball, the inner structure of which is unknown. Together, they can fly anywhere with wind whenever they want.

entries.zh: 它头顶长着一团蓬松的绿色苔藓，压低身体时能很好地融入草丛，几乎难以分辨。苔藓本身不疏水，一旦沾到水就会迅速吸收并变得沉重，让它行动迟缓甚至走不动，只能停在原地等待自然风干。它的身体像果冻一样具有弹性，可拉伸变形。
entries.en: It has a thick green moss with its head above it, which can be well integrated into the bushes when pressure is low. The moss itself does not dehydrate, it quickly absorbs and becomes heavy once it is touched by water, keeps it slow to move or not to walk, but stays in place to wait for the natural wind to dry. Its body is as resilient as a jelly and can stretch to deform.

entries.zh: 伊贝儿的果实 来源：完成伊贝粉粉的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Yibei fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Pink Yibei.

entries.zh: 每回复1能量，同时回复5%生命。
entries.en: For every 1 energy restored, also restore 5% HP.

entries.zh: 苔藓常把眼睛遮住，因此它对细微动作的反应显得迟钝。若有洛克替它把苔藓梳理开，它会明显变得开心。进食后体型会短暂膨大一圈，随后再慢慢恢复原状。
entries.en: The moss often hides its eyes, so it's slow to react to the fine movement. If Locke combs the moss for it, it will become quite happy. After eating, the body size will expand briefly and then be restored slowly.

entries.zh: 一直闭着眼睛在睡觉，即使是醒了也看不出来。在它睡着的时候也能对听到的声音有所反应，仿佛是个熟练的梦游者。
entries.en: You've been sleeping with your eyes closed, and you can't see it even when you wake up. It reacts to the sound it hears, as if it were a skilled sleepwalker.

entries.zh: 白发懒人的果实 来源：完成瞌睡王的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: White-Haired Sloth fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sleepy King.

entries.zh: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每成功应对1次，回复5能量。
entries.en: Start with 0 energy. Before entering, restore 5 energy for every 1 successful allied response.

entries.zh: 有一半的时间在睡觉，极少保持清醒，清醒时精力极其旺盛。会使劲捶打胸口努力让自己变得清醒，但是卖力地运动过后睡得更沉了。
entries.en: Half of the time is asleep, rarely remains awake, and when sober, the energy is so high that it helps to sank on your chest, but sleeps even more after working hard.

entries.zh: 比较难找到它的眼睛，主要靠鼾声来判断它是不是醒着。即使危险就在面前也能睡得香香的，或许是强大的体格给了它这样做的底气。
entries.en: It's hard to find its eyes, and it's mostly snoring to determine whether it's awake. Even the danger is right in front of it, and perhaps a strong body gives it the atmosphere to do so.

entries.zh: 它静止时像不起眼的礁石，让人很难判断这是不是生物。它以底栖方式缓慢移动，活动量与食物多少直接相关，食物少时一天可能只挪动一点点。棘刺间分布感光细胞，使它对强光十分敏感，常本能地躲向阴影。
entries.en: It's like an invisible reef, and it's hard to tell if it's a creature. It moves slowly in the benthic mode, its activity is directly related to the amount of food that may move only a little bit a day less. The distribution of luminous cells between thorns makes it sensitive to strong light, often instinctively hiding into the shadows.

entries.zh: 海盔虫的果实 来源：完成千棘盔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sea Helmet Bug fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Thousand-Spine Helmet.

entries.zh: 每携带1个毒系技能进入战斗，水系技能使敌方获得1层 中毒 。
entries.en: For every 1 Poison-type skill carried into battle, your Water-type skills inflict 1 stack of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 如果看到水域里冒出许多体表有短刺的精灵，那是海盔虫在呼吸。它们不会主动攻击，刺又短又圆润，如果用手摸它们的刺，会感觉到被轻轻扎了一下，并不会很疼。
entries.en: If you see a lot of elves in the water with short stings, it's Sea Helmets breathing. They don't attack on their own initiative, they're short and round, and if they touch them with their hands, they feel lightly and not very painful.

entries.zh: 刺上会卡着贝壳，木片，海藻。长长的棘刺有大量感光细胞，对光线非常敏感，具有负趋光性，为了逃避光线会在日间抓着各种东西为自己遮挡光线。食物充足时移动距离也会稍微变大。
entries.en: It's got shell shells, wood chips, seaweeds. Long thorns have a lot of light cells, are sensitive to the light and negatively radiant. To escape the light, they grab everything in the sun to shield themselves from it.

entries.zh: 在水中，普通的刺盔虫因为棘刺太长，容易被海草缠住，而被磨损了的刺盔虫，它们的短刺既能保护自己，又能减少移动阻力。它们被惊扰时收缩成一团，然后用坚硬的刺铠防御伤害。
entries.en: In the water, ordinary hedgehogs are worn out as they are too long for thorns to be entangled with seaweeds. Their short stings protect themselves and reduce their resistance to movement. They shrink into a swarm when they are disturbed and then defend themselves with hard pricks.

entries.zh: 平时它仍行动迟缓，但遇险时能短暂加速，脱离光照与威胁区域。受到轻微触碰时，棘刺会迅速聚合，并指向接触点，棘端的毒囊能造成刺痛与轻微麻木。
entries.en: In general, it is still slow to move, but temporarily accelerates out of the light and threat areas in distress. When touched slightly, thorns quickly converge and point to the point of contact, where a poison bag at the end can cause stings and mild numbness.

entries.zh: 短棘虽然短，但更粗壮，呼吸效率比其他千棘盔更高——它们能快速吞吐海水中的氧气，即使在浑浊水域也能保持稳定呼吸。部分个体的短棘尖端含有毒囊，但毒素更加微弱，通常只会让接触者感到轻微麻木。
entries.en: The thorns, though short, are thicker and more effective than the other thorn helmets – they can quickly spit out oxygen from the seawater, and they can breathe safely even in the blistering waters. Part of the individual's thorny tip contains a poison bag, but the toxin is weaker and usually only makes the contact feel slightly numb.

entries.zh: 有少量报告称见到过如此奇异的精灵。似乎看一眼都会感觉到刺痛。 身形大过鸟类，尖刺利过刀刃。已经无法找到虫体本身。它们再也不用担心保护自己的问题了，反而是别的生物需要担心这个。
entries.en: There are a few reports of having seen such strange elves. It seems as if it's stingy at first glance. It's bigger than birds, sharper than blades. It's impossible to find the worm itself. They don't have to worry about protecting themselves anymore, but they need to worry about other creatures.

entries.zh: 每携带1个毒系技能进入战斗，水系技能使敌方获得2层 中毒 。
entries.en: For every 1 Poison-type skill carried into battle, your Water-type skills inflict 2 stacks of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 有少量报告称见到过如此奇异的精灵。似乎看一眼都会感觉到刺痛。身形大过铠甲，尖刺利过刀刃。已经无法找到虫体本身。它们再也不用担心保护自己的问题了，反而是别的生物需要担心这个。
entries.en: A small number of reports say they've seen such a strange elf. It seems as if it's stingy at first glance. It's bigger than armor, sharper than blade. It's impossible to find the worm itself. They don't have to worry about protecting themselves anymore, but other creatures need to worry about it.

entries.zh: 看起来像梨，闻起来像梨，尝起来味道也像梨。睡觉的时候会把身体藏在泥巴里，只把花朵留在地面上。小黄蜂想要来授粉的话它会非常苦恼。
entries.en: It looks like pear, it smells like pear, and it tastes like pear. When you sleep, you hide your body in mud and leave your flowers on the ground. The bumblebee will be very upset if he wants to pollute.

entries.zh: 菊花梨的果实 来源：完成菊花梨的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Chrysanthemum Pear fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Chrysanthemum Pear.

entries.zh: 可获得的 萌化 层数不受限制。
entries.en: There is no limit to the number of Cutification stacks you can gain.

entries.zh: 小星光（星光能量的样子）
草原晴天的微风里，常传来细碎噼啪——那是小星光在甩鬃毛，它们似乎总是处于炸毛的状态，其实 是毛发里的电流导致的。它们从来不怕打雷，长长的尾巴能起到导电的作用，被雷劈中也不会受伤。
entries.en: In the breezes of the plains, it's often nuanced -- it's small starlights that seem to be in a hairy state, actually caused by currents in the hair. They are never afraid of thunder and long tails can act as conductors, nor will they be hit by lightning.

entries.zh: 小星光的果实 来源：完成星光狮的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Starlight fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Starlight Lion.

entries.zh: 携带的攻击技能获得 迸发 ：威力+40。
entries.en: Carried attack skills gain Burst: +40 power.

entries.zh: 小星光（月光能量的样子）
月光下诞生的小星光，储存的雷电能量转化为银白色月光，看起来像光在云层中多次散射所形成的月晕。
entries.en: The small starlights born under the moon light, the stored lightning energy turning into silver white moons, look like a moon dizziness formed by the repeated scattering of light in the clouds.

entries.zh: 星光狮（星光能量的样子）
头顶的晶体是身体的一部分，里面似乎蕴含着无尽的能量。从晶体中发射能量攻击对手，吃饱睡好的情况下发射的能量炮能炸掉整个聆风塔地。
entries.en: The crystal over its head is part of the body, and it seems to contain endless energy. Fire from the crystal to attack the opponent, and when you sleep well, fire a cannon can blow up the entire wind tower.

entries.zh: 星光狮（月光能量的样子）
它头部鬃毛由大量半透明、有导光能力的角蛋白丝构成，能高效传导月光中的能量，能量充沛时，尾巴的鬃毛呈持续流动的银雾状视觉效果。
entries.en: Its head hair consists of a large number of semi-transparent, conductive angular protein wires that efficiently transmit the energy from the moon light and, when it is filled with energy, the tail hair has a continuous flow of silver fog visual effects.

entries.zh: 悬浮着的蜂巢就像身体的一部分一样灵活运动。可能是受某种信息素或者魔法影响，总会默契地做出协同的动作。
entries.en: The floating hives are as flexible as a part of the body. They can be influenced by some kind of information resource or magic, and they always act in concert.

entries.zh: 一窝蜂的果实 来源：完成花魁蜂后的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Bee Swarm fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Flower Queen Bee.

entries.zh: 队伍中每有1只其他的虫系精灵，自己入场时获得攻防速+10%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +10% attack, defence and speed for every 1 other Bug-type creature on the team.

entries.zh: 在蜂后的下半身周围有能量波动，推测是用来建立两只小蜂的联系。战斗时，蜂后的两眼会变成红色，针刺也会变得锋利无比。
entries.en: There's energy fluctuations around the lower side of the bee, and it's supposed to connect two little bees. When you fight, the bee's eyes turn red, and the needle sting becomes sharp.

entries.zh: 穿着披风、戴着王冠的蜂后，总是带着它的两个小侍卫。高雅的女王形象令人印象深刻，它的外形曾经是许多服装设计的灵感。
entries.en: A queen in cape and crowned bee always wears two of its little guards. An elegant queen has an impressive image, a shape that used to inspire many costume designs.

entries.zh: 只有最尊贵的蜂后能得到加冕，穿着金色的华美虫衣，有淡淡的花香味，女王蜂以信息素的方式向周围的蜂群传递自己的命令。
entries.en: Only the most noble queens can be crowned, wearing golden velvet suits and the smell of light flowers, and the queen bees pass their orders to the surrounding herds in the form of messages.

entries.zh: 队伍中每有1只其他的虫系精灵，自己入场时获得攻防速+15%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +15% attack, defence and speed for every 1 other Bug-type creature on the team.

entries.zh: 身手敏捷的小猫，擅长在雾气中隐藏身形，也可以幻化成其他物体。常常以惊讶和恐惧为食，消化后会散发出一种奇怪的味道。
entries.en: An agile little cat, good at hiding her body in the fog, can morph into something else. Often, surprise and fear are used to feed on it, and digesting it produces a strange smell.

entries.zh: 小夜的果实 来源：完成朔夜伊芙的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Night fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for New-Moon Eve.

entries.zh: 自己每失去25%生命，连击数+2。
entries.en: For every 25% HP you lose, gain +2 hits.

entries.zh: 经常四处游历，偶尔幻化成其他精灵的样子之后偷偷潜入其他族群中，猜测是为了锻炼自己的幻化能力。通常情况下喜欢独自生活。
entries.en: You often travel around, sometimes sneaking into other communities as if you were another elf. You usually like to live alone.

entries.zh: 喜欢在远处观察其他精灵的活动，有时会故意制造幻象来测试目标的反应。几乎不与同类接触，有些排斥社交，意外的是，被亲近的洛克抚摸的话耳朵尖会发光。
entries.en: He likes to observe the activities of other elves from a distance, sometimes deliberately creating hallucinations to test their reaction. Little contact with his own kind, some rejection of socialization, and unexpectedly, the tip of his ears glows if he is touched by close Locke.

entries.zh: 羽毛有很好的疏水性，可以毫不费力地浮在水面上，浮着的时候怔怔地看着水面，并不是在发呆，而是在检查自己的美丽，小小的乖乖鹄很早就已经意识到了美丽与优雅的重要性。
entries.en: The feathers are very hydrophobic, they can float on the surface without any effort, and look at the surface when they do. They are not gliding, but checking for their beauty, which is so small that the importance of beauty and elegance has been recognized long ago.

entries.zh: 乖乖鹄的果实 来源：完成翠顶夫人的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Gentle Cygnet fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Emerald-Crowned Lady.

entries.zh: 离场 后，自己的 增益 和 减益 会被更换入场的精灵继承。
entries.en: After you leave the field, your replacement inherits your buffs and debuffs.

entries.zh: 有强烈美意识的种族，时常梳理羽毛，用珍珠来打扮自己。优雅的举止和良好的外表是向同伴传递自身健康强壮的信号，拥有的珍珠数量也决定了自身在种群中的地位。
entries.en: A race with a strong sense of beauty, always combing its feathers and dressing itself with pearls. Elegance and good appearance are signals to its peers that they are healthy and strong, and the number of pearls in their possession determines their status in the population.

entries.zh: 柔弱温顺，羽毛软而蓬松。过于专注梳理羽毛可能会迷路，意识到迷路的时候通常已经游到了完全不认识的环境里。不过总能保持优雅淡定，似乎永远不会慌张惊恐。这或许是夫人为自己制定的礼仪规范。
entries.en: Soft and gentle, feathers soft and loose. Too focused to comb feathers can get lost, and it usually swims into a completely unknown environment when you get lost. But you always stay elegant and calm, and you never seem to panic. This is perhaps the protocol that the lady has set for herself.

entries.zh: 天鹅精灵中罕见的独居分支，对社交并不热衷。羽毛长而卷翘，摸起来有些刺手，似乎并不符合种族中普遍的审美，但自信令她看起来非常优雅。
entries.en: The rare solo branch of the swan elves is not very social. The feathers are long and curly, they touch a bit of stingy, they don't seem to fit in with the glorification that is common among races, but self-confidence makes her look very elegant.

entries.zh: 敌方精灵 离场 后，其 增益 和 减益 会被更换入场的精灵继承。
entries.en: After an opposing creature leaves the field, its replacement inherits its buffs and debuffs.

entries.zh: 三三两两地站在建筑的高处，有些神秘，被认为是王国的守护者。洛克靠近时，会发出尖锐刺耳的声音，头部奇怪的形状为工具设计提供了设计灵感。
entries.en: Three, three, two and a half stand at the height of the building, some mysteriously considered to be the guardian of the kingdom. Locke comes near with sharp snares, and the strange shape of his head provides design inspiration for tool design.

entries.zh: 锤头鹳的果实 来源：完成锤头鹳的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Hammerhead Stork fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Hammerhead Stork.

entries.zh: 携带的能耗小于3的技能，获得 迅捷 。
entries.en: Carried skills with an energy cost below 3 gain Swift.

entries.zh: 在森林里挥舞着手中的木棍，好像是在做施放巫术的练习。偶尔会和帽子交谈，晒太阳的时候可能会发出诡异的笑声。
entries.en: Swinging sticks in the forest, it's like practicing sorcery. Sometimes talking to hats, getting laughter when you're sunning.

entries.zh: 绿草精灵的果实 来源：完成魔草巫灵的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Green Grass Spirit fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Magic Grass Witch.

entries.zh: 离场 后，更换入场的精灵以 木桶状态 登场。
entries.en: After you leave the field, your replacement enters in Barrel state.

entries.zh: 守护着森林的小巫师，头上的帽子似乎已经跟随它多年了。帽子的两侧是它树叶状的耳朵，能听到树木之间的对话。
entries.en: The young sorcerers who guard the forest seem to have had their hats followed for many years. On both sides of the hat are its leaves-like ears, and they can hear a conversation between trees.

entries.zh: 埋在土地里露出上半截，就像是石碑一样。通过扫描分析它所散发的波动，能窥见一点点王国百年前的历史。
entries.en: Buried in the land, it's like a stone. By scanning the fluctuations that it emit, you can see a little bit of the Kingdom's history a hundred years ago.

entries.zh: 记忆石的果实 来源：完成记忆石的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Memory Stone fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Memory Stone.

entries.zh: 携带的无额外效果的攻击技能，威力+30%。
entries.en: Carried attack skills with no additional effect gain +30% power.

entries.zh: 跑得很快，手短且柔软，一般用尾巴来代替手的作用。尝试助跑之后短暂地浮空，但似乎一直没能学会飞翔。
entries.en: Runs fast, hands short and soft, usually with a tail instead of a hand. After trying to help him, he floats briefly, but doesn't seem to be able to learn how to fly.

entries.zh: 咔咔羽毛的果实 来源：通过风眠省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Kaka Feather fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Fengmian Province.

entries.zh: 若先于敌方行动，行动后获得 连击数 +1。
entries.en: If you act before the opponent, gain +1 hit after acting.

entries.zh: 仿照洛克号的帆进化出了大尾巴，曾经尝试练习滑翔，大尾巴让它们能够短暂浮空，也可以用来吓唬和拍打敌人。
entries.en: Like Roark's sails, they evolved out of the big tail, which tried to glide and allowed them to float briefly. They could also be used to scare and beat the enemy.

entries.zh: 拥有两条漂亮的大尾巴，虽然无法飞翔，但是抓着大尾巴可以滑翔一段距离，滑翔时身体散发出香香的味道，是因为这个种族普遍有些恐高，紧张的时候会释放舒缓神经的信息素，为自己壮胆。
entries.en: Having two beautiful big tails, which, although unable to fly, can glide a distance and smell of fragrance when they glide, is because the race is generally afraid of heights and when it is nervous, it releases the information fluid that relaxes the nerves and gives itself courage.

entries.zh: 果树分叉越多的地方，越容易找到它们，常常被误认为是未熟的青葡萄。肤表黏糊糊的，睡觉时缩成一团挂在树上。常观察到许多只挤在一起，目前推测是畏寒的原因。
entries.en: The more there are fork, the easier it is to find them, often misconstrued as uncircumcised green grapes. Skin-faced, sleep shrunk up in a tree. Many of them are observed together and are now presumed to be the reason for the cold.

entries.zh: 小草虫的果实 来源：完成花衣蝶的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Grass Bug fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Flower-Clad Butterfly.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，己方队伍获得1次随机 奉献 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, your team gains 1 random Offering.

entries.zh: 与果树是互利共生关系，在果树之间采蜜的同时完成授粉。尾部的花朵是虹吸式进食器官，能够用来吸取和储存花粉，是访花昆虫中最重要的种群。
entries.en: It is a mutually beneficial symbiotic relationship with fruit trees, which pollinate them while collecting honey between fruit trees.

entries.zh: 原本的尾巴脱落后变成手中的花朵，似乎蕴含着魔法能量，能当作魔杖使用。冬日寒冷的雨夜里，成千上万的花衣蝶聚集在枯树上休息，清晨又四散飞走，如同花开一夜的蜃景。
entries.en: The original tail is turned into a flower in its hands, and it seems to contain magic energy that can be used as a wand. In the cold rain of winter, thousands of flowers and butterflies gather on the dead tree and travel again in the morning, like an all-night mirage.

entries.zh: 胆小谨慎的精灵，总是下意识地遮挡和隐藏自己。头部心型冠的原理不明，要小心对待，拉扯后，绿翼鸟的性格和样貌会大变，拉扯三次后变回本来的性格和样貌。
entries.en: Cautionful elves are always consciously shielding themselves and hiding themselves. The head-crowding principles are unclear, careless, and when pulled, the green wing birds change their character and shapes so dramatically that they pull back three times.

entries.zh: 绿翼鸟的果实 来源：完成魔眷鸟的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Greenwing Bird fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Magic-Blessed Bird.

entries.zh: 自己每有1层 萌化 ，获得 连击数 +3。
entries.en: For every 1 stack of Cutification you have, gain +3 hits.

entries.zh: 巨大的翅膀能够给予敌人强有力的打击，旋转时更能提高打击效率。物理攻击和魔法攻击都很擅长，翅膀中蕴含着巨量魔力，翅膀内侧的脉络中是魔力流转的痕迹。
entries.en: Large wings can give the enemy a powerful blow, and they can be more effective when they rotate. Physical attacks and magic attacks are good, with huge magic in their wings and magic flows in their veins.

entries.zh: 似乎并非是自然产生的物种，对魔法的共鸣极强。根据调查统计结果来看，即使是野生的魔眷鸟也曾经有过契约者，怀疑是被制作出之后再放生的。
entries.en: It doesn't seem to be a natural species, but it has a strong resonance with magic. According to the survey, even wild phantom birds have been contracted and suspected of being made and released.

entries.zh: 全身都是岩石，但眼睛周围没有岩石保护，是十分脆弱的柔软皮肤。喜欢吃不同口味的矿石，总是静静呆着，没什么存在感。
entries.en: The whole body is rocked, but there's no rock around the eyes, it's a very fragile soft skin. You like different ores, you're still, you don't feel anything.

entries.zh: 阿米亚特的果实 来源：完成罗隐的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Amiyat fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Luoyin.

entries.zh: 能量不足时，消耗5%生命，代替1能量。
entries.en: When energy is insufficient, spend 5% HP in place of 1 energy.

entries.zh: 石头组成的上身和双臂异常粗壮，腿部短小，经常会腿痛。重重挥拳的时候会把构成手部的石头都打散，不过很快就会用岩石修补好。
entries.en: The upper body and arms of the stone are so thick that their legs are so small, they often hurt their legs. When you wave your fists, you break up all the stones that make up your hands, but it'll soon be repaired with rocks.

entries.zh: 身体中结晶脉络光滑透亮，十分坚硬，似乎是某种矿石。长着凶狠的样貌，揣着不知如何表达的善意，示好的时候会展示一下由石头构成的肌肉。
entries.en: The crystalline flow is smooth and very hard, and it seems to be some kind of ore. With a ferocious look, with unknowing goodwill, it shows the muscles made up of stones.

entries.zh: 吃下稀有的矿石后，极少部分个体能进化成这样。长得更加凶狠，头顶的斧状骨冠非常锋利，用于劈开坚硬的岩层寻找稀有矿石，任何靠近的入侵者都会被它那副凶狠的模样吓退。
entries.en: When you eat rare ores, very few individuals can evolve this way. They are much more ferocious, and the axe crowns on their heads are sharper, used to break hard rock formations to find rare ore, and any nearby intruder will be deterred by its ferocity.

entries.zh: 能量不足时，消耗5%最大生命，代替1能量。生命低于50%时，获得吸血100%。
entries.en: When energy is insufficient, spend 5% maximum HP in place of 1 energy. Below 50% HP, gain 100% lifesteal.

entries.zh: 如果看见它们在水面上大量聚集，往往预示着快要下雨。它们的尾巴摆动时带起细小涟漪，薄膜边缘会在气流中轻轻振动，发出清亮悦耳的声响。
entries.en: If you see them massing on the surface, it tends to signal that rain is coming. Their tails move with a tiny twig, and the edges of the thin membrane vibrate lightly in the airstream and make a sound that brightens their ears.

entries.zh: 风铃鲨的果实 来源：完成彩蝶鲨的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Windchime Shark fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Rainbow Butterfly Shark.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次水系技能，自己入场时获得全技能能耗-1。
entries.en: On entry, reduce all skill energy costs by 1 for every 1 Water-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 它的身体构造至今难以完全解释：体内几乎都是水，身体被一层透明的膜包裹住，里面的液体非常轻。飞行时，由于压力变化或者风势太大，液体有时会漏出来。
entries.en: It is difficult to fully explain its physical structure: it is almost water in the body, it is wrapped in a transparent film and the liquids are very light. During flight, the fluids sometimes leak because of pressure changes or too much wind.

entries.zh: 常被目击从水面贴风飞过，轻盈得几乎不留波纹，它飞行时会借气流而动，并且发出清亮的声音。危险逼近时，它会迅速褪淡体色，降低存在感，再沿风向逃跑。
entries.en: It's often seen passing through the water, lightly and almost untraceable. It moves with air currents and makes a bright sound. When the danger approaches, it quickly fades, reduces its presence and then escapes along the wind.

entries.zh: 暴雨时，它将雨水储藏在身体中；干旱降至，它在半空挥舞翼膜，水分升空化作雾墙，再聚成雨云。“这一路上，跌跌撞撞，有时快乐，有时候感伤，可是它依然坚强，哪怕真的没有尽头，它都愿意继续前行。”
entries.en: When it rains, it stores the rain in its body; the drought drops to a semi-empty winging film, and the water rises into a fog wall, and then gathers into a cloud. “On this road, falling and crashing, sometimes happy, sometimes sad, but still strong, even if it does not end, it is willing to continue.”

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次水系技能，自己入场时获得全技能能耗-1，且能耗为0的技能威力+30%。
entries.en: On entry, reduce all skill energy costs by 1 for every 1 Water-type skill used by an allied creature. Skills costing 0 energy also gain +30% power.

entries.zh: 古老的种族，似乎和现在的精灵们很少交流，但对洛克族十分友好。地系部族掌握建造之术后的创造的第一个物种。在古代也被用作计量单位，一个石石约等于三十千克。
entries.en: An ancient species that rarely seems to interact with modern creatures, but is very friendly towards the Roco people. It was the first species created after the Earth tribes mastered construction. In ancient times it was also used as a unit of measurement: one Shishi was approximately thirty kilograms.

entries.zh: 石石的果实 来源：完成巨灵石的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Shishi fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Giant Spirit Stone.

entries.zh: 若使用技能能耗高于敌方，回合结束敌方失去能耗之差的能量。
entries.en: If your skill costs more energy than the opponent's, the opponent loses energy equal to the difference at the end of the turn.

entries.zh: 从大地获取强大的能量，可以使用地系魔法操纵土壤石头。常常收集一些土壤、石块作为零食，喜欢边讲故事边嚼石头，洛克族的孩子们偶尔会躲在旁边偷偷听它们讲故事。
entries.en: To acquire powerful energy from the earth, soil stones can be manipulated with the magic of the earth. Often, soils and rocks are collected as snacks, they like to chew on them while telling stories, and Roark children occasionally sit around and listen to their stories.

entries.zh: 在很久很久前被洛克族在遗迹的深处发现，可能已经有上千年的历史了。它的身体由宝石和贵重的金属组成，是被追求财富的人争抢的对象。
entries.en: It was discovered a long time ago by the Locke people at the depths of their remains, perhaps for thousands of years now. Its body is made up of precious stones and metals that are the object of competition among those who seek wealth.

entries.zh: 仪使者的果实 来源：通过风眠省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Ritual Envoy fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Fengmian Province.

entries.zh: 敌方每有1层 星陨印记 ，自己的地系技能威力+20%。
entries.en: For every 1 Meteor Mark on the opponent, your Earth-type skills gain +20% power.

entries.zh: 曾被误认为是雕像，但却有意识和情绪。传说它的身体上镶嵌的宝石象征三种元素。被认为是完美平衡的象征，有研究证明它能够感知或预测时间的流动。
entries.en: It was mistakenly thought to be a statue, but conscious and emotional. Legend has it that the gems embedded in its body symbolize three elements. It is considered a symbol of perfect balance, with studies proving that it can sense or predict the flow of time.

entries.zh: 经过时间的洗礼，有些残缺的痕迹，是谜一般的存在，与其相关的研究记录十分少。但相反，这个种族似乎对洛克族十分了解和亲近。 “也许生命会消失，从人们的记忆中淡忘，但文明的传承不会断绝。”
entries.en: After the christening of time, some of the missing traces are common mysteries with which there is very little research documentation. On the contrary, this race seems to know and be close to the Locke people. “Perhaps life will disappear from people’s memories, but civilization will not be lost.”

entries.zh: 它们是远古星象祭典的传承者，将观测到的星轨运行规律铭刻在体表，延续着文明的脉络，身上的古文字符号已超出当代洛克的认知范畴，无法被识别解读。
entries.en: They are the heirs of the Ancient Star Festival, engraved on the surfaces of observed orbital patterns, continuing the bonds of civilization, with ancient letter symbols that go beyond contemporary Locke's perception and cannot be read in an identifiable way.

entries.zh: 敌方每有1层 星陨印记 ，自己的技能威力+20%。
entries.en: For every 1 Meteor Mark on the opponent, your skills gain +20% power.

entries.zh: 漂亮柔软的绿色鬃毛，让谁看了都想抚摸一下。不知是不是它散发出的魔力的缘故，在它的身边会感觉心灵也变得纯净了。
entries.en: The beautiful, soft green hair, it's a touch for everyone to see. I wonder if it's part of the magic, and it's close to it that the mind becomes pure.

entries.zh: 小独角兽的果实 来源：完成白金独角兽的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Unicorn fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Platinum Unicorn.

entries.zh: 携带的非光系技能，威力+25%。
在黑暗中能够照亮周围，像神明一般圣洁而华丽。头顶的角除了穿刺敌人，还能施放出让人震撼的强大魔法冲击。
entries.en: It shines around in the darkness, as holy and beautiful as a god. In addition to piercing the enemy, the horn above its head is able to unleash powerful magic shocks that are shocking.

entries.zh: 彩虹独角兽的毛发可以随环境光线改变反射的波长，在不同角度呈现出彩虹般的绚丽色彩。它也是精灵种群中最为了解洛克的存在，友谊的力量会在彼此心中唤醒新的希望。
entries.en: Rainbow unicorn hairs can change the wavelength of reflection with environmental light, displaying rainbow-like colours from different angles. It is also the best understanding of Locke among elves. The power of friendship awakens new hope in each other ' s hearts.

entries.zh: 额外获得三个未携带的随机技能，且非光系技能威力+25%。
entries.en: Gain three additional random skills that you are not carrying. Non-Light skills also gain +25% power.

entries.zh: 常挂在树上栖息，不仔细观察的话很难发现它们的踪迹。以类似树叶而闻名，颜色、形状，叶脉、叶梗，甚至是破损处也都非常相似。白天多保持静止，风起时会轻微摇晃，让自己更像一片真的叶子。
entries.en: It's hard to find traces of trees if they don't look closely. The colors, shapes, veins, foliage and even broken parts are very similar to those known as leaves. More static during the day, the wind shakes slightly, making itself more like a real leaf.

entries.zh: 旋叶虫的果实 来源：完成风滚暮虫的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Spinning Leaf Bug fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Twilight Tumbleweed Bug.
Your carried Bug Chorus skill gains +20 power.

entries.zh: 主要栖息于恶水泛滥的湿地环境，因长期被恶水侵蚀，其体表发生了不可逆的变化——受到杂质的侵蚀，体表褪去明黄，变得像一片干枯的树叶，再也无法恢复如初。
entries.en: The wetland environment, which is mainly home to a flood of bad water, has undergone irreversible changes in its surfaces as a result of long-term erosion by it — impurities that have faded away from the yellow and become like a dried leaf that can no longer recover.

entries.zh: 必要时能借助鞘翅进行短暂滑行，从一处树冠滑到另一处枝丫。它经常在风力带动下被动迁移，偶尔被风刮走很远，落稳后呆住好一会才能意识到周围环境已经变了。
entries.en: If necessary, a short slide can be made with wings from one tree crown to another. It often moves passively under the wind, occasionally away by the wind and stays for a while before it realizes that the surrounding environment has changed.

entries.zh: 身体结构发生进一步退化，储水能力几乎退化到没有，皮肤质感像纸一样薄，像晒缩的果干一样皱。杂质污染让其他精灵不敢再靠近，这似乎意外地保护了它们的安全。
entries.en: The structure of the body is further degraded, water storage capacity is almost non-existent, skin skin is as thin as paper and wrinkles like a sunny stem. impurity pollution keeps other elves from approaching, which seems to protect them accidentally.

entries.zh: 借风而行的精灵，利用风把自己带离原地，遇到水面或湿润区域就停下来休息。滚动的时候可以帮助植物传播种子。性情温和，对精灵的幼年体都照顾有加，因此与不少精灵能维持友好的关系。
entries.en: Elves who walk by the wind, take themselves away from their place of origin with the wind, and stop and rest when they meet water or wet areas. Scrolling helps plants to spread seeds. They are gentle, caring for their youths, so they maintain friendly relations with many elves.

entries.zh: 在恶劣的环境中，它们形成了低能耗、高防御的行为逻辑，整天处于倦怠状态，其躯体收缩与舒展时，会有细微的气流振动，听起来就像低低的叹息声。
entries.en: In a harsh environment, they form the logic of low-energy consumption and high-defense behaviour, with their bodies shrunk and stretched all day long, with mild air currents vibrating, sounding like low sighs.

entries.zh: 活了足够久的风滚暮虫，叶片会逐渐失去所有色素，变得像风干的白纸。它们有着最高的拟态造诣，身体极轻极薄，落地没有声响，没有任何精灵会对一片“枯死的叶子”产生警觉。
entries.en: With enough time to live, the leaves will gradually lose all colored matter and become like dry white paper. They have the highest pseudomorphosis, they are very light, they're silent, and no elves will be wary of a dead leaf.

entries.zh: 自己携带的「虫鸣」技能威力+20，己方精灵携带的虫系技能获得 巧变 ：虫鸣。
entries.en: Your carried Bug Chorus skill gains +20 power. Bug-type skills carried by allied creatures gain Adapt: Bug Chorus.

entries.zh: 在白天，小黑猫们经常闭上眼睛，揣着手休息，如果冒昧地扒开它们的眼皮，会发现很多时候并没有在睡觉，有一种说法：小黑猫闭眼就是在思考。
entries.en: During the day, black cats often close their eyes and begin to rest. If they open their eyelids, they find that they are not sleeping at many times. There is a saying that black cats are thinking when they close.

entries.zh: 小黑猫的果实 来源：通过风眠省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Little Black Cat fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Fengmian Province.

entries.zh: 若敌方技能足够击败自己，回合开始时自己获得速度+50。
entries.en: If the opponent's skill can defeat you, gain +50 speed at the start of the turn.

entries.zh: 夜晚总是在看星星，长久地观察星空和白天不停地思考，似乎让它们拥有了占卜的能力。偶尔会看到有小洛克拿着可可果去拜托黑猫巫师帮忙预测期末考试题。
entries.en: Nights are always looking at the stars, observing the sky for long periods of time and thinking about it during the day, seeming to give them the ability to read. Sometimes Locke holds cocoa fruit and asks Blackcat wizards for help in predicting final exams.

entries.zh: 拥有了在黑暗夜空中穿行的能力，据说它们能读取宇宙中所有星光的讯息，预知即将发生的危机。小洛克常常发现，当黑猫密探突然变得异常安静时，往往预示着某种变故即将来临。
entries.en: With the ability to travel in the dark night, they are said to be able to read all of the starlights in the universe and predict impending crises. Little Locke often finds that when blackcat spies suddenly become so quiet, they tend to signal a change.

entries.zh: 若敌方技能足够击败自己，回合开始时自己获得速度+50，双攻+50%。
entries.en: If the opponent's skill can defeat you, gain +50 speed and +50% to both attack stats at the start of the turn.

entries.zh: 忽幽狸的尾巴覆盖着剧毒尖刺，静止时会伪装成灌木枝条。当感知到危险，尾巴会瞬间硬化成防御姿态，刺尖分泌的神经毒素能使猎物肌肉僵直。检测显示，其毒素对草系精灵效果加倍。
entries.en: The tails of the phantoms are covered with highly poisonous thorns, and when they remain static, they are disguised as shrub branches. When it becomes aware of danger, the tails are sclerged into defensive postures in an instant, and a virulent neurotoxin can make their prey muscles stiff. Tests show that its toxins double their effect on grass-fed elves.

entries.zh: 忽幽狸的果实 来源：完成影狸的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Huyou Fox fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Shadow Fox.

entries.zh: 敌方精灵 离场 后，更换入场的精灵获得5层 中毒 。
entries.en: After an opposing creature leaves the field, its replacement gains 5 stacks of Poison.

entries.zh: 总是弓着身子，脊椎特化为毒刺弹射装置，用来发射尾巴上的尖刺。体内另外储存了几十根可再生的空心毒刺，通过弹射加压能以每秒10发的速度喷射。
entries.en: The body is always bowed and the spine is turned into a virulent puncture device, which is used to launch a thorn on the tail. There are dozens of renewable hollow stings stored in the body that can be sprayed at 10 rounds per second by ejection plus pressure.

entries.zh: 头部帽子一样的组织触感舒适，冰凉弹软。受到惊吓的话，会从头部喷射出大量毒液，之后迅速缩起陷入昏厥状态。
