entries.en: The head hat is comfy and cold. If you are frightened, a lot of venom is ejected from the head and then quickly shrinks into faintness.

entries.zh: 多多的果实 来源：完成古啦多的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Duoduo fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Guladuo.

entries.zh: 使敌方获得 中毒 时，也会使其获得物攻-40%和速度-40。
entries.en: Whenever you inflict Poison, also inflict -40% physical attack and -40 speed on that opponent.

entries.zh: 头部的粘液组织十分不稳定，情绪激动时甚至会掉落一部分。受到刺激后粘液会挥发到空气中，释放致幻毒素。
entries.en: The tissue of the head is very unstable, and even a fraction of it falls when emotional. Stimulative mucus volatilizes into the air, releasing hallucinogenic toxins.

entries.zh: 头部突起越复杂代表着年龄越大，突起内部充斥剧毒毒液，被一层外套膜包裹起来。遇到危险时，会释放更为强大的致幻毒素，但是并不致命。因此，部分洛克因为想要致幻体验，而专门寻找它们。
entries.en: The more complex the head rises, the older it gets, the more highly toxic the inside is wrapped up in a layer of coated membrane. In case of danger, more powerful hallucinogenic toxins are released, but not fatal. So part of Locke is looking for them because he wants to experience hallucinations.

entries.zh: 成群地栖息在潮湿少光的地域，分泌出来的黏液具有独特的气味，引诱旅人深入密林，吸入过多这种气体便会不停流泪。
entries.en: Clusters of land live in humid and lighted areas, where secretive slime smells uniquely and lures travellers into the dense forest. Over-inhalation of this gas keeps tearing away.

entries.zh: 哭哭菇的果实 来源：完成怖哭菇的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Weeping Mushroom fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dread-Weeping Mushroom.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，敌方获得2层 星陨印记 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, inflict 2 Meteor Marks on the opponent.

entries.zh: 会将身体埋入土壤中，依靠独特的腺体将吸收的水分转化为带有毒性的黏液，干燥与炎热时，散发的气味微微发酸，闻到会想起悲伤的事情。
entries.en: The body is buried in the soil, water absorbed by a unique gland is transformed into virulent slime, and when dry and hot, the odours are slightly acidic, smelling sad things.

entries.zh: 长期在暗处生存，双目视觉逐渐退化，演化出了胸前能够探测、储存幻系能量的触手。幻系能量凝聚在菌柄中，赋予了其极强的再生能力，即便是经过火焰的炙烤，依旧能迅速生出饱满的躯体。
entries.en: Living in the dark for a long time, the eyes and vision gradually deteriorate, elevating the tentacles that detect and store phantom energy in the chest. The hallucinogenic energy condenses in the fungus, giving it a powerful regenerative capacity, even through flame-baking, to produce a full body quickly.

entries.zh: 胸前的毛发非常粗糙，似乎能够起到保护作用。能够在战场上高速地移动，迅猛的前爪攻击十分有力。
entries.en: The hair on the chest is very rough and appears to be protective. It can move at high speeds on the battlefield, with a strong front claw attack.

entries.zh: 恶魔狼的果实 来源：完成恶魔狼的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Vargyr fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Vargyr.

entries.zh: 己方队伍中每有1只力竭的精灵，自己获得双攻+30%。
entries.en: Gain +30% to both attack stats for every 1 exhausted creature on your team.

entries.zh: 恶魔狼王是由族群内的强者通过决斗产生，胜者会以舔舐败者额头的仪式，宣告新统治的建立，当族群遭遇强敌时，恶魔狼王会断后掩护，即便身负重伤也绝不退缩。
entries.en: The wolf king of the devil is born by a duel among the strong within the community, and the winner announces the establishment of a new rule through a ritual that licks the foreheads of the losers. When the clan encounters a strong enemy, the wolf king of the demon will fall behind and will not retreat even if he is seriously wounded.

entries.zh: 双方队伍中每有1只力竭的精灵，自己获得双攻+30%。
entries.en: Gain +30% to both attack stats for every 1 exhausted creature across both teams.

entries.zh: 它们生活在寒冷的水域，会用头顶的晶体吸收空气里的电能量。当能量充足时，晶体表面会浮现细碎的亮纹和电光。偏爱暴雪与打雷的天气，风雪越大、雷声越近，它们越活跃。
entries.en: They live in cold waters, absorb electricity from the air with crystals above their heads. When they have enough energy, crystal surfaces display thin edges and light. The more active they are, the bigger the snow and the closer the thunder.

entries.zh: 小电企鹅的果实 来源：完成电企鹅的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Electric Penguin fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Electric Penguin.

entries.zh: 攻击技能获得 迸发 ：敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
entries.en: Attack skills gain Burst: increase all the opponent's skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 常成群扎堆出现来汲取更充沛的电能量，在寒冷区域居民的传说里，电企鹅大量聚集往往预示极端天气将至，当地还有个习俗——如果遇到雷暴天气，就把电企鹅放在房顶上，可以避免雷电损坏房屋。
entries.en: In the legends of people living in cold regions, where there is often clustering of electric penguins to extract more abundant electricity, there is also a local custom — placing it on the roof in case of thunderstorm weather and avoiding lightning damage to houses.

entries.zh: 出生后被父母放置在雪窝里，进食补充的能量会在冬眠时令身躯快速成长。大手大脚的雪豆丁习惯于翻滚着移动。思维直接，比较容易发脾气，可以抚摸脑袋令其冷静。
entries.en: When they are born, they put their parents in a snow nest, and the energy to feed them will enable their bodies to grow rapidly during hibernation. The big-hand snow bean tans are used to rolling around. Thinking is more direct, it is easier to get angry, so they can calm their heads down.

entries.zh: 雪豆丁的果实 来源：完成雪巨人的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Snow Beanling fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Snow Giant.

entries.zh: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每放1次冰系技能，回复3能量。
entries.en: Start with 0 energy. Before entering, restore 3 energy for every 1 Ice-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 上肢沉重却灵活，体表鬃毛格外厚重，兼具保暖与防护的功能。吸收的寒气能够压缩后储存在脊背和额头上，形成坚实有力的冰晶，用以保持平衡和击打对手。
entries.en: The upper limbs are heavy, but flexible, and the surface hair is particularly heavy, with heating and protective functions. Absorbed cold air can be stored on the backs of the spine and on the forehead, forming a solid and powerful crystal to maintain balance and strike the opponent.

entries.zh: 雪巨人感官极其敏锐，能感受到天气和气温的微小变化，会在族群的幼崽沉睡时巡逻保护它们。双臂能够撑地进行超远距离跳跃，在雪山里飞速前进，跳跃时在岩石上留下后足形状。
entries.en: The snow giants are extremely sensitive and can feel the small changes in weather and temperature, and patrol and protect their communities as they fall asleep. Their arms are able to make a very long jump, move at speed in the snow mountains, leaving a back foot on the rocks when they leap.

entries.zh: 得益于能够分泌疏水性油脂的皮脂腺，皮毛紧实而油亮，既防水又防寒。四肢短而粗壮，跑起来很快，奔跑时偶尔轻微摆动尾巴用来保持平衡。
entries.en: Thanks to the glutinous glands that are able to extract watery fats, the fur is tight and bright, waterproof and cold. The limbs are short and thick, they run quickly, and sometimes their tails are swayed slightly to maintain balance.

entries.zh: 呼呼猪的果实 来源：完成獠牙猪的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Huhu Pig fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Tusked Boar.

entries.zh: 每携带1个冰系技能进入战斗，地系技能威力+10%。
entries.en: For every 1 Ice-type skill carried into battle, your Earth-type skills gain +10% power.

entries.zh: 身躯看似圆润，但其实十分健壮灵活，拥有令人意想不到的爆发力，即使在冰天雪地里，也非常有活力。
entries.en: The body looks round, but it is strong and flexible, with unexpected eruptions, even in the snow and ice.

entries.zh: 它对洛克族异常友好，面对温暖的抚摸与拥抱也从不抗拒。传说它们是最早与洛克建立契约的种族之一，耳朵的轮廓正像星之链在契约双方之间勾勒出的形状。
entries.en: It was very friendly to the Locke people, and it never resisted warm touch and embrace. Legends say that they were one of the first race to enter into a contract with Locke, and the contours of their ears were shaped by the chains of stars between the compacts.

entries.zh: 雪娃娃的果实 来源：完成雪灵的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Snow Doll fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Snow Spirit.

entries.zh: 在场时，敌方全技能能耗+1。
entries.en: While on the field, increase all the opponent's skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 缔结契约的向往更明显，甚至会主动靠近潜在契约者，似乎由冰元素和某种尚不清楚的物质构成，推测该物质来自强烈的信念与精神力，使它们的契约更稳定、也更难被外力改变。
entries.en: The desire to conclude a contract is even more apparent, and even closer to potential contractors, as if it were made up of ice elements and an unknown substance, presumably derived from strong conviction and spiritual strength, making their contracts more stable and less susceptible to change.

entries.zh: 只有当契约者死亡的时候才会寻找下一位契约者。假如原契约者活着，但它们必须更换契约者的话，可能会自我了结生命。
entries.en: The next one will be found only when the author dies. If the original author is alive, but they have to replace them, they may end their lives.

entries.zh: 全身覆满白色绒毛，能抵御寒冷，仔细观察它们的毛毛分为两种，一种是顺滑纤细的针毛，另一种是又软又密的绒毛。虽然体型小，但却不畏惧寒冷，小小的手爪柔软又温暖。似乎喜欢抱抱。
entries.en: They're covered in white fur, resistant to the cold, and look closely at their furs in two ways: smooth and thin needle hair, and soft and dense wool. Small, but not afraid of cold, soft and warm claws. They seem to like hugging.

entries.zh: 大耳帽兜的果实 来源：通过风眠省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Big-Eared Hood fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Fengmian Province.

entries.zh: 使敌方获得 冻结 时，也会使其获得全技能能耗+1。
entries.en: Whenever you inflict Freeze, also increase all that opponent's skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 头部浓密柔软的绒毛负责锁住热量，形成高效的保暖屏障，减少温度流失，兜帽形态的头部结构也可以有效防风。同种族喜欢聚集在一起，贴着脑袋，发热保暖。可能因为这种习性，它们产生了一些社会性。
entries.en: The thick and soft hairs of the head are responsible for locking the heat, creating efficient heating barriers, reducing loss of temperature, and effectively protecting against wind from hood-shaped head structures. Races like to gather together, stick their heads on their heads, keep warm.

entries.zh: 进化后头部绒毛完全脱落，褪去的绒毛承载着进化前的回忆，被制作成一个毛绒娃娃。毛绒娃娃如果能抵御一个严冬就可以获得生命，过程中需要雪影娃娃的悉心养护。
entries.en: The evolved hair is completely removed, and the faded fur carries memories before evolution and is made into a fluffy doll. Furry dolls can survive if they are able to withstand a severe winter and need to be carefully preserved in the process.

entries.zh: 如果遇到了致命的危险，毛绒娃娃会变成巨大的兔精灵来保护主人。不要贸然靠近，不然它会非常生气。这时的它有明确的领地范围，喜欢用耳朵的香腺擦拭东西来划分地盘。如果它用耳朵蹭蹭你，代表你可以接近。
entries.en: If there's a fatal danger, the fluffy doll will turn into a giant rabbit elve to protect its master. Don't come near it, or it will be very angry. It has a clear territory and it likes to wipe off its territory with an ear. If it rubs on your ears, that means you can get close.

entries.zh: 自己入场时敌方获得2层 冻结 ，使敌方获得 冻结 时，也会使其获得全技能能耗+1。
entries.en: On entry, inflict 2 stacks of Freeze on the opponent. Whenever you inflict Freeze, also increase all that opponent's skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 黄金时代的工匠们曾将占星与炼金并列为同一门学问的两种语言。于是他们以火焰为芯，以螺纹为骨，铸成了权杖。现在只有极少量留存下来。
entries.en: The gold-era craftsmen used to list Asteroids and alchemy as two languages of the same study. So they built a scepter with a core of fire, a threaded bone. Only a very small amount is left behind.

entries.zh: 权杖-Ⅱ的果实 来源：完成权杖-V的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sceptre II fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sceptre V.

entries.zh: 若回合内自己携带的技能位置发生变化，该技能能耗永久-1。
entries.en: If a carried skill changes position during the turn, permanently reduce that skill's energy cost by 1.

entries.zh: 在充满斗争与冲突的时代中诞生的精灵，背负着工匠们的意志、行动与他们所点燃的第一把火。在诞生之初能向周围的机械精灵发出统一指令，它们能协调队列、分配任务，让贵族看到了机械系精灵无限的可能性。
entries.en: Elves born in an era of struggle and conflict carry the will, action and first fire that the craftsmen lit. A unified command can be given to the surrounding mechanical elves from the very beginning. They can coordinate their queues and assign tasks so that the nobles can see the infinite possibilities of mechanical elfs.

entries.zh: 鼻子呼出热热的气可能会灼伤小洛克的手，如果在雪山不小心被冻伤，去拜托灵狐帮忙吹一口热气，冻伤瞬间就会痊愈了。
entries.en: The hot air from the nose may burn Little Locke's hand, and if he is accidentally frozen in a snowmount, ask the fox for help to blow the heat, it will heal in an instant.

entries.zh: 灵狐的果实 来源：完成尖嘴狐仙的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Spirit Fox fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Pointed-Snout Fox Immortal.

entries.zh: 冰系技能使敌方获得4层 灼烧 ，火系技能使敌方获得2层 冻结 。
entries.en: Your Ice-type skills inflict 4 stacks of Burn on the opponent. Your Fire-type skills inflict 2 stacks of Freeze on the opponent.

entries.zh: 尾巴里储存着强大的魔力，能够释放一种特殊的雪魔法，保护越冬作物免受冻害、消灭土壤中害虫，如果在冬天的农田里看到九尾狐出现，就知道明年一定会丰收。
entries.en: The tails contain powerful magic that can release a special snow magic to protect winter crops from freezing and eliminate pests in the soil, and if there is a nine-tail fox in winter's farmlands, you will know next year's harvest.

entries.zh: 尖嘴狐仙能通过感知大地的温度变化来预测农时。当它摇着尾巴经过农田时，尾巴扇动的气流会形成特殊的暖湿环流，让田地在寒冷的初春也能保持适宜作物生长的温度。
entries.en: The Flying Fox Fairy predicts agriculture by sense of temperature change on the ground. When it shakes its tail through the field, the tail-squeezed airstream creates a special warm and wet circulation that allows the field to maintain a temperature suitable for crop growth in the cold early spring.

entries.zh: 有着圆滚滚的身躯，小小的翅膀还无法熟练飞翔，却能和愿力发生共鸣，从而获得力量。“和伙伴在一起的安全感连美食都不能替代。即使有时候像个小跟屁虫也无所谓。”
entries.en: With a rounded body, little wings that can't fly with skill, but are able to sympathize with the will and gain strength. "The sense of security with partners is no substitute for food. It doesn't matter even when it's like a little ass-weeper."

entries.zh: 对本精灵的技能，若其他翼系精灵携带相同技能，则获得 迅捷 。被敌方精灵击败时，自己额外损失1点魔力。
entries.en: A skill on this creature gains Swift if another Wing-type creature carries the same skill. When an opposing creature defeats you, lose 1 additional Magic.

entries.zh: 弱小的家伙为了伙伴却愿意勇敢向前！光羽圣殿的门扉悄然开启，沐浴在圣光之力的启迪中，澎湃的力量汹涌而来。“它的思绪已沉醉在无垠的天际中，这片蓝天便是它魂牵梦绕的地方。”
entries.en: The weak are willing to go forward for the sake of their companions! The gates of the Temple of Light feathers are opened quietly, bathed in the inspiration of the power of the Holy Light. "It is intoxicated by its thoughts, and this blue sky is where it dreams."

entries.zh: 庇佑这片纯粹的净土，是拥有强大力量之后背负的使命。从上古壁画中得知尘封的过往，它寻求力量，发自内心地想要保护现在的一切。“张开圣洁的羽翼，为同伴抵挡风雨，便是它心中的圣歌。”
entries.en: To protect this pure and pure earth is a mission that comes upon its back with great power. From the above old fresco, it seeks strength, and from its heart seeks to protect what is now. "Open the wings of the Holy Spirit, to shield its companions from the rain, is the holy song in its hearts."

entries.zh: 如果察觉到小洛克踏入森林，它们会把角塞在树杈中间伪装松果，诱使小洛克靠近观察。被林间露水打湿的话它们会结伴去晒太阳，晒太阳的时候会散发香香的味道。
entries.en: If you notice that Little Locke has stepped into the forest, they put their horns in the middle of a tree to disguise pine nuts and lured Little Rock closer to observation. If they are wet by the dew of the forest, they go with them to the sun, and when they're sunned, they smell the scent of perfume.

entries.zh: 松仔的果实 来源：完成洛克里安魔法手册第一章必修课获得
entries.en: Pine Pup fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Lockrian Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 应对成功后，下次行动 先手 +1。
entries.en: After a successful response, gain +1 priority for your next action.

entries.zh: 刚刚经历换角，松果模样的角脱落，身上的针叶变得锋利，逐渐觉醒领地意识。换角的过程中不要贸然靠近，不然会被踢出几米远。被踢的时候可以闻到它们身上带着森林中泥土和青草的香味。
entries.en: Just after a change of angles, the pine fruit-like horns were removed, and the needle leaves became sharp and gradually awakened to territorial consciousness. Don't try to get close, or they'll be kicked a few metres away. They smelled like dirt and green grass in the forest when they got kicked.

entries.zh: 丛林的向导，拥有修长的四肢与轻盈的骨骼结构，发育完全的角呈树枝状。“所谓的规则像是枝条，又好像荆棘。被缠上时使人烦躁，被刺伤时让人疼痛。但规则也有如树干，在支撑着森林的生命——所谓自由，亦是如此"。
entries.en: The guidance of the jungle, with its long limbs and light bone structures, is fully developed in branches. "The rules are so-called branches, and so are thorns. They are entangled with irritated and stabbed with pain. But there are also rules like trunks that support the forest's life — so is freedom."

entries.zh: 喉咙处有容纳火系魔法的身体结构，在小勇狮身上还不太明显，偶尔能发现它打喷嚏的时候会喷出小火花。
entries.en: There is a body structure in its throat that holds the magic of fire, and it is not very visible on the young lion, who occasionally sneezes at the point where small sparks come out.

entries.zh: 小勇狮的果实 来源：完成洛克里安魔法手册第一章必修课获得
entries.en: Little Brave Lion fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Lockrian Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 应对成功后，下次攻击威力翻倍。
entries.en: After a successful response, double the power of your next attack.

entries.zh: 只是咆哮就能点燃空气，附着火系魔法的利爪能撕裂岩石。喉咙处的火囊发育成熟，可以喷吐高温火球，但偶尔会因能量过载而引发小型爆炸。
entries.en: It's just a growling that ignites the air, and the claws of firey magic tear the rock. Firebags in the throat are mature enough to spit high-temperature fireballs, but occasionally they cause small explosions with excess energy.

entries.zh: 不休的守护者，甚至能将无私守护的意志凌驾于一般契约之上。虽然性格高傲，但对认可的伙伴极为忠诚。拥有永不熄灭的火焰心脏，绝对的正义是支持烈焰的力量源泉。 “让我见识看看吧，你的正义之心！”
entries.en: Protector of the unending, even a selfless will above a general contract. High-mindedness, but extremely loyal to recognized partners. With an eternal flame heart, absolute justice is the source of strength in support of fire. "Let me see your just heart!"

entries.zh: 和水滴蛇对上眼神的时候，最好保持礼貌并尝试解答它们留下的难题，如果拒绝回答或敷衍，往往会招来恶作剧，让你在不知不觉中迷路或错过冒险的宝藏。
entries.en: It is better to be polite and try to answer the difficulties they leave behind when they look at them, and if you refuse to answer them or play with them, it often attracts pranks that cause you to lose your way or miss the treasure of adventure without knowing it.

entries.zh: 水滴蛇的果实 来源：完成洛克里安魔法手册第一章必修课获得
entries.en: Waterdrop Snake fruit. Source: Complete the required course in Chapter One of the Lockrian Magic Manual.

entries.zh: 应对成功后，下次行动技能能耗-5。
entries.en: After a successful response, your next skill costs 5 less energy.

entries.zh: 水蛇锁经常悄悄靠近洛克，没有半点声响。它们不以贪婪著称，也不说谎。它们的目的是汲取你的知识。试试用最珍贵的知识与它交换，或许就能平安离开。
entries.en: The chains of water snakes often approach Locke quietly, without a sound. They are neither known for greed nor lie. Their purpose is to extract your knowledge. Try to exchange the most precious knowledge with it and perhaps leave safely.

entries.zh: 真理的引路人，传闻它们最初的使命早已失败，但仍在守望，守望古老预言的验证，或是等待一段新的契约。它们拥有修长柔软的尾巴，据说尾巴尖端可以打开远古的知识之门。“真理从不主动现身——你愿意推开这扇门吗？”
entries.en: Truth guides, who have been told that their original mission has long since failed, are still watching over the confirmation of ancient predictions or waiting for a new contract. They have a soft and long tail, which is said to open the doors of ancient knowledge. “The truth never comes forward — will you push this door?”

entries.zh: 第一、绝对不放过任何争执！第二、绝对不能因为睡过头晚到现场！第三、绝对要公正裁判！第四、绝对要在被双方驱逐之前做出判决。——《公平鸽的守则》
entries.en: First, you must never leave any dispute behind. Second, you must not go to the scene because you sleep too late. Third, you must judge justly. Fourth, you must decide before being expelled from your country.

entries.zh: 公平鸽的果实 来源：完成公平鸽的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Fairness Dove fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Fairness Dove.

entries.zh: 入场时，复制敌方的 增益 。在场时，若敌方获得 增益 自己也会获得。
entries.en: On entry, copy the opponent's buffs. While on the field, also gain any buffs the opponent gains.

entries.zh: 胆量极小的精灵，曾因极少被观测记录，被王国记录为已灭绝的物种。翼膜上的眼状图案可以吓退大多数天敌，遇到敌人会张开双臂一动不动地站着，一直到对方离开或者自己昏厥。
entries.en: Smurfs, who have been recorded as extinct by the kingdom because they are rarely observed. The eye pattern on their wings can deter most natural enemies and face them with open arms until the enemy leaves or faints himself.

entries.zh: 小怂猫的果实 来源：完成怒目怂猫的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Timid Cat fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Glaring Timid Cat.

entries.zh: 打断 敌方时，自己获得双攻+30%，被 打断 的技能进入2回合冷却。
entries.en: When you interrupt the opponent, gain +30% to both attack stats. The interrupted skill enters a 2-turn cooldown.

entries.zh: 胸脯处长着结构独特的气囊，能够迅速膨起至数倍大，形状像是血盆大口，可以吓退敌人。想回到正常姿势需要排出胸脯中的气体，排气的时候会发出非常可爱的声音，一般会在没有其他生物看到的时候偷偷排气。
entries.en: The chest chief, in a uniquely structured airbag, can quickly expand to several times the size of a bloodpot and act as a deterrent to the enemy. To return to normal positions, it takes gas out of the chest, makes a very cute sound when ventilating, usually sneaking off when no other creature sees it.

entries.zh: 只能勉强顶破头部的壳，剩余的蛋壳会陪伴小狮鹫度过幼年时期，能够保护尚且脆弱的羽毛。流线型的蛋壳构造还能减小风阻，丝毫不会影响行动。
entries.en: The rest of the egg shells will accompany the young lions during their early years and protect their fragile feathers.

entries.zh: 小狮鹫的果实 来源：完成皇家狮鹫的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Griffin fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Royal Griffin.

entries.zh: 使用翼系技能后，获得 连击数 +1。
entries.en: After using a Wing-type skill, gain +1 hit.

entries.zh: 只能勉强顶破头部的壳，剩余的蛋壳会陪伴小狮鹫度过幼年时期，能够抵御高山的严寒。皮肤表面覆盖嫩黄的绒毛，有保温发热的作用。
entries.en: The shell can barely reach its head, and the rest of it will accompany the young lions through their early years and be able to withstand the harshness of the mountains. The skin is covered with yellow hair and warmth.

entries.zh: 神圣狮鹫（崖间地的样子）
悬崖间的风往往更加凶猛，崖间的狮鹫家族在这里锻炼出能抵抗风阻的飞行能力，身上的羽毛多为修长的硬羽而较少绒毛，在乱流里也稳住身形并快速调整航向。
entries.en: The winds between the cliffs are often more ferocious, where the family of lions from the cliffs develop their ability to fly in resistance to the wind. Their feathers tend to be long, hard and less velvet. They also stabilize themselves and adjust quickly in the course of the turbulence.

entries.zh: 神圣狮鹫（高山地的样子）
高山地的环境更加寒冷，高山的狮鹫家族在这里演化出能抵抗寒冷的身体结构，身上的羽毛除了用于飞行的硬羽之外，还有大量绒毛，这种绒毛疏水抗风极其厚实，小洛克使劲吹都吹不开。
entries.en: The high mountain environment is even colder, where the high mountain family of lions evolves into a body that is resistant to the cold. In addition to the hard feathers used for flight, there are a lot of fur on their bodies, which is so thick that little Locke can't breathe.

entries.zh: 皇家狮鹫（崖间地的样子）
为了适应强风阻演化出了流线型的面部长羽，微微压住瞳孔是为了在崖间穿梭时更好地视物。尾羽更加修长，能够有效引导风的流动方向，让飞行更加省力和稳定。
entries.en: In order to adapt to wind-retarded face plumes that have evolved, microtensions on pupils are designed to improve the visualization of the journey between cliffs. The tail plumes are longer and can effectively guide the direction of the wind, making flight more efficient and stable.

entries.zh: 皇家狮鹫（高山地的样子）
为了保证寒冷环境下头部温暖，头顶布满柔软的绒毛，偶尔依偎在一起取暖的时候，用喙梳理同伴的头毛，有一种猜测是为了取暖所以才会把喙伸进同伴的头毛里。
entries.en: In order to keep the head warm in a cold environment, the head is covered with soft furs and, occasionally, the hair of a companion is combed with a beak, and there is speculation that the beak is put into the other partner ' s hair for heating purposes.

entries.zh: 幼体的圆眼蜘蛛并不太能织网捕食，多以青草，树果为食。复眼获取信息范围极大，速度极快，即便是独眼，圆眼蜘蛛获取信息速度远超过洛克族100倍。
entries.en: Cyclops are not very effective in netting and feeding, mostly with green grass and fruit. The access to information is vast and fast, even one-eyed, and the access to information is 100 times faster than that of the Lockers.

entries.zh: 圆眼蜘蛛的果实 来源：完成芋香巨角蛛的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Round-Eyed Spider fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Taro-Scented Giant-Horn Spider.

entries.zh: 使用能耗小于等于1的技能时，敌方获得4层 中毒 。
entries.en: When using a skill costing 1 energy or less, inflict 4 stacks of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 各关节都覆盖着绒毛，绒毛可以疏水和保暖。在湿滑的雨天也可以自由行走，世界的动态在它们眼里显得很慢，所以大部份尖角蜘蛛都是急性子。
entries.en: The knots are covered with fur, which can water and keep warm. It's also free to walk in wet rain, the world seems slow in their eyes, so most pointy spiders are acute.

entries.zh: 颜色鲜艳美丽，尾部丝囊中的液体有剧毒，织出的蜘蛛网散发异香。依靠体毒和利刺能轻易捕获猎物，从不群居，个体之间都保持一定距离，互不侵犯。
entries.en: The colors are beautiful, the fluids in the tail silk capsules are highly toxic, and the woven spider webs smell so much that they can easily catch their prey on body poisons and sharp thorns.

entries.zh: 经常频繁抖动身体，推测是缓解外壳生长带来的不适感。它们常集体排成一列迎向海浪，借助外壳的结构消解冲击。浪头拍来时会张口吸入送上门的食物，连很硬的东西也能消化。
entries.en: Often, the bodies shake frequently, presumably to mitigate the discomfort caused by the growth of the shell. They line up in one row for the waves, using the structure of the shell to absorb the impact. Waves are taken at a time when they breathe food into the door, and even hard stuff is digested.

entries.zh: 波波螺的果实 来源：完成嗜波螺的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Bobo Snail fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Wave-Loving Snail.

entries.zh: 每携带1个水系技能进入战斗，地系技能能耗-1。
entries.en: For every 1 Water-type skill carried into battle, your Earth-type skills cost 1 less energy.

entries.zh: 经常栖息于浅水中，不太拥有应对海浪冲击的能力，它的外壳在水流长年累月的打磨中逐渐变得光滑，移动时更不易被水流与碎石卡住，能在浅水中灵活穿行。
entries.en: Often sheltered in shallow waters, with little capacity to cope with wave shocks, its crust is gradually smoothing through the milling of long years of water flow, less likely to be trapped by currents and gravel, and more flexible enough to cross shallow waters.

entries.zh: 进化后，外壳生长速度更快，更需要精心维护——它们会定期在岩石上打磨外壳。个体之间还会互相叠在一起摩擦打磨，发出“砰砰”的声响。若较长时间没有打磨，行动会明显变慢。
entries.en: After evolution, the shell grows faster and needs to be carefully maintained -- they grind over rocks on a regular basis. The individual folds and grinds together, making a "bang" sound. If it doesn't do so for a longer period of time, action is significantly slower.

entries.zh: 外壳光泽度进一步提高，热爱一切有光泽的表面，它会在礁石上打磨抛光外壳，也会主动打磨同伴，让壳面更光滑。高光滑度的外壳能减少杂质的附着，维持行动效率，也会让它们更开心。
entries.en: Shell lightness is further enhanced and loves all bright surfaces, which polish the coral reefs, as well as the skins of their peers, making them smoother. A smooth shell can reduce impurity, maintain operational efficiency, and make them happier.

entries.zh: 在海浪冲击下，演化出坚韧的矿物质石柱外壳，是一种非常稳定的消波结构，能把浪涌的力量层层化解。声音在石柱间隙中不断反射产生共鸣，能发出类似海浪的声音。
entries.en: Under the wave, a resilient fossil column shell is evolved as a very stable mode of dissipation that can defuse the power layers of the waves. Sound echoes in the gap between pillars and makes waves-like noises.

entries.zh: 常生活在恶水林地附近，光滑的表面能更有效地抵抗污染水源的侵蚀。后来有研究证实，曾经有一支波波螺家族被海浪冲到这里，就这样在原地留下来，逐渐演化成了现在的样子。
entries.en: The smooth surfaces are more effective against the erosion of contaminated water sources, often in close proximity to the forest. Research later confirmed that a wave-spircon family had been swept here by the waves, so it stayed there and evolved into what it is now.

entries.zh: “你知道吗？菇菇丁早已建立了广阔的地下王国，它们的菌丝体蔓延到整片森林，链接着许多土壤，将沾染了星星魔法碎屑的砂土和木头转化为魔法力量，循环利用，它们才是这片森林的主人！”
entries.en: “Do you know that the mushroom dins have already built a vast underground kingdom, and their filaments spread throughout the forest, linking many soil, turning sand and wood, which are soaked in the dust of the stars, into magic forces, recycling them, and they are the masters of this forest?”

entries.zh: 菇菇丁的果实 来源：完成九幽菇的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Mushroom Sprout fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Nine-Nether Mushroom.

entries.zh: 自己的能量可以超过能量上限。
entries.en: Your energy can exceed the energy cap.

entries.zh: “又有了新的发现，多菇丁埋地时，是在通过菌丝体往地下传播信号，向其他菇精灵发出指令，它们信号的语言结构和古文字非常相似，也许它们的历史远比洛克以为的要早得多。”
entries.en: “There have been new discoveries that, when buried, mushroom dings are spreading signals to the ground through mycelium, giving instructions to other mushroom elves, which signal very similar linguistic structures and ancient scripts, perhaps much earlier than Locke thought.”

entries.zh: “在古老的遗迹中发现了九幽菇的石雕，当时的洛克对九幽菇充满了崇拜，它们会在仪式上围着九幽菇唱歌，并在祭祀的指导下服用其孢子，进入幻觉，企图沟通神明，然而也存在接触它的孢子太久而神志不清的情况，等等，难道我也……”
entries.en: “The statues of the nine phantoms were found in ancient monuments, when Locke was full of worship for the nine glooms. They would sing around them at rituals, and they would take their spores under sacrifice, enter hallucinations, try to communicate with gods, but there are also cases where the spores have been touched for too long and confused, and so on.”

entries.zh: 和噜噜家族是远亲，但几乎从不联系，即使是同种族的斑斑们互相之间也并不亲近。从蛋里孵出来之后就非常独立了，经常迈着毛茸茸的小腿，挥着小小的翅膀巡视领地，十分高傲。
entries.en: The snobby family is a distant relative, but it's almost never connected to one another, even with the ethnic fragrants. It's very independent when it hatches out of the eggs, often with hairy legs and little wings on its hands.

entries.zh: 斑斑的果实 来源：完成斑枭的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Banban fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Spotted Owl.

entries.zh: 能耗小于等于1的攻击技能，无法对自己造成伤害。
entries.en: Attack skills costing 1 energy or less cannot damage you.

entries.zh: 和洛克相交甚少的种族，拥有比较强的野性和攻击性。如果在领地内看到生面孔，可能俯冲下来攻击对方，拥有出色的深度感知能力和夜视能力，即使藏在阴影处也难以逃过它的双眼。
entries.en: The races with which Locke has little interaction are more wild and aggressive. If you see a face inside the territory, you can dive down and attack each other, have excellent depth perception and night vision capabilities, and it is hard to escape its eyes even if hidden in shadows.

entries.zh: 眼睛长在两侧，不停地转动，不知道是不是在思考，很难解读它的行为规律。视觉范围有360度，从任何方向接近都会被它发现。
entries.en: The eyes are on both sides, they're constantly spinning and it's hard to read the pattern of their behavior, not knowing if they're thinking. The visual range is 360 degrees, and it'll be found in any direction.

entries.zh: 草头鸭的果实 来源：完成卷毛鸭的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Grasshead Duck fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Curly Duck.

entries.zh: 天气为 雨天 ，或处于其他水系环境中时，获得双攻+100%。
entries.en: During Rain or another Water-type environment, gain +100% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 身形与洛克近似，空洞的目光仿佛若有所思。头顶的毛发十分柔软，自然卷曲，这在鸭精灵中十分少见。
entries.en: The shape is close to Locke, and the eyes are as if they were thinking. The hair above the head is soft and curls natural, which are very rare among duck elves.

entries.zh: 圆润的身躯游得飞快，皮肤非常滑溜，十次抓捕中九次都要被它溜走。喜欢被紧挨着或被挤压着的感觉，经常成群结队地出没，迷路的时候，也会一整群一起迷路。
entries.en: The round body swims fast, the skin is very slippery, and it slips away nine times in ten arrests. It likes to be tied up or squeezed, often in groups, and when you get lost, you get lost.

entries.zh: 海豹战士的果实 来源：完成海豹船长的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Seal Warrior fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Seal Captain.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每应对1次，自己入场时水系和武系技能威力+20%。
entries.en: On entry, your Water- and Fighting-type skills gain +20% power for every 1 allied response.

entries.zh: 由聪慧且经验丰富的海豹战士进化而来，拥有极强的领地意识。这一物种对征服有极端的渴望，认为其他精灵都要臣服于它们。会指挥手下的海豹战士战斗。
entries.en: The species has an extreme desire for conquest and believes that other elves will bow to them. They will command their own seal fighters in battle.

entries.zh: 拥有中空结构的尾巴，空气和水流过的时候会发出小号一样响亮的声音。非常喜欢社交的生物，经常举办盛大的音乐会，不同的小号精灵会轮流展示自己的音乐才华，创造出令人惊叹的合奏。
entries.en: The tails with a medium-air structure sound as loud as a trumpet when the air and water pass. Very much like social beings, they often have great concerts, different little elves alternately display their musical talents and create amazing symphonies.

entries.zh: 号儿鱼的果实 来源：完成圆号鱼的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Hornfish fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for French Hornfish.

entries.zh: 使用状态技能后，敌方获得「聒噪」技能的效果，持续3回合。
entries.en: After you use a Status skill, the opponent gains the effect of Chatter for 3 turns.

entries.zh: 会专门去矿物质丰富的水域，通过吸收矿物质来调整背部结构，达到调音的目的。群居，每天早上起来一齐练声，巨大的合奏声能唤醒周围水域的所有生物，喜欢安静的精灵们不愿意住在它们旁边。
entries.en: They go to mineral-rich waters, adjust their backs by absorbing them, and they make the sound. The crowds get up every morning and practice, and the loud joints wake up all the creatures in the surrounding waters, and the quiet elves don't want to live next to them.

entries.zh: 它们进食较少，通过经常睡觉来维持体内养分的平衡。只有在海水退潮时才偶尔会出现在沙滩上，在醒着的时候才会立起来，每天大概只有五分之一的时间是醒着的。
entries.en: They eat less, maintain their nutrient balance through frequent sleep. Only occasionally they appear on the beach when seawater retreats, and they stand up when they wake, and only about a fifth of the time a day is awake.

entries.zh: 甜田螺的果实 来源：完成卡洛儿的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sweet Pond Snail fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Carol.

entries.zh: 己方其他精灵每有1层 萌化 ，自己入场时全技能能耗-1。
entries.en: On entry, reduce all skill energy costs by 1 for every 1 stack of Cutification on other allied creatures.

entries.zh: 生活在螺壳里，似乎对壳外面的世界不太关心，多数时间都躲在壳内睡觉，对食物的香味比较敏感，可以用食物引诱出来。
entries.en: Living in a shell seems to be less concerned about the world outside it, most of the time sleeping in a shell and being sensitive to the smell of food that can be lured out by food.

entries.zh: 有些呆，不论交给它们什么东西，都会用心地放进自己的壳里。如果能找到办法和它们交流的话，它可能会从螺壳里拿出意想不到的东西作为礼物。
entries.en: Some dots, whatever they give them, put it in their own shell with heart. If they find a way to communicate with them, it may bring something out of the nut as a gift.

entries.zh: “黄金时代地系部族大多无法运用魔力，但他们有着独特的智慧和精湛的技艺。地系精灵王教他们使用建造之术，地系部族用黑色矿物做出了棋子精灵，用以娱乐”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·二》
entries.en: "Most of the Golden Age Tribes can't use magic, but they have unique wisdom and skill. The King of Elves taught them to build and the Tribes made chess elfs with black minerals for entertainment."

entries.zh: 棋棋的果实 来源：完成棋骑士的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Qiqi fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Chess Knight.

entries.zh: 攻击技能应对1次后，回满能量和生命，变为棋绮后。
entries.en: After responding with an Attack skill 1 time, fully restore HP and energy, and transform into Chess Queen.

entries.zh: “从黄金时代至今，黑色棋子在月光下仍呈现乌金般幽深的纹路，它们存在本身就是黄金时代工艺的证明。传言每当乌云遮月，所有黑子便会同时转向月亮的方向，据研究可能和守夜指令有关。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·九》
entries.en: "From the golden age to the present, black chess pieces still display gold-like twilights, and their very existence is evidence of the gold age process. It has been said that every time a cloud covers a moon, all black boys turn to the moon simultaneously.

entries.zh: “棋棋的祖先们曾与地系族人相伴而生，地系部族周围多蛮兽。白天棋棋们陷入沉睡，被当作孩子的玩具，在聚落里四处滚动。夜晚则遵循着古老的指令，纷纷醒来守护着部族，替人们守夜巡逻”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·三》
entries.en: "The ancestors of chess had lived with the people of the earth, and there were beasts around the clan. Day chess went to sleep, used as a toy for children, rolling around in gatherings. At night, following old instructions, they woke up to guard the clan and patroled the people at night."

entries.zh: “在深夜，黑色棋子会跟在洛克身后排着队列，跟着移动。因此，在民间有洛克传言，深夜千万别碰黑色棋子，它们会把影子吃掉。实际上，那只是它们守护族人的本能而已。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十》
entries.en: "In the middle of the night, black chess will follow Locke's back in line and move. So there are rumours in the folk that if you don't touch black chess at night, they'll eat the shadow. In fact, it's just their instinct to protect the people." — Landmakers of the Golden Age.

entries.zh: 棋契陛下（白棋棋骑士分支）
棋盘最中央的格子是为它预留的王座，棋契陛下并非被雕刻，而是由黑白两色棋子在万夜轮转中自行对局而生，它不移动，却可以传令所有棋子。“当王棋离座，棋盘即终局；终局之时，所有棋子将回归石质，世界将再无边界可言。”
entries.en: The uppermost frame of the board is the throne reserved for it, and His Majesty's chess table was not carved, but created by a black-and-white match in the wheels. It does not move, but transmits all the pieces. “When the king leaves the throne, the board ends; at the end of the day, all the pieces will return to stone, and the world will no longer have borders.”

entries.zh: 棋契陛下大幅提升种族资质，力竭时扣除4魔力。
entries.en: Chess Majesty's base attributes increase significantly. Lose 4 Magic when exhausted.

entries.zh: 棋契陛下（黑棋棋骑士分支）
在棋盘最中央的格子是为它预留的王座，棋契陛下并非被雕刻，而是由黑白两色棋子在万夜轮转中自行“对局”而生，它不移动，却可以传令所有棋子。“当王棋离座，棋盘即终局；终局之时，所有棋子将回归石质，世界将再无边界可言。”
entries.en: In the middle of the board, which is reserved for its throne, His Majesty is not carved, but was born by a black and white chess match in the wheels of the night. It does not move, but it transmits all the pieces. “When the king leaves the table, the board ends; at the end of the day, all the pieces will return to stone, and the world will no longer have borders.”

entries.zh: “黑白棋子们有类似铠甲一样的外形，民间传闻中白银骑士团的盔甲就是模仿它们建造的，但也有另外一种说法是地系部族的族人参与了白银骑士团的盔甲制造，真实性都已不可考”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·五》
entries.en: "Black and white chess players have the same shape as armors, which were built by popular rumours, but there is also a claim that people belonging to local clans are involved in the work of the Order's armor, whose authenticity is no longer valid" - Landmaker V of the Golden Age.

entries.zh: 防御技能应对2次后，回满能量和生命，变为棋绮后。
entries.en: After responding with a Defence skill 2 times, fully restore HP and energy, and transform into Chess Queen.

entries.zh: “黑子从不主动寻找白子，但是却总会在转向的时候留下一排空位，学者推测这是黑子对换班记忆的折射，即便时代更迭，它们仍在试图完成那场和白子的交接。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十四》
entries.en: "Blacks never take the initiative of looking for white boys, but always leave a row of empty spaces when they turn around. Scholars assume that this is a reflection of Blacks' recollections of changing shifts. Even though times have changed, they are still trying to complete the interface with Whitey." — Landmakers of the Golden Age XIV.

entries.zh: 棋契陛下（白棋棋齐垒分支）
棋契陛下（黑棋棋齐垒分支）
“黄金时代过去后，棋棋开始了流浪，保护族人的遗痕行为一直在影响着它们，它们会主动寻找人文聚落，试图融入洛克的社会。也有部分出现在野外，这些野生的棋棋手感不如家养棋棋温润，干巴巴的有些粗糙”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·八》
entries.en: "Before the golden age, chess has vagrancyed, and protecting the remains of the people has been affecting them. They're willing to look for humanity and try to integrate into Locke society. There are also parts of it in the wild, where they don't feel as warm as their family's chess, and some rough as they are in the dry bar - The local craftsmen of the golden age.

entries.zh: 状态技能应对1次后，回满能量和生命，变为棋绮后。
entries.en: After responding with a Status skill 1 time, fully restore HP and energy, and transform into Chess Queen.

entries.zh: “曾经有洛克试图用黑子的外壳打造行军的铠甲，却在淬火瞬间听见棋子内部传来低沉的声音，黑暗中工匠们的影子被炉火吞噬，所有想要拆解棋子的工匠都遭遇了不幸。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十六》
entries.en: "A Roco once tried to make marching armour from a black chess piece's shell. At the instant of quenching, a low voice came from inside the piece. In the darkness, the furnace swallowed the craftspeople's shadows. Misfortune befell everyone who tried to dismantle a piece." — Earth Craftspeople of the Golden Age, Sixteen

entries.zh: 棋契陛下（白棋棋祈督分支）
棋契陛下（黑棋棋祈督分支）
“最初只有黑色棋子，后来地系工匠意外发现了光之水晶，打造了白色的棋子。黑白子交替轮班，互不相见，却共同守护地系部族。它们换班对峙时，不同棋子有各自的行走规则，逐渐发展成象棋游戏规则的雏形”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·四》
entries.en: "There were only black chess pieces, and then the local craftsmen accidentally discovered the crystal of light and built white chess pieces. Black and white boys rotated shifts, they did not see each other, but together protected the clans. When they switched classes, different chess players had their own rules of movement, which evolved to form the rules of the chess game - Landworkers of the Golden Age IV.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次武系或地系技能，自己入场时获得攻防+5%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +5% attack and defence for every 1 Fighting- or Earth-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: “黄金时代崩解后不知多久，黑子开始失眠。它们不再在日出时准点沉睡，而是继续在废土上继续巡逻。没有族人可守，它们便去围着倒塌的遗迹转圈，被认为是一种刻板行为。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十三》
entries.en: "When the golden age collapsed, the blacks began to insomnia. Instead of sleeping at sunrise, they continued to patrol the wasteland. Without people to guard, they went around the fallen monuments and were considered a rigid act."

entries.zh: 棋契陛下（白棋棋绮后分支）
棋契陛下（黑棋棋绮后分支）
毛色杂乱且粗糙，像是融合了泥土、枯叶的颜色，黑色的眼睛透露出机灵的光。它们背着自己的全部家当，在野外长期流浪，一直在路上，从未到达旅途的终点。有着健壮的身躯，但进攻意愿低，只对闪闪发光的东西兴趣浓厚。
entries.en: The furry and rough, like a combination of dirt, leaves, black eyes reveal the brightest light. They carry all their possessions, wander long in the wild, on their way, never reaching the end of the journey. They have a strong body, but they are less willing to attack, and only have a keen interest in what shines.

entries.zh: 奔波鼠的果实 来源：完成流浪鼠的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Scurrying Mouse fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Wandering Mouse.

entries.zh: 使用防御技能后，回合结束时 脱离 。
entries.en: After using a Defence skill, withdraw at the end of the turn.

entries.zh: 背后鼓鼓的行囊里是更多捡来的收藏品，闪闪发光的物体对它们有着无与伦比的吸引力。不论是亮晶晶的小石子，闪着微光的菌类，还是洛克不小心遗落的饰品。在劳累之后，它们也会静静地在波光粼粼的水面望着月亮。
entries.en: The drum bag is a collection of more picks, and the sparkling objects have an unparalleled appeal for them. Whether it's a crystallized little stone, a microlighted fungus, or an accoutrements that Locke accidentally leaves behind. After their labor, they look at the moon in silence in the water.

entries.zh: 幼年期较长，主要靠嗅闻、聆听和头上叶子的触觉来获取信息。头顶毛发会散发出爆米花的香味，偶尔引来其他精灵。它们之间用互闻头顶代表问候。
entries.en: In early childhood, information is obtained mainly by sniffing, listening to, and the tactileness of the head. The hair above your head smells like popcorn and occasionally brings in other elves.

entries.zh: 呆小路的果实 来源：完成白发路路的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Dull Lulu fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for White-Haired Lulu.

entries.zh: 获得 增益 时，额外获得层数+2。
entries.en: Whenever you gain a buff, gain 2 additional stacks.

entries.zh: 每只舞动路路都携带着一颗蛋，经常看到它们用头上的毛发擦拭蛋，那是它们最珍视的一部分。蓬松的毛发下看不到眼睛，主要靠头上的叶片来感受环境，身体非常灵活。
entries.en: Every dance road carries an egg, and they're often seen rubbing it with their head hair, which is a part of their most precious. The fluffy hair doesn't see eyes under its hair, it feels the environment mainly by the leaves on its head, and it's very flexible.

entries.zh: 白色的毛发覆盖手臂和身体，随身携带的蛋散发出爆米花的香味。能从随身携带的蛋中获得勇气和力量，暂时还不清楚是什么原理。
entries.en: The white hair covers the arm and body, and the eggs carried with them smelled like popcorn. It's not clear what it is for a while that you can get courage and strength from the eggs carried with you.

entries.zh: 体内充满轻质气体，骨骼与肌肉结构都很轻，因此可以在空中漂浮活动。它通过换气调节气体量与分布，来控制自己上浮或下沉。
entries.en: The body is filled with light gas and the bones and muscles are light enough to float in the air. It regulates the amount and distribution of gases, controlling it to float or sink.

entries.zh: 逗逗的果实 来源：完成梦想三三的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Doudou fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dream Sansan.

entries.zh: 使用能耗为3的技能时，获得双攻和双防+20%。
entries.en: When using a skill costing 3 energy, gain +20% to both attack and both defence stats.

entries.zh: 外表看起来软萌，但身体其实很结实——长期保持平衡姿态，练出了稳定身体的核心肌肉。暴风雨的时候气球猫们都会紧紧抓着树或灌木，一旦松手便很可能被风吹走。
entries.en: The surface looks soft, but the body is really strong -- keeping a balanced posture for long periods of time and producing core muscles to stabilize the body. In a storm, balloon cats hold on to trees or bushes and are likely to be blown away by the wind when they let go.

entries.zh: 咻咻咻！听到“喵呜”一声的小洛克们请立刻拿出课本做好，魔法学院开课了！请牢记以下守则：请勿在课堂上投喂助教，请勿拉扯助教的尾巴，请勿对助教发出“嘬嘬嘬”等不尊敬的声音！
entries.en: Now, when you hear the whispers of Locke, please bring out your textbooks and the School of Magic is ready! Remember the following code: "Don't feed the assistant in class, don't pull the tail of the assistant, don't make an unrecognizable sound to the assistant teacher!"

entries.zh: 负责的喵老师为了让学生好好学习，想到了一种更直接的教学管理方式：只要有学生想溜出教室探头逃课，下一秒就会被它软乎乎却弹性十足的肚皮弹回座位。
entries.en: In order for students to learn well, the teacher in charge has come up with a more direct approach to teaching management: as long as a student tries to escape from the classroom, he will be returned to his seat with a soft but flexible stomach.

entries.zh: 使用能耗为3的技能后，获得双攻和双防永久+20%。
entries.en: After using a skill costing 3 energy, permanently gain +20% to both attack and both defence stats.

entries.zh: 它们的身体具有趋触性，身躯底部会紧贴赖以生存的土地，这让它们有安全感，尤其喜欢湿润的泥土。三朵花常相互缠绕以保持接触，但也因此容易打结。当它们争执时，会发出连绵的铃声。
entries.en: Their bodies are touchy, and their bottoms are close to the land on which they live, which gives them a sense of security, especially in wet soil. The three flowers are often entangled to keep contact with each other, but it is also easy to tie them together. When they argue, there are ringing bells.

entries.zh: 花怨鳗的果实 来源：完成鳗尾兽的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Flower-Wraith Eel fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Eel-Tailed Beast.

entries.zh: 首次入场时，失去自己一半的当前生命。
entries.en: On first entry, lose half your current HP.

entries.zh: 它们的头部几乎没有视力，主要靠嘴感受气流来调整方向，偶尔会在地表横冲直撞。吼叫时会带动口中的吊钟形花朵震动，发出阵阵钟声。它们和同伴间通过这些声响，彼此交流。
entries.en: They have little vision in their heads, are reoriented mainly by the gas flow of their mouths, and occasionally hit across the surface. When they shout, they vibrate the cerebral flower in their mouths and sound the bells. Through these sounds, they interact with each other.

entries.zh: 幼年的小龙喜欢在雨天调皮捣蛋，充满水分的环境令它们十分活跃，在水里游得飞快，小洛克抓也抓不住它们。
entries.en: Young dragons like to play tricks in the rain, and water-filled environments make them very active, swim fast in the water, and little Locke can't catch them.

entries.zh: 伊雷龙的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Yilei Dragon fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 蓄力 状态下，可以使用任一携带技能。
entries.en: While Charging, you can use any carried skill.

entries.zh: 修长的尾鳍在空气中划过会留下水雾的痕迹，水雾持续存在形成云朵。观测显示，伊兰亚龙停留超过半小时的区域，降雨概率提升67%。干旱季节时，它们会主动迁往缺水的农田上空。
entries.en: The long tailings are drawn in the air, leaving traces of water fog, which continues to form clouds. It is observed that Elanyalong stays in an area of more than half an hour, with a 67% increase in rainfall probability. During the dry season, they move voluntarily over water-poor farmland.

entries.zh: 当它舒展躯体时，水流沿鳞片纹路均匀铺展，使其外形兼具威慑力与神圣感，威严而不可侵犯。“在龙系精灵的历史中起到了关键的作用，一直默默地付出，很少有人知道它的存在。”
entries.en: When it stretches its body, the water flows are evenly spread along scales and strips, so that its shape is both deterrent and sacred, with a high degree of sacrosanctness and inviolability. "It plays a key role in the history of dragon elfs, and it has been given silently, and few people know its existence."

entries.zh: 蓄力 时可以使用任一携带技能，且获得双防+100%。
entries.en: While Charging, you can use any carried skill and gain +100% to both defence stats.

entries.zh: 同伴之间经常会打架，用头或者用拳头对撞，每撞一下都会闪着电光。大多数拉特沉默寡言，但正义感十足，拉特们会出手帮助遇到麻烦的洛克和精灵。
entries.en: There's a lot of fights and punches between your peers, with their heads and their fists. Every hit is lightning. Most Rats are silent, but they have a great sense of justice. They help Locke and elves in trouble.

entries.zh: 拉特的果实 来源：完成酷拉的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Lat fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Kula.

entries.zh: 入场后首次行动，所选技能使用次数+1。
entries.en: On your first action after entry, use the selected skill 1 additional time.

entries.zh: 能利用电能量高速移动，偶尔也会发生意外事故与同类相撞，交流时会发出“噼啪噼啪”的声音。
entries.en: There are occasional accidents and collisions with the same type of person using high-speed electrical energy, which can be communicated with a “cracking” voice.

entries.zh: 常年栖息在雷暴云层内部，喜欢在高空活动，它不再需要与同伴对撞来产生电能，体内蓄积的电量足以自发形成风暴。族群遇到威胁时，它会无声地赶来，天降雷罚。
entries.en: The perennial habitat is inside the thunderstorm cloud, it likes to move at high altitude, it no longer needs to collide with its peers to generate electricity, and it accumulates enough power to create storms spontaneously. When a community is threatened, it comes silently and receives punishment.

entries.zh: 入场后首次行动，所选技能使用次数+1，且该回合每次行动后回复2能量。
entries.en: On your first action after entry, use the selected skill 1 additional time. Also restore 2 energy after each action that turn.

entries.zh: 总是一副不开心的样子，面对对手的时候会使出全力攻击，不论所处环境有多么危险，只要没电就会立刻陷入昏睡。
entries.en: It is always an unhappy look, and when faced with the opponent, it can lead to a full-scale attack, no matter how dangerous the environment may be, as long as there is no electricity, it will fall asleep immediately.

entries.zh: 闪电环的果实 来源：完成荆棘电环的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Lightning Ring fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Thorned Lightning Ring.

entries.zh: 经常三三两两聚集在一起互相充电。情绪也会随着电力在同伴之间传播，群聚在一起容易变得更不开心，靠近后能听到此起彼伏的电流杂音，偶尔还有“呜呜”的声音。
entries.en: Often, three or two come together to charge each other. As the energy spreads among peers, it becomes easier for them to gather together and become more unhappy, so that they can hear the euphemisms and sometimes “wow” voices.

entries.zh: 总是会发出意义不明的“哔哔”声，似乎使用这种声音诱敌。表情看起来更加痛苦了，仿佛电力在体内循环本身就是一种负担。
entries.en: There's always an ambiguous "beep" that seems to be used to lure enemies. The expression looks even more painful, as if electricity is a burden in itself.

entries.zh: 被当作具有自我意识的宝箱，又因为与宝箱形似，变成了象征宝箱的吉祥物精灵。有些洛克会对着小箱怪祈祷好运，甚至向它投掷洛克贝许愿。
entries.en: As a self-conscious treasure box, and because it looks like a treasure box, it becomes a mascot elf that symbolizes the treasure box. Some Locke prays for good luck to little boxers and even throws Lockerberg's wish at them.

entries.zh: 小箱怪的果实 来源：完成迷迷箱怪的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Mimic fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Bewildering Mimic.

entries.zh: 自己力竭时，敌方获得攻防+20%。
entries.en: When you become exhausted, the opponent gains +20% attack and defence.

entries.zh: 它们并不追逐也不恐吓，只是静静地埋伏，等待小洛克伸手想要开宝箱时，才会突然袭击。因此老练的魔法师们会说：“冒险不难，难的是抵达终点时敢不敢伸手。”
entries.en: They don't chase or intimidate, they just ambush and wait until Little Locke reaches out to open a treasure box. So seasoned magicians say, "It's not hard to risk, it's hard to reach the end."

entries.zh: 通常低伏身体，隐藏在草丛中，只露出尾巴发出咚咚咚的轻响，吸引好奇的精灵过来。其尾部的结构可以在摇晃时发出咚咚的鼓声，据说玄玉岛的洛克以此为灵感，制作出了某种广受欢迎的玩具。
entries.en: Usually, the body is low and hidden in the grass, with its tail blowing lightly, attracting curious elves. The structure of its tail can sway with a banging drum, which is said to have inspired Locke on the island of Hyunyu to produce some popular toy.

entries.zh: 古钟蛇的果实 来源：完成寒音蛇的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Ancient Bell Snake fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Frostsong Snake.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次状态技能，自己入场时毒系和萌系技能威力+10。
entries.en: On entry, your Poison- and Cute-type skills gain +10 power for every 1 Status skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 拥有能分泌毒液的特殊腺体，能够通过背部空心管状的骨棘发射毒液，致使猎物晕厥。毒液会散发出腐臭的气味，有精灵或洛克靠近查看味道来源时，会猛然跃起扑击。
entries.en: The adrenaline with a special gland capable of secreting the venom, which can be ejected through an empty tube-shaped bone thorn in the back, causes the prey to faint. The venom produces a stinking smell, and when there are elves or Locke close to the source of the taste, it jumps.

entries.zh: 足较短，翻倒后很难再顺利站起来。野外发现的矮脚爬爬里面十个有八个正在努力翻身。因为可爱的外表而受到许多小洛克的喜爱，但受惊时会咬人，致使王国只能贴出告示，警告大家不要轻易触碰。
entries.en: Short enough, it's hard to get up when you flip. Eight out of ten of the short feet found in the field are trying to turn around. Little Locke loves them because of his cute appearance, but bites when she gets scared, so the kingdom can only post a sign warning not to touch easily.

entries.zh: 矮脚爬爬的果实 来源：完成恶魔红钻的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Short-Legged Crawler fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Demon Red Diamond.

entries.zh: 主动击败敌方后，己方队伍获得5次随机 奉献 。
entries.en: After you actively defeat an opponent, your team gains 5 random Offerings.

entries.zh: 喜欢在洞穴的暗处歇息，会提前布好精细且带有剧毒的网守株待兔。步足末端布满危险的剧毒，尖锐而坚硬的触足既能用作进攻的矛，也能用作防御的盾。
entries.en: Like to rest in the dark of a cave, a fine and highly toxic net is prepared for rabbits in advance. The end of a foot is full of dangerous poison, with sharp and hard feet that can be used both as a spear to attack and as a shield for defence.

entries.zh: 全身被毛又干燥又粗糙，容易产生静电现象，甚至偶尔冒出火星。它的利爪有可能是打火石，连续抓挠树木的话可能会将树木点燃。
entries.en: The body is hairy, dry and rough, prone to electrostatic phenomena, and occasionally comes out of Mars. Its claws can be flint stones, and if it scratches trees on a continuous basis, they may ignite them.

entries.zh: 火尾瓦特的果实 来源：完成烈火守护的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Firetail Watt fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Blazing Guardian.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次火系技能，自己入场时获得全技能威力+10。
entries.en: On entry, all your skills gain +10 power for every 1 Fire-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 经常看到它在磨爪子，磨得发烫了才会停下。在战斗前会加热自己的身体以提升力量，有时甚至会让整个头顶的毛发燃烧起来。
entries.en: It's always grinding its claws, and it's getting hot before it stops. It heats up its body to boost its strength before fighting and sometimes burns the hair on top of its head.

entries.zh: 在草原上全速奔跑的时候时常引发火灾。毛发蓬松且疏水，毛发内部均能发现未燃尽的火星。被驯服后性情极其温顺。
entries.en: Fires often occur while running at full speed on the prairie. The hair is loose and drained, and unburned Mars can be found inside the hair.

entries.zh: 烈焰狂战士的毛发深处藏着一整片没烧完的火星，它受伤的那一刻，那些火星就一齐点着，越烧越猛，别的火系精灵在它身边战斗时，它体内的火星也会跟着一同点起来。就算被驯服后也不会变得温顺。
entries.en: In the depths of the furry hair of the Flamingo warrior there is an entire unburned Mars, and the moment it gets hurt, those sparks are lit together, and the more they burn, the more powerful the other fire spirits fight next to it, the Mars within them will come up with it. Even if they are tamed, they won't become gentle.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次火系技能，自己入场时获得全技能威力+10和物防+5%
entries.en: On entry, gain +10 power for all skills and +5% physical defence for every 1 Fire-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 里拉鳐的体表能够分泌并牵连出细长的粘液，这些粘液对水流变化极其敏感，能帮助它判断水流方向。游动时，水流掠过粘液弦会引发持续振动，发出琴音。一般认为雄性的气孔粘液更少，形成的琴弦更细，因此琴声更清脆明亮。
entries.en: Lila's surface is capable of disciplining and condensing a thin slime, which is extremely sensitive to current changes and helps it to determine the direction of the flow. During a swim, water flows over a viscous string generate sustained vibrations and sound. It is generally thought that male air-pole viscoses are fewer and more thinly formed, thus making the piano sound even clearer.

entries.zh: 里拉鳐的果实 来源：完成里拉鳐的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Lyra Ray fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Lyra Ray.

entries.zh: 赋予的 印记 不会替换其他 印记 ，而是同时生效。
entries.en: Marks you apply do not replace other Marks; they take effect together.

entries.zh: 以海水中的微小生物为食，捕食时会发出“啵啵”声，身体分泌出美丽的树枝状骨骼，呈现美丽的苍青色。喜欢用不同颜色的海藻打扮自己，代谢时能给海藻提供养分，彼此互利共生。
entries.en: Eating from the tiny creatures in the sea, when they eat, they make a sound of cynicism, and their bodies produce beautiful branches of skeletal bones with beautiful pale blue colours. They like to dress themselves with algals of different colours, and when they are metabolized, they provide nutrients for each other's mutual benefit.

entries.zh: 海枝枝的果实 来源：完成海枝枝的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sea Twig fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sea Twig.

entries.zh: 敌方精灵 离场 时，自己获得全技能能耗-3。
entries.en: When an opposing creature leaves the field, reduce all your skill energy costs by 3.

entries.zh: 喜欢用金黄褐色的共生藻打扮自己，是海枝枝界的珠宝设计师，尖端的胶质花朵被称为百合玉，脱落时会被洛克捡走做成耳坠，据说戴着能听见水流的回声，会用闪亮的花朵吸引豆丁鱼当保镖。
entries.en: He prefers to dress himself with a golden, brown symbiotic, a jewel designer in the branch area of the sea, and is known as lily at the cutting edge of the glue flower, which will be picked up by Locke as an earwreck when it falls, allegedly wearing an echo that can hear water flow, and will use bright flowers to attract soybean fish as bodyguards.

entries.zh: 生活在没有共生藻的深水区，自身分泌出了美丽的洋红色骨骼，其艳丽的颜色吸引了更多的敌人，因此长出了更有攻击性的红色珊瑚触手分叉，上面的有毒刺胞能割伤入侵的生物，它们会悄悄收集闪亮的碎片，用来装点自己的尾端。
entries.en: Living in deep-water areas without symbiotic algal, they produce beautiful red bones, and their colour attracts more enemies, resulting in more offensive red coral tentacles that cut invasive organisms with toxic prickling cells on them, which will quietly collect bright fragments to fill their tails.

entries.zh: 喜欢用绿色的共生藻打扮自己，光合色素和粘液让珊瑚枝呈现百变的造型。它对光照与水质非常敏感，需要在浅水、光线充足的地方晒足日光浴，获得维持活力所需的能量，否则，可能会凋谢成灰白色。
entries.en: It's very sensitive to light and water quality, it needs to be sunbathed in shallow waters with plenty of light to acquire the energy needed to sustain its vitality, otherwise it may fade into gray white.

entries.zh: 可以通过磁性来悬浮在空中，对影响磁场稳定的东西异常敏感，偶尔会因为磁力吸来一些莫名其妙的小零件。可以通过操纵磁力来造成巨大的破坏，常是电力故障的罪魁祸首。
entries.en: It can be suspended in the air by magnetism, extremely sensitive to things that affect the stability of the magnetic field, and occasionally it takes off some of the strange little parts. It can cause enormous damage by manipulating magnetic power, often the main cause of electrical failure.

entries.zh: 多西的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Duoxi fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用1次防御技能，自己入场时机械系和地系技能威力+10%。
entries.en: On entry, your Mechanical- and Earth-type skills gain +10% power for every 1 Defence skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 兼具岩石的稳固与钢铁的坚韧，身上带有厚重的泥土气味，推测是因为习惯在地底休眠所致。能够利用磁场的力量发动攻击，但也会在特殊磁场的影响下动弹不得，因此总是在人烟稀少的地方栖息。
entries.en: The solidness of rock and steel, with a heavy soil smell, is presumably due to the habit of subterranean hibernation. It can use magnetic field power to launch an attack, but it can also operate under the influence of special magnetic fields, so it always lives in sparsely populated areas.

entries.zh: 能将钢铁之力积蓄于双爪中，使出蓄力重击，威力十足。以地底的粗矿为食，精炼过的钢铁对它而言似乎有着不同寻常的风味。在它出没的地方，常有铁锅失窃。
entries.en: It can accumulate steel into its claws, with a full force of resilience and power. The fine steel, which feeds on the ground's rough mines, seems unusual for it. Where it comes out, iron pots are often stolen.

entries.zh: 身形圆润可爱，翼膜十分柔软，只能在陆地上漂浮。植食性，最爱啃蕨类与低矮灌木，进食的时候总是呛到，猜测是因为呼吸系统还没有发育完全，需要用嘴巴呼吸。
entries.en: It's cute in shape, it's so soft, it floats on land. It's edible, it's edible, and it's short shrubs. It's always choked when you eat because the breathing system is not yet fully developed and needs to breathe through your mouth.

entries.zh: 小翼龙的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Little Pterosaur fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 携带的龙系技能获得 迅捷 。
拥有庞大的身躯，肚子总是鼓鼓的，充满发酵的食物。它有力的双翼和坚韧的躯体仿佛为长途飞行而生，在疾飞时仍能自由呼吸。
entries.en: He has a large body, full of drums and fermented food. His strong wings and tenacious bodies are as if they were born to fly long distances and breathe freely while flying.

entries.zh: 平时几乎不带电，通过尾巴放电，贸然摸尾巴可能会被电晕。听到节拍时，它体表的细微电感会跟着节奏一跳一跳，像在悄悄打拍子。
entries.en: When you hear the beats, it's a little electrocuted. It's like a twirl.

entries.zh: 电动长颈鹿的果实 来源：完成爵士鹿的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Electric Giraffe fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Jazz Deer.

entries.zh: 每入场1次，永久获得双攻+30%。
entries.en: For every 1 entry, permanently gain +30% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 非常喜欢被抚摸，但要避开头、脚和尾巴。夜间视力很差，通常会睡眠；若必须夜间行动，会消耗能量点亮头顶电球照明，而电球的明暗也会随听见的节拍起伏。
entries.en: Very fond of being touched, but avoid the head, feet and tails. Bad eyesight at night usually sleeps; if you have to move at night, it consumes energy to light up your head on a ball, and the dark side of the ball goes up and down with what you hear.

entries.zh: 即使在野外遇到也不会贸然攻击，目光对视时会礼貌鞠躬。它能更精细地调整头顶电球的电流强度：既可用于攻击与照明，也可配合节奏稳定输出，进行电疗治疗伤病。
entries.en: Even in the wild, they don't attack. They bow politely when looking at each other. It can finely adjust the current strength of the head-top ball: it can be used for both assault and lighting and to stabilize the output with a rhythm to treat injuries and injuries.

entries.zh: 每当它听见动感的旋律，体内电流便会随着节奏起伏变化，头顶电球忽闪忽闪照亮回家的路。波普鹿用尾巴打出轻缓的节拍，是它在表达愉快的心情。
entries.en: Every time it hears a rhythm of motion, the internal current changes with the rhythm, and the head ball flashes and shines on its way home. Populaire beats a slow beat with his tail. It's a happy mood.

entries.zh: 每入场1次，获得双攻永久+40%。
entries.en: For every 1 entry, permanently gain +40% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 总是扫描寻找着什么，明明对洛克抱有极大的好奇，但是因为其机器守则限制，只能和洛克保持在一个不远不近的距离。“既可靠又实用，深得洛克们青睐，是您寻物时的不二之选。”
entries.en: It's always scanning for something, and it's very curious about Locke, but because of its machine code restrictions, it keeps Locke at a close distance. "It's reliable and practical, it's the Locke's favorite, it's your choice to find things."

entries.zh: 缇塔的果实 来源：完成声波缇塔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Tita fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sonic Tita.

entries.zh: 1号和2号位技能获得 传动 1和威力+30。
entries.en: Skills in slots 1 and 2 gain Transmission 1 and +30 power.

entries.zh: 长长的机械触手可以更方便地抓取物品，遵守着古老的机器守则，然而其需要寻找的物品，似乎早已消逝在历史中。 “更加强大的功能，见到机械，它们会毫不留情的抓过来。见到洛克，也会毫不留情地抓过来。”
entries.en: Long machine hands can take things more easily and follow ancient machine codes, but what they need to look for seems to be long gone in history. “More powerful functions, when you see machines, they come without mercy. When you see Locke, you pick them up.”

entries.zh: 小鹬有着灰白色的羽毛，孱弱的双翼还无法驾驭风的力量，但可以依靠尚为柔软的皮甲结构进行短暂的滑翔。虽然幼小却已经懂得在划过水面时溅起水花，吸引鱼虾露头，有时能收获比自己体型还大的战利品。
entries.en: With grey and white feathers, weak wings are unable to manage the power of the wind, but they can be glide for a short period of time by relying on soft leather structures. Although small, they have learned to splatter over water, attracting fish shrimp to their heads, sometimes reaping more prizes than their own size.

entries.zh: 小鹬的果实 来源：完成高脚鹬的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Sandpiper fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Long-Legged Sandpiper.

entries.zh: 本场战斗首次使用的技能获得 迅捷 。
entries.en: The first skill you use in this battle gains Swift.

entries.zh: 栖息在水边的浅滩，橘色的长脚使得它们非常适合涉水行走，喜欢捕食昆虫和甲壳类动物，其眼神如同寒星般锐利冷峻，会左右轻轻扇动翅膀，溅起阵阵涟漪，模仿弱小生物游动，吸引鱼类前来。
entries.en: On shallow beaches at the edge of the water, with long orange feet, they are well suited to walk in the water and like to hunt insects and crustaceans. Their eyes are as sharp as the cold stars. They swipe their wings lightly on the left and right, spilling their flaps, imitating the motion of a weak creature and attracting fish.

entries.zh: 拥有较大的脑容量，是运筹帷幄的猎手，坚硬的帽形结构有良好的散热性，会用巨大的头部和双翅在水面上围出一片阴影，以此吸引喜欢在阴凉处生活的水生生物，静待着来乘凉的鱼虾进入它的捕猎范围。
entries.en: With a large brain capacity, hunters who carry strangulation, hard caps with good heat evaporation and a shadow over the water with huge heads and wings, attract aquatic creatures who like to live in the shade and wait quietly to ride cold shrimp into its hunt.

entries.zh: 头顶的帽形骨冠比普通个体更高更大，能覆盖更大的水面区域。族群捕猎时常由首领负责制造阴影，其他成员则在阴影边缘等候，乘凉的鱼虾往往还没反应过来，就已经落入了包围圈。
entries.en: The capdone on the head is bigger and larger than the average individual, covering a larger area of water. Ethnic hunters are often led by chiefs to create shadows, while others wait at the edge of the shadow, and cold shrimps often fall into an encirclement when they do not react.

entries.zh: 本场战斗首次使用的技能获得迅捷。拥有迅捷效果的技能先手+1。
entries.en: The first skill you use in this battle gains Swift. Skills with Swift gain +1 priority.

entries.zh: 使用淡奶油、蛋黄搅拌加热后，冷冻1000小时以上，有极小概率得到一只香草甜甜。以蛋筒底为支点蹦跶着前行，受到惊吓时会缩到自己的蛋筒里瑟瑟发抖。
entries.en: Mix and heat whipping cream with egg yolk, then freeze for more than 1000 hours: there is a tiny chance of obtaining a Sweet Vanilla. It hops along on the tip of its cone. When frightened, it retreats into the cone and trembles.

entries.zh: 脆筒甜甜的果实 来源：完成圣代甜甜的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Sweet Cone fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Sweet Sundae.

entries.zh: 使敌方获得 冻结 时，也会使其获得2层 冻结 。
entries.en: Whenever you inflict Freeze on the opponent, also inflict 2 additional stacks of Freeze.

entries.zh: 香草甜甜一族口感各有不同，头上顶着的果果是身体的一部分，拥有360度的视野。因果果吸收不同能量而演化出不同口感分支，身体散发着浓郁的奶香。
entries.en: Vanilla's sweet taste is different: the fruit on your head is part of the body and has a 360-degree view. The fruit absorbs different energy sources and evolves different parts of the mouth, with strong milk in the body.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（樱桃巧克力口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。
entries.en: When Sundae was born, two ice cream balls were born with each other and two ice cream balls had different tastes but were able to get along.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（樱桃草莓口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，樱桃和草莓的香气能减缓洛克的情绪波动，降低魔法失控风险。
entries.en: Solidarity, who likes to live in a colony, was born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different tastes but are able to get along. The smell of cherry and strawberries is said to slow Locke’s mood and reduce the risk of magic spiraling out of control.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（樱桃抹茶口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，抹茶和樱桃的香气能提升洛克的专注力，适合复习的时候辅助洛克。
entries.en: Solidarity, who likes to live in a colony, is born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different tastes but are able to get along. The smell of tea and cherries is said to enhance Locke’s concentration and help Locke when it comes to refreshing.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（蓝莓巧克力口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，蓝莓和巧克力的香气能让洛克快速恢复体力。
entries.en: Solidarity, who likes to live in a colony, was born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different tastes but are able to get along. The smell of blueberries and chocolate is said to allow Locke to recover quickly.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（蓝莓草莓口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，蓝莓和草莓的香气能增强洛克对环境变化的适应力。
entries.en: Convergence, who likes to live in a colony, was born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different tastes but are able to get along. The fragrance of blueberries and strawberries is said to enhance Locke’s resilience to environmental change.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（蓝莓抹茶口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，蓝莓和抹茶的香气能让洛克保持平和状态。
entries.en: When Sundae's sweet was born, two ice cream balls were born, coupled with two ice cream balls that had different tastes but were able to get along. The smell of blueberries and tea is said to keep Locke at peace.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（杨桃巧克力口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，杨桃和巧克力的香气能防止过度兴奋，清爽又提神。
entries.en: Solidarity, who likes to live in a colony, was born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different taste styles but are able to get along. The scent of peaches and chocolate is said to prevent excessive excitement, freshness, and refreshment.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（杨桃草莓口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，杨桃和草莓的香气能让洛克暂时忘记烦恼。
entries.en: Solidarity, who likes to live in a colony, was born with two ice cream balls, coupled with two ice cream balls that have different tastes but are able to get along. The fragrance of peaches and strawberries is said to make Locke forget his worries for a while.

entries.zh: 圣代甜甜（杨桃抹茶口味）
喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。据说，杨桃和抹茶的香气能调节过度用脑的后遗症。
entries.en: When Sundae was born, two ice cream balls were born, coupled with two ice cream balls that had different tastes but were able to get along. The scent of peaches and tea is said to regulate the after-effects of overuse.

entries.zh: 这种形态的刺轮砣皮肤虽然柔软脆弱，但是已经蕴含着强烈的毒系魔法，即使没有足够强壮的身体，也有办法保护自己。
entries.en: Although soft and fragile, the skin of this form of thugs already contains a strong system of poison magic that protects itself even if it does not have a strong body.

entries.zh: 刺轮砣的果实 来源：完成月亮砣的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Spiked Wheel fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Moon Wheel.

entries.zh: 敌方受到 中毒效果 伤害时，自己回复等量生命。
entries.en: When Poison effects damage the opponent, restore an equal amount of HP.

entries.zh: 皮肤柔软脆弱还有轻微黏性，表面有纤细的棘刺，一定程度上能够提供保护作用，小小的刺轮砣还没有足够的勇气和战斗力，只能依靠这些小刺来保护自己。
entries.en: Skins are soft and fragile and slightly viscous, with thin thorns on their surface that provide protection to a certain extent. Small puncture wheels do not have enough courage and combat power to rely on them to protect themselves.

entries.zh: 皮肤比矿石还要坚硬，经常在有太阳的时候里浮在水面上，晒过太阳之后皮肤表面能够分泌出一种蕴含毒系魔法的物质，但对某些精灵有治愈作用，大约是一种以毒攻毒的手段。
entries.en: Skins are stronger than ores, often floating on the surface of the water when there is a sun, after which the skin surface can distill a toxic system magic, but cures certain elves by some means.

entries.zh: 经常在有太阳的时候里浮在水面上，晒过太阳之后皮肤表面能够分泌出一种充满芳香味道的物质，有促进伤口愈合的作用。生命力十分顽强，即使受了严重的外伤也能迅速愈合。
entries.en: Often, when there is a sun, the surface of the skin is able to emit a substance full of fragrance, which promotes healing. Life is tenacious, and even with severe trauma it heals quickly.

entries.zh: 白色的鳞片柔软而有韧性，平时安静地浮在水面上，满月的那夜它会出来加班，皮肤表面分泌出银色的物质，附近带伤的精灵会悄悄游近，天亮之前伤都好了大半。
entries.en: The white scales are soft and resilient, they usually float quietly over the water, they work overtime on the full moon night, their skin surfaces distill the silvery material, and the nearby smurfs will swim in close proximity, and most of the injuries will be well before dawn.

entries.zh: 敌方受到中毒效果伤害时，自己回复等量生命。每过量回复10%生命敌方获得1层中毒。
entries.en: When Poison effects damage the opponent, restore an equal amount of HP. For every 10% HP of excess healing, inflict 1 stack of Poison on the opponent.

entries.zh: 总是抿着嘴巴气鼓鼓的样子，实际上不是因为生气了，而是在努力练习游泳，传说它们一族有着龙的血脉，只要努力游泳就可以进化为龙，基于精灵遗传学理论推测是龙系混血的精灵。
entries.en: It's not because you're angry, but because you're trying to practice swimming. It's a legend that they have dragon blood. They can evolve into dragons if you try to swim.

entries.zh: 豆丁鱼的果实 来源：完成龙鱼的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Beanling Fish fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dragonfish.

entries.zh: 每次进入 蓄力 状态，获得全技能能耗永久-2。
entries.en: Each time you enter Charging state, permanently reduce all skill energy costs by 2.

entries.zh: 额部鼓起突出，中空有气囊，可以自由改变前额的形状，推测可能是借着移动内部空气来产生形状上的变化，潜水能力相当强，甚至可以一边在水下灵活旋转一边发出多变的叫声，呼唤着同伴，吟唱着记忆深处关于化龙的古老歌谣。
entries.en: The upper part of the head is striking and there are airbags in the middle that can freely change the shape of the forehead, presumably using moving internal air to produce a change in shape, with considerable diving capacity, even with the ability to squeezing loudly at the same time as it rotates flexibly under water, calling on its companions and singing ancient songs about dragons deep in memory.

entries.zh: 长鳍长尾，身形纤细流畅，拥有强大的游泳能力和跳跃能力，身体的结构比起鱼更接近龙，证明其拥有少量龙系血脉，尾部的红珠中蕴含着些许龙系能量，可以在跃出水面时发出真正的龙吼。
entries.en: The long fins have long tails, twirls, strong swimming power and jump capacity, the body structure is closer to dragons than the fish, proving that it has a small number of bloodlines and that its red beads contain some kind of raw energy, which can give rise to a real roar when they leap out of water.

entries.zh: 以强力放电而闻名的精灵，种族中的鳗鱼们似乎对自己的知名度一无所知。常常畏首畏尾，即使是十分弱小的对手，也能令它们战战兢兢。曾有胆小鳗鱼假死晕倒在浅滩上，原因是一只爬爬路过。
entries.en: The elves of the race, known for their powerful discharges, seem to know nothing about their reputation. They can be wary when they fear their tails, even if they are very weak rivals. There were timid eels who fainted on a shallow beach, because one crawled through them.

entries.zh: 胆小鳗鱼的果实 来源：完成闪电鳗鱼的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Timid Eel fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Lightning Eel.

entries.zh: 携带的电系技能获得 迸发 ：能耗-2。
entries.en: Carried Electric-type skills gain Burst: energy cost -2.

entries.zh: 不会被自己或同类电到，那是因为电鳗体内的脂肪组织有很好的绝缘作用。几乎全身的肌肉组织都能放电，其生物电能与闪电产生强烈共鸣，某些个体能够定向引雷。身体所能承受的电能最高可达8600000伏。
entries.en: Its fatty tissue provides excellent insulation, preventing it from shocking itself or its own kind. Almost all its muscle tissue can discharge electricity. Its bioelectricity resonates strongly with lightning, and some individuals can direct lightning strikes. Its body can withstand up to 8600000 volts.

entries.zh: 柔软的精灵，通过收缩身体喷水在水中前进。会使用触手释放毒素，以此麻痹对手，然后将其拖入水中。
entries.en: Soft elves, they go in the water by shrugging their bodies. They use tentacles to release toxins, so that they paralyse their opponents and then drag them into the water.

entries.zh: 翡翠水母的果实 来源：完成琉璃水母的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Jade Jellyfish fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Glazed Jellyfish.

entries.zh: 使用水系技能后，敌方获得 中毒 ，获得层数等于 中毒印记 层数的2倍。
entries.en: After using a Water-type skill, inflict Poison equal to 2 times the opponent's Poison Mark stacks.

entries.zh: 身体的触手花纹会随心情变化，游动时非常漂亮。是海边生活的洛克的艺术灵感来源。然而它长长的触手可以释放多种效果的攻击，被它的美丽吸引注意时，可能会陷入危险哦。
entries.en: The body's tentacles change its mood and are very beautiful when it moves. It's a source of artistic inspiration for Locke living on the beach. But its long tentacles can release multiple effects, and it can be dangerous when its beauty attracts attention.

entries.zh: 胸口的星星状器官暖烘烘的，天冷的时候裘洛们都会把前爪揣在胸口取暖。曾经有洛克贸然地接触了裘洛的尾巴，皮肤变得红肿疼痛，足足半年之后才好转痊愈。
entries.en: The star-shaped organs of the chest are warm, and when it's cold, Joloes heat their front claws on their chests. Locke used to touch the tail of Joro, and his skin turns red and painful and heals for half a year.

entries.zh: 裘洛的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Qiuluo fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，敌方每2层 中毒 转化为1层 中毒印记 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, convert every 2 stacks of Poison on the opponent into 1 Poison Mark.

entries.zh: 即便在寒冷的冬天也是独来独往，从不聚在一起取暖，太冷的时候会把脚放在尾巴上。尾巴尖处有两个腺体，危险时能迅速喷射毒液，会用尾巴缠住对手，释放毒素的同时使其无法逃走。
entries.en: Even in cold winters, when they're alone and never come together to warm themselves, their feet are put on the tail when it's too cold. There are two glands at the tip of the tail that can quickly spray venom at dangerous times, entangle the opponent with a tail, release the toxin while making it impossible for him to escape.

entries.zh: 独自活动，高傲而优雅的生物。一生中只选择一只伴侣。据研究表明裘卡的体液都有剧毒，紧张时脚垫会分泌汗液，在地面上留下有剧毒的梅花形汗渍。
entries.en: Living alone, a proud and elegant creature. Only one partner has been chosen in life. Research shows that the body fluids of Joka are highly toxic, and when they are nervous, the foot pads distill the sweat from which there is a poison of clubs on the ground.

entries.zh: 头顶着活跃的微型火山，就连睡觉时也会冒出小烟圈。可别因为体型而小看了它，可爱猿头上流出的熔岩就连钢铁也能融化。
entries.en: With a lively microvolcanic head, small smoke rings emerge even when sleeping. But don't underestimate it because of its size, the molten rock that flows from the head of a lovely ape can melt even steel.

entries.zh: 可爱猿的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Cute Ape fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每放1次火系技能，回复3能量。
entries.en: Start with 0 energy. Before entering, restore 3 energy for every 1 Fire-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 会从头上喷出烟来彰显气势，普遍好斗。打喷嚏的时候，背上也会跟着喷出巨大的浓烟，还会洒出一些岩浆。
entries.en: Smokes from the head show up and are generally aggressive. When you sneeze, there's a huge smoke coming out of your back and some magma coming out.

entries.zh: 哪怕是休息的时候，也像沉睡的火山一样危险。岩浆涌动的身体需要经常添加燃料，偶尔会把吃不完的食物丢到头顶的火山口里燃尽。
entries.en: Even when we rest, it's as dangerous as a sleeping volcano. The magma needs to be fueled frequently and occasionally throws food that can't be eaten at the top of its head.

entries.zh: 头部开始晶体化，触感冰凉，能缓慢吸收周围热量，使自身温度维持在较低水平。头顶的白色绒球对温度变化很敏锐，能帮助它判断环境冷热。
entries.en: The head starts to crystallize, feels cold and slowly absorbs the heat around it, keeping itself at a lower level. White velvet balls on top of the head are sensitive to temperature changes and help it judge the environment as cold.

entries.zh: 布鲁斯的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Bruce fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 敌方携带技能总能耗每有1点，自己攻击时威力+10%。
entries.en: When attacking, gain +10% power for every 1 point of total energy cost across the opponent's carried skills.

entries.zh: 晶体化结构更稳定，修长的腕足变得更灵活，能细致地打理身体、调整伪装姿态，白色绒球对温差的感知也更敏锐。
entries.en: The crystallized structure is more stable, the long wrists are more flexible, the body can be carefully fixed and disguise adjusted, and white velvet balls are more sensitive to temperature differences.

entries.zh: 会拾取断落的枝桠，并在枝桠表面喷覆与头部成分相似的晶体化物质，使其变得坚硬冰冷，作为武器使用。
entries.en: The crystallized material that picks up the broken twigs and sprays them on the surface of the twigs similar to the head composition makes it hard and cold for use as a weapon.

entries.zh: 平时生活在灌木丛中，看到洛克的话会因为好奇而主动靠近。据说如果感冒了的小洛克摸摸它的小脚，就会很快康复。
entries.en: They usually live in the bush, and when they see Locke, they come close to him because of curiosity.

entries.zh: 治愈兔的果实 来源：完成红绒十字的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Healing Rabbit fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Red Velvet Cross.

entries.zh: 敌方受到 灼烧 伤害时，自己回复等量生命。
entries.en: When Burn damages the opponent, restore an equal amount of HP.

entries.zh: 绒毛里储存着温和的火系能量，抱在怀里就像一个小暖炉，身体散发出煎药的香味。它特别喜欢照顾受伤的精灵，会用温暖的鼻息轻轻吹拂伤口，伤口就不痛了。
entries.en: The fur stored the energy of a mild fire chain, holding it in its arms like a small warmer furnace with the scent of a frying pill. It particularly loved to look after wounded elves, blowing their wounds lightly with warm nose.

entries.zh: 头顶的十字结构能释放出强效的治愈魔法，轻轻一碰就能缓解肌肉酸痛，伤口也会加速愈合。如果看到受伤的精灵但无法施救的话会流泪不止。
entries.en: The cross structure above the head releases powerful healing magic, relieves muscle pains by touching lightly, and accelerates the healing of wounds. If you see injured elves but you cannot save them, it tears more than enough.

entries.zh: 喜欢藏在头盔里吓唬人，是因为需要吸收尖叫来维持自己的能量。实际上胆子很小，遇到危险会倒地装晕。
entries.en: It's like hiding in a helmet because you need to absorb screams to keep your energy. In fact, there's only a small amount of guts, and if you're at risk, you'll get dizzy.

entries.zh: 乌达的果实 来源：完成乌拉塔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Wuda fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Wulata.

entries.zh: 主动击败敌方精灵时，自己永久获得双攻+50%。
entries.en: When you actively defeat an opposing creature, permanently gain +50% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 尖叫声不再是它们唯一的力量来源，于是不止专注于吓唬人。笑声也会成为他们的力量来源，因此演化出了讲冷笑话的能力。
entries.en: Screams are no longer their only source of power, so it's more than just to scare people. laughter is also the source of their strength, and hence the ability to tell cold jokes.

entries.zh: 吓唬人的能力越来越强。在族群当中，越是擅长吓唬人，就越容易受到同伴的尊重，如果气势弱于对方，就要趴在地上装晕认输。
entries.en: The greater the power to scare people, the better they are among communities, the more likely they are to be respected by their peers and, if they are less aggressive than each other, they will have to lie down on the ground and give up.

entries.zh: 收集笑声的方式更加熟练，它们会把冷笑话冻成冰沙随身携带，需要的时候变为冰魔法投掷使用，是一种对冰系魔法的巧妙运用。被冷笑话击中的小洛克们明明听不懂精灵说的话，但却理解了他们的冷笑话。
entries.en: They're more sophisticated in collecting laughter, and they freeze cold jokes into ice sands, turn them into ice magic when they need to, a smart way of using ice-system magic. The little Rockers who are hit by cold jokes don't understand what the elves say, but understand their cold jokes.

entries.zh: 在对决中常常使用夸张的姿态让对手退却，体内另一股意志会让它在关键时刻保持一条底线——它并不以伤害为乐，只汲取自己必要的尖叫。尊重对手，十分有礼貌。
entries.en: Too often, an exaggeration is used to get the opponent back, and another will in the body keeps it at the bottom of a critical moment — it's not about harm, it's only about what it needs. Respecting the opponent is very polite.

entries.zh: 天冷的时候是它们最喜欢的恶作剧时刻，偷偷用冰冷的爪子塞进小洛克的脖子里。当能量满溢之后，同伴之间会互相投掷蕴含冰系魔法的冷笑话，看上去就像在打雪仗。
entries.en: When it's cold, it's their favorite prank time, sneaking cold claws into Little Locke's neck. When the energy is full, a couple of friends throw cold jokes with ice-based magic, and they look like snow wars.

entries.zh: 它们立志成为机械系精灵维修专员，曾有大批战损的机械系精灵奇迹般地恢复健康，排着队回到原来生活的地方，这背后默默付出的正是不起眼的螺旋帕帕。
entries.en: They were determined to become mechanical elf maintenance attachés, and miraculously recovered their health from a large number of war-damaged mechanical elves, who stood in line to return to the place where they lived.

entries.zh: 螺旋帕帕的果实 来源：完成帕帕斯卡的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Spiral Papa fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Papaska.

entries.zh: 1号位技能获得 迅捷 和 传动 1。
entries.en: The skill in slot 1 gains Swift and Transmission 1.

entries.zh: 在机械系精灵中非常有声望。曾经制造出帕帕斯卡的洛克许下一个愿望，希望能让机械系精灵有尊严地活着。于是帕帕斯卡整个种族一直在想办法让机械系精灵过上更体面更开心的生活。
entries.en: There is a great reputation among the mechanical elves. Lockh of Pappasca made his next wish, hoping that he would live with dignity. So the whole race of papasco has been trying to make him live a more dignified and happy life.

entries.zh: 似乎是一种非常古老的机械系造物，用处不详。身体结构精巧，拨弄它头顶的天线，会让它变得十分愉快，甚至能断断续续地播放音乐。“方方正正，顶天立地，做人亦该如此。”
entries.en: It seems to be a very old mechanical system that is not useful. The body's fine structure, the antenna above its head, makes it very happy and can even play music intermittently. And so does being human.

entries.zh: 机械方方的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Mechanical Cube fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 回合开始时，技能顺序打乱，4号位的技能能耗-4。
entries.en: At the start of the turn, shuffle skill order. The skill in slot 4 costs 4 less energy.

entries.zh: 似乎是一种非常古老的机械系造物，用处不详。热爱社交，尤其喜欢和其他种族的幼体玩耍。喜欢歌唱和舞蹈，但普遍不擅长舞蹈，容易摔倒。
entries.en: It seems to be a very old mechanical system that is of little use. Socialism, especially play with young bodies of other races. Singing and dancing, but generally not good at dance and falling down.

entries.zh: 能够听懂和使用洛克族语言，了解洛克族的礼仪和社会结构，会模仿洛克族的行为，甚至会与其他个体组建家庭。 “勤奋的它，总是不停的前行，心中在默念：每个人努力过都不普通。”
entries.en: Being able to understand and use the Locke language, understanding its rituals and social structure, imitating the behaviour of the Rocks and even forming a family with other individuals. “The hard-working thing is always going on: it's not ordinary for everyone to try.”

entries.zh: 鸡冠有特殊腺体分泌可燃气体，情绪激动时，鸡冠会熊熊燃烧。为了便于警戒，可立鸡会排成一队，由鸡冠火焰最旺盛的个体来带领。
entries.en: The chicken crown has a special gland secretion of combustible gas, and when it gets emotional it burns. In order to be alert, the rooster can be lined up and led by one of the most active individuals in the fire.

entries.zh: 可立鸡的果实 来源：完成绅士鸡的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Keli Chick fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Gentleman Chicken.

entries.zh: 应对成功后，获得全技能威力永久+30。
entries.en: After a successful response, permanently gain +30 power for all skills.

entries.zh: 成长后学会了控制情绪，维持着绅士风度，为了追求优雅和游刃有余，逐渐更能控制火焰释放。偶尔会因为忍耐过度，大脑变得晕乎乎的。
entries.en: Growing up learns to control emotions, preserves gentleman's temperament, and gradually controls fire releases in pursuit of grace and edge. Sometimes the brain becomes distraught because of patience.

entries.zh: 充满高尚气度的种群，常把一只手放在身后。手中的羽毛可以喷射火焰，制造独特而优雅的攻击。
entries.en: A population full of nobleness often puts a hand behind its back. The feathers can spray fire and create a unique and elegant attack.

entries.zh: 应对成功后，永久获得双攻+30%。
entries.en: After a successful response, permanently gain +30% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 极其发达健壮的双臂是它们的标志性特征，手部演变为锋利的钙化物质。这一分支舍弃了种族遗传下来的火焰魔法，堂堂正正地用双手和踢腿打败敌人。
entries.en: The most developed and strong arms are their hallmarks, with sharp calcification in their hands. This branch has abandoned the flame magic inherited from races to squarely defeat the enemy with both hands and kicks.

entries.zh: 白天，它们竖起蓬松的尾巴，在沙地上蹦跳活动。夜里守在洞口放哨，尾尖亮起柔和的暖黄光，并用尾巴轻点地面，把消息无声地传给同伴。
