entries.en: During the day, they raise their pristine tails and jump on the sand. They stand at night and watch at the mouth of a hole, with its tender and warm yellow tails, and lightly touch the ground with their tails and send the news silently to their companions.

entries.zh: 优优的果实 来源：完成绒光优优的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Youyou fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Downlight Youyou.

entries.zh: 回合开始时若敌方技能足够击败自己，自己获得速度+50，行动后 脱离 。
entries.en: At the start of the turn, if the opponent's skill can defeat you, gain +50 speed and withdraw after acting.

entries.zh: 进化后它们仍然毛绒绒、行动更显优雅敏捷，战斗时旋转腾挪如轻快战舞，发光的尾巴拖出一缕光丝带。它们警惕性极高，只需将尾巴贴地，便能感知远处的动静。
entries.en: After evolution, they are still fuzzy and more elegantly agile, spinning around like a light war dance, with their glowing tails pulled out of a ribbon. They are extremely vigilant, so that by putting their tails on the ground they can sense movement far away.

entries.zh: “你知道洛克的头发什么时候会竖起来吗？”“是你妈妈突然闯入你房间的时候？”“是进入了噼啪鸟的电场！我还听到它的吼叫声！幸好我跑得快，差点就被电击了！”“……不过这个发型还挺帅的，下次再试试。”
entries.en: "Do you know when Locke's hair will come up?" "When your mom suddenly broke into your room?" "It was in the courtyard of crackbirds. I heard it screaming. Fortunately, I ran fast and almost got electrocuted!" "But the hair looks good again."

entries.zh: 噼啪鸟的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Crackle Bird fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 自己技能的 迸发 效果延长1回合。
entries.en: Your skills' Burst effects last 1 additional turn.

entries.zh: 深蓝鲸们喜欢贴着水面游泳，会跳出水面，和来往船只嬉戏，遇到危险时，可以把头部冰柱发射出去。种群之间通过歌声和口哨声交流，不论距离多远，互相之间的声音都能传达到。
entries.en: Deep blue whales like to swim on the water, jump out of the water, play with ships, and when they're in danger, they can fire their heads off. They can communicate through singing and whistling, no matter how far they may be.

entries.zh: 深蓝鲸的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Deep Blue Whale fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 携带的技能受能耗变化效果的影响翻倍。
entries.en: Energy-cost changes affecting your carried skills are doubled.

entries.zh: 格兰种子可以借助微风悬于空中，总是呆呆地望着对方，其实脑袋里盘算着许多鬼点子。体内花粉不停生长，使它躁动不安，总是忍不住捉弄其他精灵。
entries.en: Grant seeds can hang on to the air with a breeze, always staring at each other, but there's a lot of ghost ideas in your head. The pollen in your body keeps growing and it makes it restless and can't stop fooling other elves.

entries.zh: 格兰种子的果实 来源：完成格兰球的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Gran Seed fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Gran Ball.
At the end of the turn, restore 12% HP.

entries.zh: 格兰花头顶可喷射出具有不同功效的花粉，花粉沾身会致痒。它总是带着些许挑衅的眼神看着对方，似乎有意识地引诱对方来打自己，被打能帮它挠痒痒，而击打它时还会传播其花粉。
entries.en: Grant's head can spray pollen with different effects, and it tickles. It always looks at each other with a little bit of provocation and seems consciously to lure the other into hitting itself, being beaten to scratch it and spreading its pollen when hit.

entries.zh: 格兰球的花瓣持续生长与更替，老化花瓣会化作鳞片般的护甲。护甲上黏附诸多致痒花粉，它们热衷于边笑边蹭其他精灵。但洛克研究学者经观察其表情和动作发现，它们坏笑时鳞片般的护甲会微微张开，让它们更好地传粉。
entries.en: The petals of the Glen ball continue to grow and change, and the petals of the aging will become scales of armor. They have a lot of itch powder on their armour, which they are keen to smile and rub with other elves. But Locke researchers look at their faces and movements and find that their scribble-like vests will open slightly so as to make them more pollinative.

entries.zh: 有着小巧的身体，敏感的尾巴是它最大的弱点。族群数量庞大，生命力极强，几乎不需要喝水。
entries.en: With a small body, sensitive tails are its greatest weakness. There are large groups of people with great vitality and little need for water.

entries.zh: 地鼠的果实 来源：完成遁地鼠的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Ground Mouse fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Earth-Burrowing Mouse.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，若自己能量为0则 脱离 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, withdraw if you have 0 energy.

entries.zh: 生活在干旱地区，演化出了可以储藏水分的特殊耳朵结构。它们呼吸时，在鼻腔和口腔中凝结出水珠，再将水珠输送到耳朵里储存起来。
entries.en: Living in arid areas, they have evolved special ear structures that can store moisture. They breathe, condensing water beads in their noses and mouths, and then sending it to their ears for storage.

entries.zh: 尾巴上有一层坚固的壳，所以挖洞的时候不必担心身后。耳朵的尖端粗糙而耐脏，把摄取的水分和养分都储存在饱满的大耳朵里。
entries.en: There's a strong shell on the tail, so you don't have to worry about the back when you dig holes. The ears are thick and resistant, with ingested water and nutrients stored in full ears.

entries.zh: 饱满的大耳朵里都是水分，蓄满水的时候会膨大成球状，摸起来软软的，像水球一样充满弹力，行走间轻轻晃动，能听见细微的水声。
entries.en: The thick ears are filled with water, and when they fill the water, they swell into spherical shapes and touch softly, as strong as a water balloon, and move gently between walks, so that they can hear a faint sound of water.

entries.zh: 精力旺盛，时常在烈日下的沙漠里飞奔。能够四脚共用，在地下挖掘复杂的洞系，休息的时候常常躲在地下的洞里。
entries.en: Powerful and often running in the deserts under the sun. It can share its four feet, dig complex holes underground, and often hide in underground holes when resting.

entries.zh: 对干旱环境的适应性极强，耳朵里的储水囊容量巨大，需要摄入水分的时候，水分能够直接向身体内输送。一次蓄满水之后可以连续几个月不喝水。
entries.en: It is highly adaptable to arid environments, with huge reservoir capacity in the ears, and when water needs to be ingested, it can flow directly into the body.

entries.zh: 不同于章鱼精灵，它们因为蕴含幽系能量，皮肤已经褪成苍白的颜色，头足里面藏着墨囊，装着它们收集来的颜料。经常藏在厚厚的画纸中间休息。
entries.en: Unlike octopus elves, because of their phantom energy, their skin has faded into pale colours and their heads are covered with inkbags containing the paint they collect. They often rest in thick drawing paper.

entries.zh: 墨鱿士的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Ink Squid Squire fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 使用非本系技能时威力+50%。
entries.en: Skills that do not match your own types gain +50% power when used.

entries.zh: 体型暴涨，皮肤化作流动的红、蓝、黄三色漩涡，情绪高涨时随时像泼墨般炸开。它用触手当画笔，在空中乱甩墨汁，留下大片狂野的色块。
entries.en: The body surges, the skin becomes a flow of red, blue and yellow vortexes, which explodes at any time like ink. It draws brushes with tentacles, dumps ink in the air, leaving large pieces of wild color.

entries.zh: 身体覆上整齐的黑白方格，触手末端变成细长的金属尺，能把漂浮的墨滴精确切割成等分方块。它从不越界，乐于将墨汁按深浅、冷暖、浓度排成矩阵，精准而冷静。
entries.en: A neat black and white square over which the end of your hand becomes a fine metal ruler, cutting the floating ink drops precisely into an equal square. It never crosses the border and is happy to line the ink into a matrix that is deep, cold, warm, concentrated, precise and calm.

entries.zh: 受到非敌方系别的技能攻击时伤害-50%。
entries.en: Take 50% less damage from attack skills whose type does not match the opponent's own types.

entries.zh: 头盔顶部和双手上都有黄色的尖角，锋利而坚硬。听说在它们的世界里，坚硬且粗壮的角是身份地位的象征。
entries.en: The heads of helmets and hands have yellow sharp and hard horns. In their world, they say strong and thick horns are symbols of identity.

entries.zh: 小甲虫的果实 来源：完成铠甲虫的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Beetle fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Armoured Beetle.

entries.zh: 每受到1次攻击伤害，己方队伍获得1次随机 奉献 。
entries.en: For every 1 damaging attack you take, your team gains 1 random Offering.

entries.zh: 全副武装没有破绽，头顶的巨钳令人生畏。甲壳有些沉重，依然可以飞行。但好处是，厚重的甲壳能够挡住敌人的攻击。
entries.en: Full arming is not broken, and the pliers on top of your head are daunting. The crust is a bit heavy and can still fly. But the good thing is that it is thick enough to block enemy attacks.

entries.zh: 黄金时代的工匠们曾将占星与炼金并列为同一门学问的两种语言。于是他们以风为芯，以力量和律法为骨，铸成了圣剑。现在只有极少量留存下来。
entries.en: The gold-era craftsmen listed as stars and alchemy two languages of the same study. So they built the sword with the wind core, strength and law. Only a very small amount of them are left behind.

entries.zh: 圣剑侍从的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Holy Sword Squire fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.
You may only use the skill in slot 1.

entries.zh: 制造者把牺牲和奉献作为圣剑的使命，接下来它的一切行为都是为了实现这个目的，无数十号圣剑就这样留在了从前的时代里。现在黄金时代的风早已停息，暗夜过后也迎来了新生。
entries.en: The maker has made sacrifice and dedication his mission as a sword, and all of its actions followed to that end, and no dozen swords left behind in the old days. Now the winds of the golden age have stopped, and after the night has passed, they have rejuvenated.

entries.zh: 永远不会停下的机械，被发现的时候伤痕累累，曾经被修复过很多次，修复后的身体仍然能发出的超过5000度的光焰。其身体内部刻着古代文字意为：熄灭不是终结，等待新生到来，它将重铸工匠的意志。
entries.en: A machine that never stops. It was found badly damaged and has been repaired many times, yet its restored body can still emit a radiant flame exceeding 5000 degrees. Ancient writing inside it reads: Extinguishing is not the end. Awaiting new life, it will reforge the will of the craftspeople.

entries.zh: 仅可使用1号和3号位技能。
entries.en: You may only use skills in slots 1 and 3.

entries.zh: 骨骼天生比较脆，需要经常吸食淤泥，泥巴里面含有它们骨骼所需的物质。如果摄入不足，它们的关节会发炎，走起路来可能容易摔倒。吻部尚未完全发育，偶尔会被泥巴噎住
entries.en: The bones are naturally crisp, requiring regular silt and the mud contains the material needed for their bones. If they are not adequately ingestion, their joints become inflammated and they can easily fall on their way. The kisses are not fully developed and occasionally choked by mud.

entries.zh: 吸泥鸥的果实 来源：完成泥吼牙的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Mud-Sipping Gull fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Mud-Roaring Fang.

entries.zh: 在场时，所有精灵 连击数 固定为2。
entries.en: While on the field, all creatures' hit counts are fixed at 2.

entries.zh: 一口就能吞下比自己还重的淤泥，皮肤表面也有了吸收淤泥的能力，淤泥硬壳能有效保护它们脆弱的骨骼。有的时候不小心把小体型的精灵邻居吸到嘴巴里，会赶紧吐出来，连连道歉。偶尔也会用嘴巴载着小型精灵度过泥潭。
entries.en: A single bite can swallow the silt that weighs more than itself, and the skin surface has the ability to absorb the silt, which is able to protect their fragile bones effectively. Sometimes a small-sized elf neighbor is accidentally sucked into his mouth and spits out, even apologizes. Occasionally, a little elves are carried with their mouths through the mud.

entries.zh: 它是这片泥地里体型最大、吃得最多、活得最久的个体，是整片泥地的管理者。摄取了大量的矿物后，骨骼密度是同族的数倍，干裂的泥甲覆盖全身像一层天然盔甲。
entries.en: It's the largest, most eaten and longest-lived individual in this mudland, and it's the manager of the whole earth. After taking up a large quantity of minerals, bone density is several times that of the same people, with a torn mud coat covering its entire body like a natural armor.

entries.zh: 在场时，所有精灵 连击数 固定为1。
entries.en: While on the field, all creatures' hit counts are fixed at 1.

entries.zh: 首次被人发现时，大头骨龙在地下岩层中沉睡，并且对现在的世界和精灵社会一无所知。骨架不仅坚硬，而且具有再生能力。即使骨头被打断，也可以在短时间内重新长出。骨质翅膀虽然看起来脆弱，但实际上非常坚韧。
entries.en: When first discovered, the big skull dragons fell asleep in the subsurface rock formation and knew nothing about the world and elf society. The bones were not only hard, but also regenerative. They could grow up in a short period of time, even when they were broken. Bones seemed fragile, but were actually very resilient.

entries.zh: 大头骨龙的果实 来源：完成寂灭骨龙的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Big-Headed Bone Dragon fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Annihilation Bone Dragon.

entries.zh: 当被从土层里挖出来的时候，它们正在一无所知地睡觉。别看它们脆弱得好像一脚会散架，但埋了亿万年的矿物硬度堪比钻石。“它总是对着镜子思考，幻想自己当年活着时候的样子。”
entries.en: When they're dug out of the earth floor, they're sleeping in ignorance. Don't look as if they're vulnerable, but the minerals buried for billions of years are hard as diamonds. "It always thinks about mirrors and imagines what it was like to be alive."

entries.zh: 体味清香，翼下藏有数个腺体，能够发射致洛克晕厥的毒雾。受惊时将双翼展为扇形，倾泻毒雾后迅速逃离。
entries.en: The fragrance is clear, and there are several glands hidden under the wing that can launch a poison fog that causes Locke to faint.

entries.zh: 厉毒小萝的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Little Venom Luo fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 敌方每有1层 中毒效果 ，自己获得 连击数 +1。
entries.en: For every 1 stack of Poison effects on the opponent, gain +1 hit.

entries.zh: 翼上的棘刺带有能够分泌剧毒的腺体，狩猎时常在暗处蹲守观察许久，找到时机后从棘刺中射出毒液使猎物昏迷，再飞速捕获。
entries.en: The thorns on the wing carry highly toxic glands, and hunting often waits for long periods of time in the dark to find a chance to shoot venom out of the thorns to make the prey unconscious and catch it at speed.

entries.zh: 探索欲很强的精灵，会通过摇尾巴的方式表达亲近，尾尖会散发出魔法，但并不能很好的控制，时常伤到自己。
entries.en: Exploited elves express closeness by shaking their tails, and their tails spread magic, but they are not well controlled and often hurt themselves.

entries.zh: 小帕尔的蛋 来源：完成「暗夜拾光」赛季作业
entries.en: Little Par egg. Source: Complete the Light in the Dark seasonal assignment.

entries.zh: 击败敌方精灵时，敌方额外损失1点魔力。被敌方精灵击败时，自己额外损失1点魔力。
entries.en: When you defeat an opposing creature, the opponent loses 1 additional Magic. When an opposing creature defeats you, you lose 1 additional Magic.

entries.zh: 头顶的独角锋利又坚硬，但不蕴含魔法，脱落下来的独角最早被洛克用来制作匕首。“他眼中看到的都是黑白的，他的世界没有色彩，单一的世界却让他有了执著的信念和忠诚的心。”
entries.en: The unicorn above his head is sharp and hard, but it does not contain magic. Locke's unicorn was first used to make daggers. "He sees black and white in his eyes, his world is colorless, and a single world gives him a commitment of faith and loyalty."

entries.zh: 在古老的典籍中记载，龙息帕尔和其他恶系精灵的行事风格不同，它们秉持等价交换的原则，会严格遵守自己缔结的契约。在契约完成前绝不会离开，甚至愿意为此等待漫长的时光。
entries.en: In the old books, it is written that Long Jingpar and other evil spirits behave differently in a way that adheres to the principle of equal exchange and strictly abides by the contract they have concluded. They will never leave, or even wait for long periods of time, until the contract has been completed.

entries.zh: 身上的绒毛柔软且密集，表面有微小的鳞片结构来吸附灰尘，喜欢从灰尘中吸食各种魔法粉尘，会追逐星星魔法，并吸食炸开的粉末。遇到洛克时容易惊慌失措，全身颤抖，在刺激下炸毛，身上的灰尘也被抖落，让洛克忍不住打喷嚏。
entries.en: The fumes are soft and dense, with small scales on the surface to absorb dust, enjoy all kinds of magic dust from the dust, pursue star magic and eat fried powder. Locke is easily frightened, his body trembles, his hair blows under stimulus, and his dust falls down so that he can't resist sneezing.

entries.zh: 毛头小蛛的果实 来源：完成捕尘长绒的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Little Fuzzy Spider fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dust-Catching Longdown.

entries.zh: 回合结束时驱散敌方1层 印记 ，且驱散后己方队伍获得1次随机 奉献 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, dispel 1 Mark from the opponent. After dispelling it, your team gains 1 random Offering.

entries.zh: 绒毛长而纤细，每个洛克小时候都曾把家里打扫清洁的捕尘长绒当作魔法扫帚骑着玩，然后被家长揍一顿，而家长顺手拿起的武器也是捕尘长绒，但是它们喜欢被洛克需要。
entries.en: The fur was long and thin, and every Locke used to clean his house as a magic broom to ride, and then he was beaten by his parents, who picked up the weapons as dusty as well, but they liked it.

entries.zh: 绒毛短而浓密，出没在灰尘多的地方，能够在任何表面爬行，其脚掌上短且蓬松的绒毛在爬行时会产生静电作用，牢牢地黏在物体表面上，吸附灰尘，清理家具的死角。
entries.en: The fumes are short and thick enough to crawl on any surface where there is a lot of dust, and the furs on its feet are short and loose when they climb with static electrostatic effects, firmly stuck on the surface of the object, soaking up the dust and cleaning out the dead corners of the furniture.

entries.zh: 回合结束时偷取敌方1层 印记 。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, steal 1 Mark from the opponent.

entries.zh: 画中世界诞生的精灵，活泼好动，对穿梭魔法的运用不是很熟练，偶尔会被画框卡住。曾经尝试少吃可可果来解决这个问题，后来发现并没有效果。
entries.en: The elves who were born in the world were active, not very skilled in their use of shuttle magic, and occasionally stuck in frames. They tried to solve the problem by eating less cocoa, but found it to be ineffective.

entries.zh: 画精灵的果实 来源：完成画间法师手的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Painting Spirit fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Painting Mage's Hand.

entries.zh: 攻击会使敌方已有的 减益 层数+3。
entries.en: Your attacks add 3 stacks to the opponent's existing debuffs.

entries.zh: 可以熟练地在画中与画外穿梭，十分热心肠，喜欢交朋友，经常为认识的画做保养，轻轻吹走灰尘，灰尘太多可能令他一直打喷嚏。但这并不会成为它们的阻碍。
entries.en: The ability to travel with the drawings, the enthusiasm for friends, the constant maintenance of familiar paintings, the light blowout of dust and too much dust may keep him sneezing. But it will not be an obstacle to them.

entries.zh: 能够通过画框跨越时间与空间，沉迷于收集更多的见闻，看见更广阔的世界。在长年累月的穿梭中，曾经认识的画已经褪色，但它从没有停下。
entries.en: It was able to cross time and space by drawing frames, gathering more insights and seeing a wider world. In the passage of years and months, the painting that was once known faded, but it never stopped.

entries.zh: 一种沉默寡言的分支形态，稍微有些粗鲁，比起结识更多的朋友，对他来说更重要的是保护现在朋友们的安全，可能在实施保护中不小心磕到朋友的头。确定了需要保护的对象之后，就不会再四处穿梭。
entries.en: A kind of silent branch, a little bit rude, with more friends than we know, is more important for him to protect the safety of his friends now, possibly by accidentally hitting their heads in the exercise of protection. Once someone who needs to be protected has been identified, there will be no further travel.

entries.zh: 行动时，敌方每有1层 增益 ，本次行动技能威力+10%，速度+5。
entries.en: When acting, gain +10% power for that skill and +5 speed for every 1 buff stack on the opponent.

entries.zh: 沉迷于阅读，其力量来源于书本的知识。走路和睡觉时都手不释卷，读的书越多体型变得越大，隔一段时间就要调整绑书带的长度，不然会阻碍它学习新知识。
entries.en: The power of reading comes from the knowledge of books. When you walk and sleep, the larger the volume, the longer it becomes, the longer it adjusts to the length of the belt, which prevents it from learning new knowledge.

entries.zh: 书魔虫的果实 来源：完成古卷执政官的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Book Magic Bug fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Ancient Scroll Archon.

entries.zh: 入场时，若自己魔力值为1，自己获得双攻+100%。
entries.en: On entry, if your Magic value is 1, gain +100% to both attack stats.

entries.zh: 身上带着书本和油墨的味道，看起来小小的，其实比想象中重很多。常与同伴交换藏书，偶尔遇到疑惑的地方，会用书使劲砸自己的头，希望用这种办法让知识快点进入身体。
entries.en: The smell of books and ink is small, but it's a lot heavier than you think. Exchangeing books with fellow people, sometimes with doubt, hits your head hard, hoping to get knowledge into the body quickly.

entries.zh: 期末时期的图书馆，每当古卷执政官从书架间缓缓现身，它周围的位置总被围得水泄不通，它的古卷如臂膀般展开，书页无声翻动，精准停在学生们最需要的章节上。“不要抗拒，作业是你和知识之间的契约。”
entries.en: The library at the end of the period, whenever the archaic governor slowly appears from between bookshelves, its surroundings are surrounded by water and its curls are spread like arms, its pages are unsoundly flipped, and it stops precisely on the sections that students need most. "Don't resist, your work is a contract between you and knowledge."

entries.zh: “盗贼撬开了书库的大门，随后就被黑暗中什么沉重的打击在空中划出了一道抛物线。然后落荒而逃，并且拒绝再次到访这里，并且嘴里一直嘟囔着：知识就是力量”——某冒险者叙述他们在魔法学院遭到古卷匣魔像攻击的故事。
entries.en: “The thief opened the door to the library, and then was struck by what was in the dark by a parabolic line in the air. Then he ran away and refused to visit here again, and his mouth kept whispering: knowledge is power” — some adventurer told the story of them being attacked at the Academy of Magic by an ancient statue.

entries.zh: 入场时，若敌方魔力值为1，自己获得双防+100%。
entries.en: On entry, if the opponent's Magic value is 1, gain +100% to both defence stats.

entries.zh: 绒绒多在夜间活动，触角能感知星光，体表覆盖着细密的短绒，能吸附少量蕴含星光的细微粉末。偶尔主动靠近洛克，以柔软的身体轻蹭对方，习性黏人，是温顺的小型毛绒精灵。
entries.en: The velvet moves at night, the tentacles sense starlight, and the watch covers a thin velvet that absorbs a small amount of fine powder with star light. Sometimes they come close to Locke, rubbing each other softly with a soft body, and they are gentle little fury elfs.

entries.zh: 绒绒的果实 来源：拾光通行证获得
entries.en: Rongrong fruit. Source: Gathered Light Pass reward.

entries.zh: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是非本系的系别血脉，技能威力+100%。
entries.en: When attacking, gain +100% skill power if the opponent has a type bloodline that does not match its own types.

entries.zh: 体表的短绒进化为蓬松且带有黏性的长绒，能够吸附并储存更多星光粉末，直接触摸的话，会感到轻微刺痛。它们吸附的粉末最终在体内融合，驱动体内组织发生解离和重塑，当能量饱和时，绒毛能爆发出强劲的冲击力。
entries.en: The velvet of the surface evolves into a fluffy and viscous long velvet, capable of absorbing and storing more star powder, with a slight sting if touched directly. Their adsorbed powder eventually merges within the body to drive disassemble and reconstructive tissue, and when energy is saturated, the velvet can erupt with a strong shock force.

entries.zh: 完全发育成型，翅脉中流动着体液，横脉与纵脉交汇处形成规整的星形花纹，蕴含强烈的星光能量。胸节与携粉足极度膨大，布满致密的长绒，能牢牢黏附超多光系魔法粉末——这些粉末正是体液代谢后的产物。
entries.en: Full growth, fluid flow in the veins, star-shaped stripes forming at the intersection of the arteries and the veins, with strong starlight energy. The chest and powder are extremely large and heavily velvet, so that they can be firmly attached to the super-lighted magic powder -- which is a product of body fluid metabolism.

entries.zh: 足部又软又嫩，相当虚弱无力。双眼的视觉暂未发育完全，偶尔被毛发遮挡视野。研究推测其毛发承担了主要感官的功能，在看不清的时候也可以通过毛发的感光功能，早早隐藏好自己。
entries.en: The feet are soft and young and quite weak. The vision of the eyes is not fully developed, sometimes covered by hair. Research assumes that their hair assumes the main sensory function, and can hide themselves early in time through the light function of hair when it is difficult to see.

entries.zh: 犀角鸟的果实 来源：拾光通行证获得
entries.en: Hornbill fruit. Source: Gathered Light Pass reward.

entries.zh: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是首领血脉，技能威力+100%。
entries.en: When attacking, gain +100% skill power if the opponent has a Boss bloodline.

entries.zh: 毛发柔软但有韧性，结构特殊，似乎每一根毛发都能接收和发射光能量。它们可以分辨来自四面八方所有光束的到达时间，比较每个光束抵达的时间，计算其距离和能量。
entries.en: Fluids are soft but resilient and have a special structure, as if each hair received and launched light energy. They distinguish the time of arrival from all beams on every side, comparing the time of arrival of each beam and calculating its distance and energy.

entries.zh: 在月亮升起来之后活动，某些特定时间会散发出微弱光芒，与某些弱小的夜行生物存在共生关系。光能量在每根毛发中沿“之”字形向身体内部传输，可以完好无损地传输到体内，存储凝结成强大力量。
entries.en: When the moon rises, a slight light is emitted at certain times and there is a symbiotic relationship with some of the weak night travelers. The energy of light is transmitted inside the body in the word "of" in every hair, and it can be transferred intact to the body and stored into a powerful force.

entries.zh: 透明而不起眼的精灵，经常在干净的水源被发现。研究发现，果冻精灵可以维护森林、湖泊和山脉的生态平衡，似乎是因为它们能让水变得清澈。
entries.en: Transparent and invisible elves are often found in clean water sources. Research shows that Jell-O elfs can maintain ecological balance in forests, lakes and mountains, as if they could make water clear.

entries.zh: 果冻的蛋 来源：地下管道
离场 后，更换入场的精灵回复20%生命且免疫 寄生 。
entries.en: After you leave the field, your replacement restores 20% HP and gains immunity to Parasitism.

entries.zh: 抹茶布丁负责舒缓与修复，它会释放带草本气息的挥发物，闻到这种气味，周围的生物会更容易安定下来。它们对同伴与洛克都很亲近，会抱住洛克身上的细小伤口，通过触碰治愈创伤。
entries.en: Tea pudding is responsible for comfort and repair. It releases volatile things with herbs, smells it, and the surrounding organisms are more likely to settle down. They're close to Locke, they hold a small wound in Locke, and they heal wounds by touching him.

entries.zh: 椰浆布丁负责降温与保鲜，它能在体表形成一层很薄的冷凝膜，使自身在温暖环境中不易软化变形。它常出现在有人维护的洁净水源附近，并更愿意与洛克共存，阴凉的室内能提高它们的舒适度。
entries.en: Coconut pudding is responsible for cooling and keeping fresh. It can form a thin condensate on the surface, making it difficult to soften itself in warmer environments. It often appears near clean water sources that are maintained and more willing to coexist with Locke, and the chilled room increases their comfort.

entries.zh: 离场 后，更换入场的精灵获得双防+20%且免疫 冻结 。
entries.en: After you leave the field, your replacement gains +20% to both defence stats and immunity to Freeze.

entries.zh: 熔岩布丁负责增温与成熟，它体内的活性物质能促进糖分增多，在丰收季节，洛克常带着它们在可可果林区活动，帮助可可果形成更明显的甜香气味，洛克也常把它们的活跃视作可可果林健康的信号之一。
entries.en: The molten rock pudding, which is responsible for warming and maturing, has the active material in its body that contributes to increasing sugar fractions. During the harvest season, Locke often carries them along with him in cocoa forest areas, helping to create a more visible smell of sweetness for cocoa fruit, and Locke often sees their dynamism as one of the signs of the health of cocoa fruit forests.

entries.zh: 离场 后，更换入场的精灵获得双攻+20%且免疫 灼烧 。
entries.en: After you leave the field, your replacement gains +20% to both attack stats and immunity to Burn.

entries.zh: 洛克与精灵开始缔结契约的时候诞生的物种。以精灵契约为食，是极其稀少的物种。囫囵吞下咕噜球后，先整个保存在身体里一段时间，非常久之后才能完全消化掉。虽然也能吃其他食物，但很难从中获取养分。
entries.en: The species that was born when Locke and the Elves began to enter into a contract. Eating on an elf pact is an extremely rare species. After swallowing the grumpy ball, the whole body stays in it for some time, very long before it is completely digested. While eating other foods, it is difficult to get nutrients from it.

entries.zh: 根据捕捉所用的咕噜球，入场时获得不同效果。
entries.en: Gain a different effect on entry according to the Gulu Ball used to catch you.

entries.zh: 与精灵缔结契约的形式发生变化，咕噜球的样子世代更替，这一种族的外表也渐渐发生了变化。有人曾经尝试使用特殊咕噜球喂食，虫的形态在数年后发生变化，但实验没有继续下来，猜测是因为资金不足。
entries.en: The form of compacts with elves has changed, and the look of grunts has changed over time, as has the appearance of this race. There have been attempts to use special grunts for feeding, and the shape of worms has changed after a few years, but the experiment has not continued because there is insufficient funding.

entries.zh: 在这个虫族中存在着森严的等级制度，某些虫有资格吃到更稀有的咕噜球。咕噜球研究科曾经提出过一个实验课题《陨星虫与国王球的对撞实验》，后来课题被取消了，原因不明。
entries.en: There is a strict hierarchical system in this community, where certain insects are eligible for rarer grunts.

entries.zh: 头顶的光似乎并不是光系魔法，而是来自于某种寄生在其身上的会发光的细菌，目前不清楚发光细菌的其他特性，即使在水中也必须把头顶的灯伸到水面上。
entries.en: The light above the head does not seem to be light magic, but rather comes from some kind of parasitic bacteria that are present in it. It is not clear what other properties of glowing bacteria are, even in water, that the lamp over the head must reach on the surface.

entries.zh: 双灯鱼的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Twinlamp Fish fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己的能耗增加变为能耗降低；能耗降低变为能耗增加。
entries.en: Your energy-cost increases become decreases, and decreases become increases.

entries.zh: 独居生物，个体之间保持距离，互不侵犯。常常自言自语，狂笑乱跳。据研究它们头顶的灯内有百万只以上的发光菌，肉眼很难观察。每只菌似乎都有独立意识，能够和本体进行沟通，甚至还有可能侵蚀本体的脑。
entries.en: Living alone, individuals keep their distance from each other. They often talk to themselves and laugh at each other. There are more than a million luminous bacteria in the lights on their heads. The naked eye is hard to observe. Each of them seems to be independent, able to communicate with the body and even likely to erode it.

entries.zh: 额前的星星质地不明，触感温热，能够从其中检测到异常的魔力波动。如果星星离开身体太远的话，身体会进入沉睡状态。“虽然它从不去看，但是魔法丢得很准。”
entries.en: The stars on the forehead are unknown in shape and warm, and they detect abnormal magic fluctuations. If the star leaves too far away, the body goes to sleep. "Although it never looks at them, it throws magic perfectly."

entries.zh: 月牙雪熊的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Crescent Snow Bear fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 使用攻击技能时，敌方每有1层冻结，在攻击前使其获得1层 星陨印记 。
entries.en: When using an attack skill, before attacking inflict 1 Meteor Mark for every 1 stack of Freeze on the opponent.

entries.zh: “经实验发现，其腹部含有特殊的器官，只对光系能量产生反应。因此，存放光水晶时需派遣光系精灵巡逻，混淆它们的感应。”“光系精灵一同发出抗议，要求王国打击嗜光嗡嗡的狂热跟踪和过分亲近行为。”
entries.en: "It has been discovered that the abdomen contains a special organ and reacts only to light energy. Therefore, the crystal must be stored with photogenic elves patrolling to confuse their senses." "Lighty elves together protest for the Kingdom's fight against entanglement and excessive intimacy."

entries.zh: 嗜光嗡嗡的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Light-Loving Buzzer fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 敌方每携带1种系别的技能，自己攻击时威力+10。
entries.en: When attacking, gain +10 power for every 1 distinct skill type carried by the opponent.

entries.zh: 在微光沼泽，有不少因为长期触光水晶而琥珀化的精灵，这里面却没有恶名昭著的窃光蚊。这是因为窃光蚊会互相合作，一旦有个体吸收了过多光系能量，其他伙伴就会去吸收，帮助其减少体内的能量浓度。
entries.en: In the microlight swamp, there are a lot of elves that have become amberized by long-term contact with crystals, and there is no notorious haciferous mosquitoes. This is because they work together, and once an individual absorbs too much light energy, other partners absorb it, helping to reduce energy concentrations in their bodies.

entries.zh: “请避免在秋季携带柴渣虫进入山林，若因未采取防火措施而促成险情，洛克将承担所有责任。”——一则来自魔法部的公告
entries.en: “Please avoid carrying woody worms into the mountains in the fall, and Locke will bear all responsibility for any risk caused by the failure to take fire measures.” - a communiqué from the Ministry of Magic.

entries.zh: 柴渣虫的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Wood-Scrap Bug fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 在场时，所有 灼烧 的衰减变为增长。
entries.en: While on the field, all Burn decay becomes growth.

entries.zh: 木头已经失去了生命迹象，没有实体的火焰精灵在死去木头的身体里栖息。往往喜欢热闹，洛克族的亲近和合作关系会让它们非常自豪。
entries.en: Wood has lost its signs of life, and no real flame elves are sheltering in the bodies of dead wood. Often they like to have fun, and the closeness and partnership of the Locke people make them very proud.

entries.zh: 夜晚很容易在破旧的空屋见到。力量弱小但长着骇人的面容，会恐吓其他精灵，以此来保护自己。它几乎不依赖视觉，通过感知热量来判断生物的位置与距离。
entries.en: It's easy to see at night in a broken empty house. Small but terrible face, it scares the other elves to protect itself. It hardly relies on sight, judging the location and distance of life by sense of heat.

entries.zh: 空空颅的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Hollow Skull fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 敌方每使用1次「聚能」技能或更换精灵，自己入场时获得魔攻+20%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +20% magical attack for every 1 time the opponent used Gather Energy or switched creatures.

entries.zh: 吓退其他精灵以取乐，有人说它们以恐惧为食，但没人考证过真假。长出双爪后，行动更加自如，有了保护自己的能力。
entries.en: Detering other elves for pleasure, some say they eat with fear, but no one has ever tested the truth. When you grow your claws, you become more self-sufficient and able to protect yourself.

entries.zh: 充盈着魔力的巨爪十分有力，曾经被夜枭吞下过的生命，虽然躯体看似无碍，灵魂却缺失了一部分。
entries.en: The claws of magic are strong, and the life that was once swallowed by a nightlord is lost to a part of the soul, though the body looks intact.

entries.zh: 头部的骨角是经年累月吞噬灵魂后凝聚而成的，角越多、越长，说明它夺取过的灵魂越多。曾有幽系研究员试图记录，但靠近后总是不受控制地产生强烈恐惧，难以继续观察。
entries.en: The skulls of the head are condensed after years of ingesting the soul, and the more the horns grow, the more the spirits it has taken. There were phantom researchers who tried to record them, but when they approached, there was always uncontrollable fear that would be difficult to continue to observe.

entries.zh: 敌方每使用1次「聚能」技能或更换精灵，自己入场时获得魔攻+20%和魔防+10%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +20% magical attack and +10% magical defence for every 1 time the opponent used Gather Energy or switched creatures.

entries.zh: 身体里流淌着神秘的星光能量，打喷嚏的时候会下星星雨。喜欢聚在一起舞蹈，舞蹈时能看到漂亮的星光在它们周围环绕，推测这是粉粉星们交流的一种方式。
entries.en: There's mysterious star light in your body, and it rains when you sneeze. You like to come together and dance, and you can see beautiful starlight around them, presumably as a way of communicating with pink stars.

entries.zh: 粉粉星的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Pink Star fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，若场上的己方精灵能量等于0，自己立即替换此精灵。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, if the allied creature on the field has 0 energy, immediately replace it with this creature.

entries.zh: 浑身散发着紫色的微光，有时会在夜晚拿出珍藏的星星，为迷途的旅人照亮归途。得益于柔软的身体结构，能够将不稳定的星光能量储存在体内，据说星星的亮度代表着存储能量的强度。
entries.en: Slights of purple light, sometimes at night, bring out treasured stars to brighten the way of lost travelers. The softness of the body allows for the storage of unstable star energy, which is said to represent the strength of stored energy.

entries.zh: 拥有坚硬而沉重的外壳，靠石头和木头补充能量，在能量短缺的时候会靠睡觉度过。 “它是坚硬的，它永远不会破碎。可当你狠心地对待它，它终究会伤心地沉睡。”
entries.en: "It's hard, it'll never break. But when you treat it hard, it will sleep sadly."

entries.zh: 贝瑟的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Beise fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 1号位技能获得 传动 1，且使用后使敌方获得6层 灼烧 。
entries.en: The skill in slot 1 gains Transmission 1 and inflicts 6 stacks of Burn on the opponent after use.

entries.zh: 身体结构十分精巧，能够最高效地利用能源，是某些发热供暖装置的设计原型。但在氧气不足的地方身体会逐渐冷下来进入睡眠状态。“经过了岁月的磨练和沉淀，透露出时光的浑厚。”
entries.en: The body structure is so delicate that it can most efficiently use energy as a prototype of the design of some heat heating devices. But it cools down to sleep where oxygen is insufficient. "After years of grinding and sedimentation, it reveals the thickness of time."

entries.zh: 能够通过头顶的蒸汽猜出贝古斯的心情，对于它们而言，不同的心情需要消耗不同数量的矿石。 “它是安静的，像座山一样，守候在这里，亘古不变，然而它又是有生命的，内心之中迸发出无限的生机。”
entries.en: The feeling of Begus can be extrapolated through the steam above his head, and for them different emotions need to consume different amounts of ore. “It is quiet, like a mountain, waiting here, and it is immutable, yet it is alive, with infinite life in its heart.”

entries.zh: 习性和语言都与目前所知的任何精灵种族不同，身体轻盈，皮肤柔软但极其有韧性。研究学者偶然拾取到它星星飘下的碎屑，密度极高但质量非常轻，研究发现其材质也不属于卡洛西亚大陆的任何一种已知材质。
entries.en: Unlike any of the elf races currently known, it is light and soft but extremely resilient. Researchers occasionally pick up fragments from its stars, which are very dense but of very low quality, and find that their materials do not belong to any of the known ingredients on the continent of Carlocia.

entries.zh: 粉星仔的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Pink Star Pup fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 在场时，双方回合结束时的效果会额外触发1次。
entries.en: While on the field, end-of-turn effects on both sides trigger 1 additional time.

entries.zh: 踏着流星而来的信使，在洛克族里传闻对着它们说话有概率可以梦想成真。它们总是很着急，在夜幕下如同一道道银针般穿行，谁让这世间的许愿总是太多、太多了呢。
entries.en: A messenger who comes on a meteor, has the probability of speaking to them in the Roarks to come true. They're always anxious to walk through the night like a silver pin. Who lets the world wish too many and too many?

entries.zh: “能够在流星上倾听许愿的家伙，总会被认为是善良的吧？嘻嘻，它们可从来没说过会以什么方式实现哦！扭曲的实现也是实现。不愿以他人的理想为自己一生的追求，却也无法逃脱命运的桎梏。那么来吧，向它们许愿吧”！
entries.en: "As for those who listen to their wishes on a meteor, they will always be considered good." Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha. They never say the way in which they will be achieved. A twisted achievement is also achieved. And a man who does not want another's vision for his life, but cannot escape the yoke of destiny. So make a wish to them."

entries.zh: 在场时，双方回合结束时的效果不会触发。
entries.en: While on the field, end-of-turn effects on both sides do not trigger.

entries.zh: 这本来是一只布瓜形状的娃娃，缝制它的老洛克以“不挂科”的谐音为它取了名字，希望它能给魔法学院的小洛克们带来好运。没想到布娃娃因为被赋予非常多爱与希望的力量，竟然诞生了生命和意识。
entries.en: This was a doll in the shape of a burgundy, and old Locke who sews it with the sound of an unchallenged hymn, hoping it would bring good luck to little Rock at the School of Magic. I didn't think that the doll had given birth to life and consciousness because she was given the power to love and hope so much.

entries.zh: 布瓜蝌的果实 来源：预约活动获取
entries.en: Bugua Tadpole fruit. Source: Pre-registration event reward.

entries.zh: 周末时自己获得双攻+40%，其他时间获得双防+40%。
entries.en: Gain +40% to both attack stats on weekends; gain +40% to both defence stats at other times.

entries.zh: 布娃娃诞生了意识之后，因为想要快快奔向小洛克的身边为它们带来好运，所以演化出了擅长弹跳的双腿，跳跃着冲向魔法学院。有传闻说，如果小洛克在考试前听100遍上岸蛙们的“呱呱”声，就可以心想事成，逢考必过。
entries.en: After gaining consciousness, the cloth doll wanted to hurry to young Rocos and bring them good luck. It evolved springy legs and began hopping towards the Magic Academy. Rumour says that hearing a Landbound Frog croak 100 times before an exam will grant a young Roco's wishes and ensure a pass.

entries.zh: 午为烈火之马，丙在天为阳——当二者相遇，火红尾从赤云中探出，它来自东方，额前的火纹像初升之阳，鬃毛如飞天的飘带。东方的洛克会在春节把绘有火红尾纹样的灯笼挂于檐角，灯火随风一晃，便似驹影掠过，寓意为火马开岁，光明满堂。
entries.en: At noon, the horse of fire and C is the sun in the sky — when they meet, the fire turns out from the clouds. It comes from the east, with the first-lit sun on its forehead, and its hair as a flying swathe. Locke in the east hangs a lamphouse with red tails of fire on the corner of spring, and the lights go by the wind as if it were a shadow of war. It opens for the flame and is full of light.

entries.zh: 火红尾的果实 来源：活动获取
entries.en: Flame-Red Tail fruit. Source: Event reward.

entries.zh: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是污染血脉，技能威力+100%。
entries.en: When attacking, gain +100% skill power if the opponent has a Polluted bloodline.

entries.zh: 岁首更替，丙午是天地通明的光明之年，传闻雅丹鬃是光明的使者，会在新年的子夜仰首长嘶，声如裂帛，鬃毛化作飞天的流火长带，照得千里沙海通明。此时，万盏红灯同时亮起，仿佛回应烈马奔腾——天地通明，光明永昼。
entries.en: And at the beginning of his life, the year of brightness in the heavens and the earth, and at the end of the month, when it is said that Adam is a messenger of light, who will look upon the children of the new year with a sound like a cracking sound, and a brimming swirling as a burning belt of flying skyscraper, and he shall see a thousand miles of sea and sea. Then the red lights will be lit at once, as if they were in response to the rising of horses: the heavens and the earth are full of light, and the day will last forever.

entries.zh: 春天草原上出生的小兔，成群出现，以露水为食。吸收的露水储存在耳囊中，因此散发出浆果和青草的香味。
entries.en: The rabbits born on the spring prairie appear in groups and feed on dew. Ingestion of the dew is stored in earbags, so that the fragrance of berries and green grass is spread.

entries.zh: 春团的果实 来源：活动获取
entries.en: Spring Puff fruit. Source: Event reward.

entries.zh: 获得能量或生命时，会将等量的能量或生命随机分配给场下的精灵。
entries.en: When you gain HP or energy, randomly distribute an equal amount of HP or energy among creatures off the field.

entries.zh: 耳朵的皮肤呈透明玻璃状，触感柔软，内部可以储藏更多的露水。总是细心地做着准备，可以把自己和身边的同伴都照顾得很好，经常用手中的四叶草为其他精灵同伴遮雨。
entries.en: The skin of the ears is transparent and soft in touch, so that more dew can be stored inside. Always carefully prepared to take good care of themselves and their companions, often with his hands of grass to cover the rain for other elf peers.

entries.zh: 即使找不到水源，也可以吸收耳朵里储存的大量露水。手中的四叶草变为双枪，能够汲取自然中逸散的草系能量，也能作为媒介释放魔法。经常帮助其他精灵，在某些地方被称为勇者兔兔。
entries.en: Even if water cannot be found, it can absorb the large amount of dew stored in the ears. The four leaf weeds in your hand turn into two guns that can extract the energy of the herbs that are scattered in nature and release magic as a medium. It often helps other elves, sometimes referred to as brave rabbits.

entries.zh: 无数幽星光家族的精灵们花费了几千年时间仰望星空，并持续观察和记录，星星的轨迹被它们编成旋律，一代代传唱。
entries.en: The elves of the countless family of phantom light have spent thousands of years looking up at the sky and continuously observing and recording that the stars' tracks are made into melodys to be sung from generation to generation.

entries.zh: 幽星光的果实 来源：活动获取
entries.en: Ghostly Starlight fruit. Source: Event reward.

entries.zh: 触发 星陨印记 时仅消耗一半层数，仍造成满层伤害。
entries.en: When triggering Meteor Marks, consume only half their stacks while still dealing full-stack damage.

entries.zh: 越来越多的星星汇聚在它身侧，应和它的歌声。它们能从星星的光芒中读取漫长岁月的信息，并通过拨动星环预知未来星星们前行的方向。
entries.en: And more and more stars come together on its side, and they sing with it. They can read from the light of the star for a long time and predict the direction ahead of the future stars by twisting the rings.

entries.zh: 当知识积累到一定程度，曜星光便会和星辰共鸣，化身暮星辰。一颗星辰寂灭，一颗星辰升起。涌起的黑洞已然吞噬了它的心灵。无穷无尽的冰冷与空洞啊——但是它依然在等待，等待新的行星诞生。
entries.en: When knowledge is accumulated to a certain extent, the light of the stars echoes with the stars and becomes the twilight stars. One star disappears and one star rises. A black hole has swallowed up its heart. An endless cold and empty hole — but it still awaits the birth of a new planet.

entries.zh: 被洛克制造并赋予美好的使命，它们的底层结构里面写着“去吧，去给孩子们带来快乐吧。”于是它们年复一年日复一日，用不太灵光的脑袋想，用有点笨的小手做，尝试制作出所有能让洛克感觉到快乐的事物。
entries.en: The bottom structure of Locke, which is made and given a wonderful mission, says, "Go ahead and bring happiness to the children." So they think year after year, with their little, little hands, trying to make everything that makes Locke feel happy.

entries.zh: 钨丝贝贝的蛋 来源：完成「狂欢怪谈」赛季作业
entries.en: Tungsten Beibei egg. Source: Complete the Carnival Strange Tales seasonal assignment.

entries.zh: 在场时，背包里会变化出随机精灵，随机精灵只能与本精灵相互更换。本精灵受到的克制伤害+25%。
entries.en: While on the field, random creatures appear in the backpack. They can only switch with this creature. This creature takes 25% more super-effective damage.

entries.zh: 经常对着空气练习，有洛克靠近时会立刻启动表演程序。有时显得笨拙不够善解人意，如果小洛克曾因为它的笑话而微笑，它可以不眠不休追着小洛克讲三天三夜的笑话，然后直接昏倒。
entries.en: Often practiced with the air, when Locke approached, he immediately started performing. Sometimes it seemed clumsy enough to understand. If Little Rock had smiled because of his jokes, it could go after Little Locke for three days and three nights and fainted.

entries.zh: 努力观察着所有洛克，曾经因为什么而变得快乐。它默默地把这些瞬间记录下来，尝试动手改造自己，用机械系的魔法制作成「心脏」，希望能够模拟感受到洛克从心底感受到的快乐。
entries.en: It tries to look at all Locke, and it's been happy because of what. It writes these moments in silence, tries to transform itself into a "heart" made out of mechanical magic, hoping to simulate the happiness that Locke feels from the bottom of his heart.

entries.zh: 和普通的鸟精灵看起来差不多，小小的，连叫声都不怎么响亮，只是独自站在崖石上，每天扑扇几下翅膀，比昨天多飞出一点点距离。 “走自己最平凡的路，按照自己的意志行动，追逐自己最真实的梦想”。
entries.en: Like ordinary bird elves, they don't even sound loud, just stand alone on cliffs, pounce a few wings a day and fly a little more than yesterday. “Go your own ordinary way, act according to your will, pursue your truest dreams”.

entries.zh: 在场时，自己携带的普通系技能变为翼系技能，若后于敌方行动，自己受到的伤害+25%。
entries.en: While on the field, your carried Common-type skills become Wing-type. If you act after the opponent, take 25% more damage.

entries.zh: 安静独立的精灵，在长期在高空迎风飞行后，翅膀尖端开始显出橘色的翎羽，它们一天一天地练习，一根羽毛一根羽毛地蜕变，翼系研究员管这个过程叫"凡羽蜕金"。
entries.en: The silent and independent elves, after a long flight at high altitude, began to display orange feathers on the tip of their wings, which practiced day by day, with one feather and one feather changing, and the wingworker called this process "The Van Feather Gold".

entries.zh: 身形变成了梭形，修长的尾羽薄而宽，能把横着吹来的山风悄悄转成向上的托力。研究院测过它的风阻系数，低得离谱，但凡鹰自己好像并不在意这些数据。它飞得很稳，不快不慢，从平凡到非凡，它从没停过，也从没急过。
entries.en: The shape has turned into a shuttle, with its long tail feathers thin and wide enough to turn the wind from blowing across it into an upward torque. The Institute has measured its wind barrier, which is so low that it doesn't seem to care about the data itself. It's steady and slow, and it never stops, nor does it rush.

entries.zh: 头顶的眼是精致的拟态结构，而真正的眼部和头部在腹部，都还很脆弱。魔法师们发现，它的腹部有厚厚的抗冻组织，能在极寒环境中保护核心器官。
entries.en: The eye above the head is a finely crafted structure, and the real eye and head are fragile in the abdomen. The magicians find that it has a thick anti-freeze tissue in its belly that protects its core organs in extreme cold conditions.

entries.zh: 小雪人的果实 来源：狂欢通行证获得
entries.en: Little Snowman fruit. Source: Carnival Pass reward.

entries.zh: 自己使用2次不同的冰系技能后，敌方获得4层 冻结 ，随后特性重置。
entries.en: After you use 2 different Ice-type skills, inflict 4 stacks of Freeze on the opponent, then reset this trait.

entries.zh: 吃掉足够多的暴风雪后就会进化成这个样子。手里永远攥着两个雪球，试图让自己看起来凶猛一些，但其实是个温柔的大家伙，经常偷偷帮迷路的精灵们搭建避风的小雪屋。
entries.en: That's what happens when you eat enough blizzards. You always have two snowballs in your hand, trying to make yourself look fierce, but it's a big, gentle guy who helps the lost elves to build a snow house.

entries.zh: 肚子里有一个小小的爆焰囊，当蓄满火焰时，肚子会鼓成圆滚滚的球状。如果看到它突然捂住肚子，最好赶紧躲开——那是爆焰囊过载的警告！
entries.en: There's a small bulge in the belly, and when it is filled with fire, it becomes a rounded ball. If you see it suddenly covering the stomach, you better get away from it. That's a warning of the blast.

entries.zh: 爆焰仔的果实 来源：狂欢通行证获得
entries.en: Blastflame Pup fruit. Source: Carnival Pass reward.

entries.zh: 自己使用2次不同的火系技能后，下次技能无需 蓄力 ，随后特性重置。
entries.en: After you use 2 different Fire-type skills, your next skill requires no Charging, then reset this trait.

entries.zh: 腹部的爆焰囊扩张了三倍，蓄能时会使整个躯体膨胀如热气球，火焰甚至会从鳞片间隙逸散。古代文献记载，曾有爆焰喷喷在火山口蓄能三天三夜，最终喷射的龙焰照亮了整个夜空。
entries.en: The abdominal capsules have quadrupled, causing the entire body to expand as hot balloons while the energy accumulates, and the flame has even dispersed from the gap between scales. Ancient literature has documented that there was an explosion of fire in the volcano for three days and three nights, which eventually lighted up the entire night sky.

entries.zh: 经常抓着尾巴不停讲话，通过奇妙的头部和尾部结构将自己的声音放大，这是在向周围散播“和我一起玩吧”的信号。如果观察到猴麦仔这样做，可以去和它玩耍试试，它会很开心自己的声音被洛克所听到。
entries.en: He often talks with his tail, magnifies his voice through a wonderful head and tail structure, which is spreading the signal of "Play with me." If you see Monkey McKee do this, you can go play with it, and it'll be happy to hear what Locke says.

entries.zh: 猴麦仔的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Monkey Mic fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己携带的音波弹/音爆/金属噪音/午夜噪音威力提升，且获得 巧变 ：同系别技能。
entries.en: Increase the power of your carried Sonic Orb, Sonic Boom, Metal Noise and Midnight Noise skills. They also gain Adapt: a skill of the same type.

entries.zh: 进化后嗓门大得惊人，更加渴望被听到，想让所有洛克都听见自己的声音。同类碰面时会争抢谁先拿麦，双方轮流对着吼，谁的声音更大谁就赢。有研究员曾记录到两只音碟吼对峙了整整一周，最终以一方嗓子沙哑告终。
entries.en: The voice of evolution is amazingly large and much more eager to be heard, so that all Locke can hear his voice. When the same people meet, they compete for the first to take the wheat, the other to shout at the other side, and the bigger to the other to win. Some researchers have recorded two loudspeaks for a whole week, ending up with one voice.

entries.zh: 身体柔软，会随着水流轻轻摇摆，安静无害，常被误认为普通的装饰，似乎并不想进化。曾有洛克研究员研究这一物种后感概：生命自有出路。
entries.en: The body is soft, swaying with the current, quiet and harmless, often misconstrued as ordinary decorations, and does not seem to want to evolve. Locke researchers have studied this species and felt that life has its way.

entries.zh: 加油海葵的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Cheering Anemone fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 若自己在 萌化 状态下再获得 萌化 会解除萌化。
entries.en: If you gain Cutification while already Cutified, remove Cutification.

entries.zh: 加油蟹（两只海葵的样子）
加油海葵放弃了锤炼自己变得更强这一进化手段，它们和加油蟹一起构建出特殊的共生关系。这个世界足够宽容，小小精灵不必努力变得更强大，只要健康快乐就好。
entries.en: The anemones have given up the evolutionary means of hammering themselves to become stronger, and they create a special symbiotic relationship with refueled crabs. The world is tolerant enough for little elves not to try to be stronger as long as they are healthy and happy.

entries.zh: 加油蟹（单只海葵的样子）
丢失了一只海葵的加油蟹，会埋伏在同伴出没的路上，偷走对方的海葵，而被偷的那只又会去偷下一只。就这样循环往复乐在其中，总有加油蟹缺少一个海葵……
entries.en: The one that lost an anemone's refueled crab will be ambushed on the sidewalk, stealing each other's anemones, and the one that was stolen will steal the next. So that's how it goes back and forth, and there's always a respiratory crab missing a sea anemone.

entries.zh: 在人群中偶尔觉得焦虑的小朋友，看起来有些多动，总是晃悠身体，实际上是在缓解焦虑给自己勇气，不太善于表达。
entries.en: Little friends with occasional anxiety among the population, who seem to be moving and always swaying their bodies, are actually giving themselves courage and less expressive expression.

entries.zh: 小丑豆豆的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Clown Doudou fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己无法回复生命，而是将回复生命变为敌方扣除等量生命。
entries.en: You cannot restore HP. Instead, healing makes the opponent lose an equal amount of HP.

entries.zh: 仍然有些闲不住，但它正在学着克制，想蹦的时候就抛球，把冲动转化到了抛球中。不过偶尔还是会忍不住，球抛着抛着身体就跟着飞了出去。
entries.en: It's still a little busy, but it's learning to exercise restraint, throw the ball when you want to jump, turn the impulse into a throw. But sometimes, it can't help it, and the ball drops on its body and then flies out.

entries.zh: 依然爱动，所有躁动化作指尖球技，它的迈步从容而有节奏，抛球的轨迹优雅得像一门艺术。它的耳朵随着每一次弹跳有规律地颤动，就像洛克喜欢抖腿，这是它唯一泄露出来的小破绽。
entries.en: Still moving, with all the adrenalines turned into finger-twig moves, its pace and punctuation, and the trajectories of throws are as elegant as an art. Its ears tremor in a regular way with every bounce, like Locke likes to shake his legs, which is its only leaking little crack.

entries.zh: 爱扎堆聊天的小话痨，走到哪聊到哪，头顶的烟花就是它们的聊天气泡，聊得越开心，烟花崩得越热闹。脑袋上噼里啪啦闪个不停，如果看到落单的烟花团一整天头上都没有冒出烟花，请多关心它的心理健康。
entries.en: The little talk of chatting, where we go, the fireworks on top are their chat bubbles, the funniest they're talking about, and they're falling apart. If there's a bunch of smoke in your head that doesn't show up all day long, care more about its mental health.

entries.zh: 烟花团的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Firework Puff fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 在场时，衰减的 灼烧 变为相同层数的 中毒 。
entries.en: While on the field, decayed Burn stacks become an equal number of Poison stacks.

entries.zh: 进化后社交圈更广了，走在城镇街道上，即使遇到不认识的精灵也能停下来聊两句。它们主动承担了一些王国业务，负责节日庆典的烟花表演，几只烟花伯爵就能组成一个专业团队。
entries.en: The social circle has grown wider since evolution, walking on the streets of towns and cities, and even when there are no-known elves, they can stop and talk. They take up some Kingdom business and perform fireworks for the festivals, so that a few of them can form a professional team.

entries.zh: 看到洛克就想展示刚学的魔法。可惜魔力还不够，变得不太好，偶尔还有可能失败，表演失败之后它会钻进帽子里面反思，过一会儿又探出脑袋继续尝试。
entries.en: When you see Locke, you want to show the new magic. Unfortunately, it's not enough, it's not good enough, it can sometimes fail, and when it fails, it goes into the hat for reflection, and then comes up with a brain to try again.

entries.zh: 咕咕帽的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Gugu Hat fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 在场时，场上双方携带的技能获得 巧变 ：同系别技能。
entries.en: While on the field, skills carried by creatures on both sides gain Adapt: a skill of the same type.

entries.zh: 认为变出东西的魔法很厉害，于是想要传授给其他精灵这项技术，可惜其他精灵都不是很感兴趣，只有咕咕帽不厌其烦地每天请教，它很开心，于是更加殷切地陪练。
entries.en: Considering that the magic of change is great, and then trying to teach it to other elves, the other elves are unfortunately not very interested in it, except for the groove hats, which do not get tired of asking each day, and it is happy and much more accompanies.

entries.zh: 自己不能发光，但背部覆盖着镜面般的鳞片，蜷缩成球就可以把微小的光芒反射成绚烂的闪光。拥有很多的爱，常常兴奋地滚向最近的洛克！想在闪光中跳跃，想一起共舞一辈子！
entries.en: You can't shine on yourself, but your back is covered with mirrored scales, and you can shrug into balls that reflect a tiny light into a glitter of light. You have lots of love, you get excited to go to the nearest Locke. You want to jump in the light and dance together forever!

entries.zh: 炫光迪迪的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Dazzle Didi fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 使用光系技能后，回合结束时自己 返场 。
entries.en: After using a Light-type skill, return to the field at the end of the turn.

entries.zh: 古老物种在漫长的时间里发生演化，曾经独自栖息在安静与黑暗里面，偶尔靠敲击山石的回音和其他个体沟通。这让它们对声音无比敏感和渴望，它们拥有坚定的心，一直等到可以在光里热烈地表达。
entries.en: Ancient species evolved over a long period of time, once living alone in silence and darkness, occasionally communicating with the sound echoes of rocks and other individuals. This gives them great sensitivity and desire to sound, and they have a strong heart that waits until they can be enthusiastically expressed in light.

entries.zh: 鼻子和尾巴末端有个圆圆的结，走路时摇摇摆摆，肚子被敲出奇妙的鼓点，其他精灵们听到后不由自主地被吸引，跟着它的鼓点巡游。
entries.en: At the end of his nose and tail there is a round knot, he moves on his feet, his stomach is knocked out of an amazing drum point, and other elves are drawn to it uncontrollably, following its drum.

entries.zh: 小鼓象的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Little Drum Elephant fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 本回合与敌方使用的技能在系别/类型/能耗上每有1项相同，回合结束时获得物攻和物防永久+10%。
entries.en: For every 1 matching property between your skill and the opponent's this turn (type, category or energy cost), permanently gain +10% physical attack and physical defence at the end of the turn.

entries.zh: 经常把听到过的旋律一段一段地敲出来，但是它的记忆力不太好，经常把好几首曲子混在一起敲，发出谁也听不懂的节奏，只有巨鼓象自己敲得很起劲。有评论家说，虽然听不懂，但别有一番风味。
entries.en: It's always banging out a piece of the melody that you hear, but it doesn't have a good memory. It often mixes up songs and issues rhythms that no one can understand, except the drums who beat themselves. Some commentators say they don't understand, but don't smell it.

entries.zh: 总是一副亲切愉悦的样子，备受小洛克们的喜欢，但似乎在没人的时候它们不会展现出一丁点生气。曾经不分昼夜持续观测一年，且让样本知道自己被观测，期间样本呈现愉悦的状态。停止观测一小时后样本所有生命体征均消失。
entries.en: It's always nice and happy to be liked by Little Locke, but it doesn't seem like they're a bit angry when nobody else is there. There was one year of continuous observation, day and night, and the sample knew that it was being observed, and the samples were in a happy state. All vital signs disappeared after an hour.

entries.zh: 牵线木偶的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: String Puppet fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 可以携带多个复写/借用/取念技能，非幻系技能能耗-2。
entries.en: You can carry multiple Copy, Borrow or Thought Taking skills. Non-Illusion skills cost 2 less energy.

entries.zh: 非常偶然的情况下发现它们殴打自己身上闪烁着的微光的提线。提线中流动着强大魔力，以此来操纵结构精巧的木质结构身体，看似十分脆弱，但在幻系魔力的支撑下，有着令人意想不到的破坏力。
entries.en: It is quite accidental to find that they are beating the light of their own body. There is a powerful magic in the line to manipulate the delicate structure of the wood, which seems to be fragile, but it has unexpectedly destructive power supported by the magic of the illusion.

entries.zh: 心中怀揣着对魔法的强烈渴望和对广阔知识世界的向往，呱呱从玄玉岛来到魔法学院。咒语对它们来说就像绕口令，因此需要花费更多的时间来学习，在魔法学院的走廊，经常能看到它们带着歪歪扭扭的自学笔记飞奔的身影。
entries.en: With a strong desire for magic and a longing for the vast knowledge world, the spells have come to the Academy of Magic. For them, it is like an obscurantism, which requires more time to learn. In the corridors of the Institute of Magic, they are often seen running with twisted self-learning notes.

entries.zh: 学院呱呱的蛋 来源：参与活动「呱呱上学记」
entries.en: Academy Guagua egg. Source: Take part in the Guagua Goes to School event.

entries.zh: 自己全技能能耗+2，可以学习全部攻击技能石。
entries.en: All your skills cost 2 more energy. You can learn every Attack skill stone.

entries.zh: 喙部末端附着一层极硬的角质结构，快速啄击树干时能摩擦产生火星。经常能在林中看到它们一排排地啄树，似乎还没学会控制力度。被啄焦的树干是辨认这个种群栖息地的最好标志。
entries.en: At the end of the beak is attached to a very hard angular structure, so that when you hit the trunk quickly, you can rub Mars. Often see them in a row of trees in the forest, they don't seem to know how much to control it. A pecked trunk is the best sign for identifying this population habitat.

entries.zh: 烈钻鸟的果实 来源：完成烈钻鸟的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Blazing Drill Bird fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Blazing Drill Bird.

entries.zh: 每场战斗1次，受到致命伤害时保留1血，且敌方获得15层 灼烧 。
entries.en: Triggers 1 time per battle: when taking lethal damage, survive with 1 HP and inflict 15 stacks of Burn on the opponent.

entries.zh: 飞行时火焰席卷全身，在天空中拉出一道灼目的火痕。实际观测发现，它们的翅膀扇动频率远低于同体型鸟类，真正提供飞行推力的是尾部持续喷射的烈焰。
entries.en: When the flames swept all over the air, a burning flame was pulled out of the sky. Actual observations showed that their wings were fanning much less frequently than homogenous birds and that what really provided flight thrusts was a fire that continued to eject at the tail.

entries.zh: 整个种群中最罕见的形态，全身的火焰从未真正熄灭过。当生命走到新的阶段，它会主动飞向高空中最炽烈的那团火，将自己一同烧尽，而落在地面的那撮灰烬里，会诞生一枚新的蛋。
entries.en: The rarest form of an entire population, the flames of its whole body have never really been extinguished. When life has reached a new stage, it will fly to the hottest fire in the high air and burn itself together, and the ashes that fall on the ground will give birth to a new egg.

entries.zh: 每一只叮叮卯都对应古堡中的某一扇门。想打开那扇门？先抓住它。但它飞行轨迹极其刁钻。好奇心很重，有时候反而会主动凑近你观察，一伸手就飞走了，留下一串叮叮的嘲笑声。
entries.en: Every ding-ding corresponds to one of the gates in the castle. Wants to open that door? Grab it first, but its trajectory is extremely steep. Curiosity is so heavy that sometimes it comes to your attention, and it flies away with a string of jests.

entries.zh: 叮叮卯的果实 来源：完成叮叮卯的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Dingding Mao fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Dingding Mao.

entries.zh: 敌方本回合使用的技能，冷却1回合。
entries.en: The skill the opponent uses this turn enters a 1-turn cooldown.

entries.zh: 翅膀上的纹路变得更加复杂，据说纹路的图案和它守护的那扇门有关。它们会在飞行中观察追逐者，如果它主动落在你的手心里，恭喜你，是门后的秘密选中了你。
entries.en: The twilights on the wings are more complicated, and they are said to have a pattern associated with the door that it protects. They observe chasers in flight if it's in your heart. Congratulations, it was the secret behind the door that chose you.

entries.zh: 钳子其实还很脆弱，夹不碎太硬的东西。尾巴尖上粘着几块它从地底矿脉上敲下来的水晶，这可是非常厉害的成果，它见谁都举着尾巴，以此显示自己厉害。
entries.en: The pliers are still fragile, and they can't be broken too hard. They stick a few crystals on the tip of their tail that it knocks down from the ground veins. That's a really good result, because they see everyone holding their tails to show their strength.

entries.zh: 碎晶蝎的果实 来源：完成碎晶蝎的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Crystal-Shard Scorpion fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Crystal-Shard Scorpion.

entries.zh: 天气为 沙暴 时，自己获得速度+50。
不停锤炼自己，以获得更强的力量。它开始主动挑战占据优质矿脉的对手，被它占领过的矿脉上都留着深深的钳痕，就像是它们的签名。
entries.en: He kept hammering himself to gain greater strength. It began to challenge his rivals, who occupied the high-quality veins, with deep clamp marks on them, like their signatures.

entries.zh: 头上的王冠是它从地底最硬的矿石上凿下来自己戴上的，非常霸道，会霸占矿脉最好最显眼的地段趴着晒太阳，太阳让他的钳子拥有更强的力量。
entries.en: The crown on its head, which it carved down from the hardest ore on the ground, was very hegemonic and would take over the best and most visible segments of the veins and lay down in the sun, giving his pliers greater power.

entries.zh: “■■过处。■■生芽。” “不知■■。只觉世间常有新绿。” “■■，飘零。尚不知此言何意。” ——拓自巨人裂谷苔壁
entries.en: "I'm not sure where to go." "I don't know what to do. I just think there's always a new green in the world." "I'm not sure what that means."

entries.zh: 森豆丁的果实 来源：完成森豆丁的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Forest Beanling fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Forest Beanling.

entries.zh: 初始生命为10%，入场前己方精灵每使用1次草系技能，回复30%生命。
entries.en: Start with 10% HP. Before entering, restore 30% HP for every 1 Flora-type skill used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: “伤者愈，周遭同绿。” “连枝者参天。” “行过之处，枝连枝，根连根。” ——拓自巨人裂谷断崖
entries.en: "The wounded are getting worse, and the surroundings are green." "The branches come to heaven." "Where we pass, the branches go, the roots go."

entries.zh: “此地曾为荒石。有巨型精灵驻足，■■■■。” “草本同春，荣枯有时。三者相依，■■广袤；各自孤生，沦为■■。” ——一处比较新的草系氏族笔触刻凿痕迹
entries.en: "This place was a desolate stone. There were giant elves standing on their feet and giving birth to them." "The herbs are in the same spring, and at times they die.

entries.zh: 额前的闪电印记平时并不蕴含电能，可一旦周围响起音乐，便会迅速通体带电。常能看见三两只聚在一处，一边蹦跳一边迸出细小的电火花，这是它们正在彼此充电。
entries.en: The flash marks on the forehead do not contain electrical energy, but when music rings around them, they quickly tweak. They can often see three or two in one place, jumping and throwing small sparks, which are charging each other.

entries.zh: 霹雳宝宝的果实 来源：完成霹雳宝宝的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Thunder Baby fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Thunder Baby.

entries.zh: 天气为 雷鸣 时，使用电系技能后敌方获得引电。
entries.en: During Thunder weather, inflict Electricity Attraction on the opponent after using an Electric-type skill.

entries.zh: 在野外撞见它们时，总能听见断断续续的哼唱，谁也听不出是什么曲子，却莫名洗脑。它们其实是在用声音与旋律交谈，每一段哼唱里都藏着想要递给同伴的话。
entries.en: When they run into them in the wild, they hear broken groanings and no one can hear it, but they brainwash themselves. They actually talk to melody with their voices, every piece of humming hides what they want to deliver to their peers.

entries.zh: 歌声与电能已经完全融为一体，群体齐唱时，对其他种族而言那是一场雷暴，对它们而言只是一次合唱，某位魔法学院爱音乐的老师曾经评价它们：曲子很好听，也很致命。
entries.en: Singing and electricity have been completely integrated, and when groups sing together, it is a thunderstorm for other races. For them, it's just a symphony. A teacher at the Academy of Magic who loves music once commented on them: they are beautiful and deadly.

entries.zh: 白色绒毛软得像刚落的新雪，非常温顺，会安安静静地跟在洛克身后，偶尔用湿凉的鼻尖轻轻碰一下洛克的手，它很乐意被洛克抱着、被摸头、被带着散步。
entries.en: The white velvet is as soft as fresh snow, very gentle, and will follow Locke in peace and quiet and occasionally touch Locke's hand with a damp nose. It would be happy to be held, touched and taken for walks.

entries.zh: 雪灵兽的果实 来源：完成雪灵兽的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Snow Spirit Beast fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Snow Spirit Beast.

entries.zh: 天气为 暴风雪 时，冰系技能威力+100%。
entries.en: During Blizzard weather, Ice-type skills gain +100% power.

entries.zh: 体型长大了一些，白毛更浓密，它依然允许洛克靠近，但是已经学会了要保持一点距离。它有时候会突然停下来，抬头嗅着风中的气息，眼睛里掠过一丝野性。
entries.en: It's a little older, it's thicker, it still allows Locke to get close, but it learns to keep a little distance. Sometimes it stops suddenly, smells the wind, and its eyes are swept across the wild.

entries.zh: 暴风雪来的时候它们会迎着风跑出去，它以雪为食，等风暴过去，又会安静地回到洛克身边，它们的眼睛里比小时候多了许多丰富的情绪，不曾改变的是一份从未消失的倔强。
entries.en: When the storm comes, they go out against the wind. It feeds on the snow. When the storm passes, they return quietly to Locke. Their eyes are much richer than they were when they were children. What has never changed is a stubbornness that has never disappeared.

entries.zh: 滚烫的岩石对这个种群而言就是皮球，它们会把熔岩抱着、滚着、互相砸着玩。它们不明白为什么其他精灵和洛克看到它们就跑。想跟外族打招呼时会双拳碰击，但这个动作至今被误读为宣战——因此火系部族的“社交”几乎全部以战斗收场。
entries.en: The hot rocks are skinballs for this population, and they hold, roll, and play with each other. They don't understand why other elves and Locke run when they see them. When they want to say hello to foreigners, they hit them with both fists, but the move has so far been misread as a declaration of war — so that the “socialization” of the fire clan almost all ends in battle.

entries.zh: 火豆丁的果实 来源：完成火豆丁的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Fire Beanling fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Fire Beanling.

entries.zh: 入场前己方精灵每使用1次火系技能，获得攻防+10%，速度+10。（最多触发10次）
entries.en: Before entering, gain +10% attack and defence and +10 speed for every 1 Fire-type skill used by an allied creature. Triggers at most 10 times.

entries.zh: 群体活动时，方圆百米内都会火星四溅。它们觉得这很热闹，完全不理解附近的精灵为什么会逃走。它们偶尔会把熔岩块扔向其他部族当打招呼，三族争斗大多是这么挑起的。
entries.en: In mass events, Mars is sprouted around a hundred metres away. They think it's hot and they don't understand why the nearby elves are running away. They occasionally throw lava blocks at other tribes to say hello, which is how most of the three struggles were provoked.

entries.zh: 躯体中流淌着不灭的岩浆，是巨人裂谷中破坏力最强的种群，实际整座山体的热源都来自于它们，不论是山下的温泉，还是热流，都源于它们无意间溢出的热量。
entries.en: The magma running through the body is the most destructive population in the Giants Rift, and the heat of the entire mountain comes from them. Both the hot springs under the mountains and the hot currents come from the heat that they accidentally spill.

entries.zh: 对它来说世界上没有陌生的洛克，只有还没认识的朋友。只要对它微笑一下，它头顶的光圈就会闪一闪，然后它会非常认真地记住这个小洛克。
entries.en: There's no stranger to Locke in the world, only friends who haven't known him yet. Just smile at it and the halo on its head will flash, and then it'll remember that little Rock very carefully.

entries.zh: 友爱天天的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Friendly Tiantian fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，双方队伍中的所有精灵回复1能量。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, every creature on both teams restores 1 energy.

entries.zh: 它们相信友谊不会消失，而会变成星星。积攒了足够多的友谊之后，这些关于友谊的愿力汇聚成了它尾部的一颗星。洛克触碰它们的星星后，能想起彼此陪伴中开心的事情。
entries.en: They believe that friendship will not disappear, but will become stars. With enough friendship, these hopes for friendship have come together as a star at the end of it. Locke has touched their stars to remember things that are happy with each other.

entries.zh: 透明的小身体里能看到水在不停地转啊转，它总是开心地扭来扭去。有时候睡一觉就长大了，再睡一觉又回到了小时候，它对此毫不困扰，哪里都可以是新的起点。
entries.en: The transparent little body can see the water going around and around, and it's always twisting and twisting. Sometimes it grows up and gets back to being a child, and it doesn't bother it. It can be a new start anywhere.

entries.zh: 莫比乌乌的果实 来源：通过洛克里安省智慧树苗的考验获得
entries.en: Mobiu fruit. Source: Pass the Wisdom Sapling trial in Lockrian Province.

entries.zh: 回合结束时，若自己的能量为0，则回复10能量。
entries.en: At the end of the turn, if you have 0 energy, restore 10 energy.

entries.zh: 变大之后逐渐能控制身体中能量的循环，像推动一条流动的河，没有源头也没有尽头，它只是慢慢地看生命循环往复。
entries.en: Growing up, it gradually controls the circulation of energy in the body, like driving a flowing river with no source or end, but only slowly looking back at the life cycle.

entries.zh: 总是缩在某个角落里不知道在想些什么，看似脑袋空空双眼无神，一副呆呆的样子。额头上第三只眼睛不是用来作为视觉器官，而是用来探测魔法能量的痕迹，使用时需要放空所有杂念。
entries.en: It's always in a corner where you don't know what to think, and it looks like your head is empty and your eyes are dumb. The third eye on your forehead is not used as a visual organ, it's used to detect traces of magic energy, and it needs to be used without all the distractions.

entries.zh: 瑰眼仔的果实 来源：完成瑰眼仔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Rose-Eyed Pup fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Rose-Eyed Pup.

entries.zh: 自己或其他精灵 离场 时，自己与更换入场的精灵交换血量百分比。
entries.en: When you or another creature leaves the field, exchange your HP percentage with that of the replacement entering the field.

entries.zh: 耳边的翎毛可以隔绝大部分声音，听力很差很差。研究人员从翎毛的特征入手进行分析，发现其在越嘈杂的环境下眼中的魔力越强。
entries.en: The hair on the ear can isolate most of the voices and have poor hearing. Researchers begin by analysing the features of the hair, finding it more magical in their eyes in an increasingly noisy environment.

entries.zh: 原来它们一直在通过魔法感知高纬度能量，是十分谨慎的种族，甚至睡眠时间极短，常处于高度紧张的戒备状态。通过极短的间歇性闭目养神回复第三只眼睛中的魔力。
entries.en: It turns out that they've been using magic to sense high-latitude energy, very cautious races and even very short sleep periods, often in a state of high stress. React to the magic of the third eye through extremely short intermittent closed eyes.

entries.zh: 常出现在垃圾堆和阴暗潮湿的洞穴里，常看到它们同类之间碰碰鼻子交流。看起来似乎是鼻子的部分用来放出声波探测周围信息，对味道的感知几近于零。
entries.en: They're often found in garbage dumps and dark, wet caves where they have contact with each other. It looks like the part of the nose is used to release sound waves to detect information around them, and the smell is almost zero.

entries.zh: 觅觅蝠的果实 来源：完成觅觅蝠的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Seeking Bat fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Seeking Bat.

entries.zh: 携带的翼系攻击技能获得 选择 ：能耗+1，攻击时 吸血 50%。
entries.en: Your carried Wing-type attack skills gain Choice: cost +1 energy and gain 50% lifesteal when attacking.

entries.zh: 声波探测的范围变大了，专门翻找被其他精灵丢弃的东西。它们的鼻子能穿透层层堆积物精确定位目标，找到好东西后会兴奋地跟同伴碰鼻分享消息。
entries.en: The range of sound waves has grown to look for things that are discarded by other elves. Their noses have been able to locate the target precisely through layers of layers, and when they find good things, they can be excited to share information with their peers.

entries.zh: 一到天黑就集体出动，在夜空中无声地滑翔游荡。声波探测让它们在纯黑环境中如鱼得水。附近居民吓唬小小洛克说天黑不回家的话会被夜游魔吃掉。某些个体对此表示不赞同。
entries.en: The sound waves make them look like fish in a pure black environment. Residents around here scare Little Locke to say that nightwalkers will eat him if he doesn't come home in the dark. Some people do not agree with it.

entries.zh: 该种群的幼体已经展现出极强的领地排他性。眼球还很脆弱，几乎全天处于睡眠状态，但头顶的芽始终保持警戒，它们通过头顶的芽感受和接收外界一切信息。
entries.en: The larvae of the population has shown great territorial exclusion. Eyeballs are still fragile and sleepy almost all day, but the buds above their heads remain vigilant and they sense and receive everything from outside through the buds above their head.

entries.zh: 芽眼魔的果实 来源：完成芽眼魔的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Bud-Eye Demon fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Bud-Eye Demon.

entries.zh: 天气为 雨天 时，使用水系攻击技能时 吸血 50%。
entries.en: During Rain, your Water-type attack skills gain 50% lifesteal.

entries.zh: 如果你不幸走进了叶眼魔的领地，你会注意到空气中有一种异样的压迫感，好像被很多眼睛同时审视着，从不同角度同时锁定你。
entries.en: If you have unfortunately entered the territory of Leaf-Eye, you will notice that there is a different sense of oppression in the air, as if it had been looked at by many eyes and locked from different angles.

entries.zh: 小心了！被它们注视一分钟就会浑身起疹子！研究员如是说。遇到它们最明智的做法是缓慢后退，不要发出任何响声，直到缓慢退出它们的领地。
entries.en: Watch out! They'll get rashes for a minute. Fellows say it. The wisest way to meet them is to slow down and not make any noise until they withdraw from their territory.

entries.zh: 没有人知道这个种群从哪里来。它们总是独自出现在山顶或旷野中，对着夜空静坐。有幻系学者推测它们是在接收星云中某种信息，也有洛克认为，它们是很久以前被许愿召唤下来的，只是忘记了回去的路。
entries.en: No one knows where this stock comes from. They always appear alone at the top of a mountain or in the wilderness, sitting quietly in the night sky. There are hallucinogenic scholars who assume that they are receiving some kind of message from a nebula, and Locke think that they were summoned long ago by a wish, just forgetting their way back.

entries.zh: 星云旅者的果实 来源：完成星云旅者的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Nebula Traveller fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Nebula Traveller.

entries.zh: 攻击时，将敌方所有 印记 变为相同层数的 星陨印记 。
entries.en: When attacking, convert all the opponent's Marks into an equal number of Meteor Marks.

entries.zh: 它天生看不得任何脏东西，会忍不住吐出小泡泡去擦，但力道和数量都控制不好，经常把别人的窝弄得到处是泡沫，对每一个角落都要检查一遍，被赶走的话会露出十分委屈的表情。
entries.en: It was born to see nothing dirty and to spit out bubbles for rubbing, but its strength and quantity were not well controlled, it often made bubbles available to others, examined every corner, and it showed a very disconcerting face when driven away.

entries.zh: 点点的果实 来源：完成点点的图鉴课题获得
entries.en: Diandian fruit. Source: Complete the compendium task for Diandian.

entries.zh: 自己或其他精灵 离场 时，更换入场的精灵获得 萌化 。
entries.en: When you or another creature leaves the field, the replacement gains Cutification.

entries.zh: 从慌慌张张的小学徒长成了真正的大管家，举手投足都透着从容，泡泡会落在需要清洁的地方，它对自己负责的空间有极强的领地意识，不许其他精灵把打扫好的地方弄乱。
entries.en: The young apprentices who have grown from panic and panic have become real butlers, with their hands raised and their feet dropped into places that need to be cleaned. They have a strong territorial awareness of the space for which they are responsible, and other elves are not allowed to mess up areas where they clean up.

entries.zh: 曾因机械禁令而被囚禁，胆怯已经刻进了这个种群的本能。遇到危险时它们会加速或减慢表盘指针转动，副作用是局部时间流速短暂错乱。曾有守卫追赶一只不咕钟，自觉只跑了十几秒，抬头发现已经是黄昏。
entries.en: Once imprisoned for mechanical prohibitions, timidness has been carved into the instincts of this population. When they are in danger, they accelerate or slow the rotation of their tablet needles, with the side effect of a brief breakdown of local time flow speed. Guards have chased a non-comotion clock, feeling that they only ran for a dozen seconds and found it to be dusk.

entries.zh: 不咕钟的果实 来源：探索不咕钟的守护地获得
entries.en: Silent Cuckoo Clock fruit. Source: Explore the Silent Cuckoo Clock guardian area.

entries.zh: 每场战斗1次，回合结束时，若自己累计消耗的能量恰好为12，则回满能量和生命。
entries.en: Triggers 1 time per battle: at the end of the turn, if your cumulative energy expenditure is exactly 12, fully restore HP and energy.

entries.zh: 飞起来时摇摇晃晃的，翅膀会发出“嘎吱”声，像是旧手工造物，实际拥有少量扭转时间的能量，会边发出“布谷”的声音，能短暂扭曲周围的小范围时间，让追逐者的动作变迟缓。
entries.en: When they fly, their wings make a "creaking" sound, like old hand-made objects that actually have a small amount of energy to turn the time around, and at the same time, they make a "bullk" sound that briefly distorts the small range of time around them and slows the chasers' movements.

entries.zh: 圆滚滚的身体可以吃掉很多可可果也藏着很多神秘的魔法，据说它能实现人心底的愿望，但它自己却不太清楚。喜欢跟在洛克周围转悠，湿漉漉的大眼睛似乎盯着洛克书包里的可可果，又似乎是别的什么东西。
entries.en: The rounded body can eat a lot of cocoa and hide a lot of mystic magic, which is said to give people what they want, but it's not quite clear to itself. It likes to follow Locke around, wet eyes seem to be staring at the cocoa fruit in Locke's book bag and something else.

entries.zh: 加灵的蛋 来源：完成「铅字幻梦」赛季作业
entries.en: Jialing egg. Source: Complete the Typecast Dream seasonal assignment.

entries.zh: 使用「 选择 」技能后，会额外使用1次另一种「选择」效果。使用任意技能后，该技能冷却1回合。
entries.en: After using a Choice skill, also use its other Choice effect 1 time. After any skill is used, it enters a 1-turn cooldown.

entries.zh: 似乎能分辨愿望的颜色，开心的愿望是香香的粉黄色，难过的愿望是苦苦的紫黑色。它总是涂一些谁都看不懂的线条，不止在纸上涂。曾因为四处涂鸦被保洁阿姨警告过，后诚恳道歉，并在阿姨门前摆放整整十个可可果表达歉意。
entries.en: It seems to be able to distinguish between the colours of wishes: happy desires are fragrant pink and sad desires are bitter purple and black. It always wears lines that no one can read, not just on paper. The aunt warned about the graffiti, apologized sincerely and put ten whole cocoa fruit in front of her aunt's door.

entries.zh: 传说能够实现愿望，其实是每天只会吃东西打瞌睡的小小精灵。偶尔转转悠悠，如果没人看着可能会走去很远的地方，凭借着直觉和本能生活了很久很久。什么是直觉的来源呢？是许愿的声音吗？
entries.en: The legend is that it is the little elves who eat and drowse every day. Sometimes, if no one looks at it, they may go far away and live long enough with their instincts and instincts. What is the source of their intuition? Is the voice of a wish?

entries.zh: 没有人知道它是从哪里出现的，它和加尔共用一具身体。眼珠滴溜溜地转，它聪明又凌厉，曾经严肃指出不是所有可可果它都喜欢，它明确表示不喜欢软的可可果，脆脆的口感才是最好的。
entries.en: No one knows where it came from, and it shares a body with Gale. The eye drops slip through, it's smart, it's tough, it's serious about not all cocoa, it doesn't like it, it makes clear that it doesn't like soft cocoa, but it's the crispy taste.

entries.zh: 使用「 选择 」技能后，会额外使用1次相同的「选择」效果。使用任意技能后，该技能冷却1回合。
entries.en: After using a Choice skill, also use the same Choice effect 1 additional time. After any skill is used, it enters a 1-turn cooldown.

entries.zh: 古老的童话故事里面写道：如果战胜了一千只鼠精灵，就可以得到咬咬小子家族的认可。咬咬小子们似乎没听过这个故事，它们经常在路口站岗、巡逻，鼠精灵也在他们的保护范围内。
entries.en: The old fairy tale says, "If you beat a thousand elves, you can get the approval of the Bite Boy family. The Bite Boys do not seem to have heard this story, they often stand at the intersection and patrol, and the Smurf are within their protection."

entries.zh: 咬咬小子的果实 来源：幻梦通行证获得
entries.en: Biting Kid fruit. Source: Dream Pass reward.

entries.zh: 双方场上每有1种不同的 增益 ，自己获得物防+20%。
entries.en: Gain +20% physical defence for every 1 distinct buff present across both sides of the field.

entries.zh: 胡桃王子喜欢巡逻，巡逻途中偶尔会顺手把迷路的小精灵护送回家，也会挡在受惊的洛克面前。即使没有任何契约关系，胡桃王子们自发地守护着整条街道。
entries.en: Prince walnuts like to patrol, and occasionally escort lost elves back home on the road, and they stand in the way of frightened Locke. Even if there is no contractual relationship, Prince walnuts guard the entire street spontaneously.

entries.zh: 古老的童话故事里面写道：有一种被施了魔法的鸟精灵，每个夜晚都必须在月光下起舞，不然家族会遭遇不幸。足尖元件们似乎在轮班排练，动作还稍显稚嫩笨拙，随着旋转发出叮咚叮咚的曲调。
entries.en: An ancient fairy tale says, "There is a bird elf who has been enchanted and must dance at the moon every night, or the family will suffer. The foottips seem to be rehearsing in shifts, acting slightly naively and clumsyly, with the tune of a jingle on the spin."

entries.zh: 足尖元件的果实 来源：幻梦通行证获得
entries.en: Toe Component fruit. Source: Dream Pass reward.

entries.zh: 双方场上每有1种不同的 印记 ，自己获得魔攻+50%。
entries.en: Gain +50% magical attack for every 1 distinct Mark present across both sides of the field.

entries.zh: 在月光好的夜晚，成群的离心舞者聚在湖边旋转，远远看去像一场盛大的舞会——目击洛克说，离心舞者的舞蹈能跳出旋律，旋律像一场美梦，梦里讲述着，湖水、月光和一只银白色的鸟。
entries.en: On the bright night of the moon, a crowd of centrifuge dancers came to spin by the lake and looked far away as a big ball — the sight of Locke said that the dance of the centrifugal dancers could come out of the melody, like a dream that told, the water of the lake, the moonlight and a silver-white bird.

entries.zh: 它们坚信自己是夜晚的国王，项圈是它的王冠。每天日落后就出门巡视领地，把沿途看到的硬币、纽扣、碎玻璃一切闪亮的东西都带回窝里，当作臣民的贡品。
entries.en: They believe in themselves as kings of the night, and their collars as crowns. Every day they go after them to patrol the land and bring back to their nest all the brightness of the coins, buttons, broken glass that they see along the way, as a tribute to their subjects.

entries.zh: 蝴蝶陶陶的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Butterfly Taotao fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每完整使用1次「 选择 」技能（「明」和「暗」各1次），自己入场时获得物攻+40%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +40% physical attack for every 1 complete allied use of a Choice skill, comprising 1 use each of its Light and Dark choices.

entries.zh: 自封的国王现在有了配得上野心的武器：锋利的毒爪。它们夜间行动变得更加隐秘和高效，能在对方毫无察觉时把东西拿走，等对方发现时只剩爪印和一点残留的麻痹感。
entries.en: Self-proclaimed kings now have arms worthy of ambition: sharp poison claws. Their night actions become more secret and efficient, taking things away when the other side does not know anything, and when the other side finds out, it only has paw marks and a bit of residual paralysis.

entries.zh: 某些地区真正的统治者，修长的身影在夜色中几乎无声，它不再需要去偷任何东西，崇拜者主动献上闪亮的礼物。爪爪大人如果遇见认可的洛克，也愿意慷慨地给点赏赐。
entries.en: The true rulers of some areas, the long body, are almost silent in the night, and it no longer needs to steal anything; worshippers offer bright gifts. If Lord Claw meets Acquainted Locke, he is willing to give something generously.

entries.zh: 体内积蓄着高压的热能，需要经历一次足够猛烈的高温才能进化。田野里偶尔传来的“砰”一声闷响，多半是哪只不走运的精灵踩到了它。村民们在收割季都互相提醒多看脚下，别踩鼓起来的苞米仔。
entries.en: The body has high-pressure heat, and it needs to go through enough heat to evolve. Occasionally "bang" from the fields stutters, most of them lucky elves have stepped on it. Villagers look at each other at their feet during the harvest season.

entries.zh: 苞米仔的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Corn Pup fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 草系技能使敌方获得4层 灼烧 ，火系技能使敌方获得1层 寄生 。
entries.en: Your Flora-type skills inflict 4 stacks of Burn on the opponent. Your Fire-type skills inflict 1 stack of Parasitism.

entries.zh: 田野里最吵的精灵，噼里啪啦的爆裂声是它们的开场白，能自行生成高温玉米粒，枪口永远冒着热气。它的信条是：先开枪，再打招呼。打完招呼，再开一枪。
entries.en: The loudest elves in the field, the cracking sound of a puncture, were their opening words, producing high-temperature corn grains, and the gun was always hot. Its creed was to shoot first and say hi. Say hello and shoot again.

entries.zh: 传说它们出生在连光都沉不到的深渊底部，身上有一道还不太清晰的十字纹路，体型很小，这里的水压大到同类精灵根本待不住，但它不觉得苦，每天都在拼命往上游一点点。
entries.en: The legends say they were born at the bottom of a abyss where light was not even able to sink, and they had a little less clear cross-cart road, small in size, where the water was so high that the elves couldn't stay, but it did not feel bitter and struggled every day for a little more upstream.

entries.zh: 十字蝌蚪的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Cross Tadpole fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 每回合各1次，获得 增益 时，同时获得全技能能耗-1，获得 减益 时，同时获得全技能能耗+1。
entries.en: Each effect triggers 1 time per turn: gaining a buff also reduces all skill energy costs by 1; gaining a debuff also increases all skill energy costs by 1.

entries.zh: 从深渊底层一层一层地闯上来，会向一切挡路的精灵宣战，不管对方多大。额头的十字纹变得清晰有力，像一枚代表荣耀的徽章刻在身上。
entries.en: Coming up from the bottom layer of the abyss will declare war on every elf who stands in the way, no matter how big. The crosses on the forehead have become clear and strong, carved like a badge of glory.

entries.zh: 它们终于站在阳光下了。身上的十字纹被光照得发亮，那是从深渊底部一直带上来的印记。不再需要向谁证明什么，也不需要任何帮助，它们骨子里的斗志永远不会消失。
entries.en: They finally stand under the sun. The crosses are lit with light, a mark that comes from the bottom of the abyss. There is no longer any need to prove anything to anyone and no need for help, and the struggles in their bones will never disappear.

entries.zh: 能够生产出纺线的精灵，纺线主要由卡波体内的蛋白质和唾液构成。卡波的唾液中带有某种未知诅咒，即使是同类触碰到的话也会中毒陷入昏睡。
entries.en: Smurfs who can produce swirling lines, which consist mainly of proteins and saliva from Capo's body. Carbo's saliva contains an unknown curse that poisons even when the same person touches it.

entries.zh: 卡波的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Kabo fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 每受到1次技能攻击（不含连击），敌方获得1层 暗涌印记 。
entries.en: For every 1 skill attack you take, excluding extra hits, inflict 1 Undercurrent Mark on the opponent.

entries.zh: 据传说卡拉波斯曾经是一个仙子，因为误会诅咒过一位公主，被诅咒反噬后变为纺锤的模样。一次最多能够拉出7000米纺线。当体内的蛋白质耗尽的时候，它们就不会再进行任何活动陷入长久的昏睡中。
entries.en: Legend says Karabos was once a fairy who cursed a princess because of a misunderstanding. When the curse rebounded, it transformed into a spindle. It can draw out up to 7000 metres of thread at once. When its internal protein runs out, it ceases all activity and falls into a long sleep.

entries.zh: 据说它曾经是城堡里一位小骑士，或者至少它自己是这么认为的。不知道是谁的魔法让它变成了一截蜡烛的模样，但它好像并不太在意，依然坚守骑士的职责，在城堡巡逻，用两只小手护住火焰。
entries.en: It was said to have been a little knight in the castle, or at least it thought it was. The magic of someone who turned it into a candle seemed to be unmindful and still held to the knight's duty to patrol the castle and guard the flame with two small hands.

entries.zh: 守夜烛的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Nightwatch Candle fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 携带的火系技能获得 选择 ：使用后失去15%生命，光系技能威力永久+30。
entries.en: Carried Fire-type skills gain Choice: after use, lose 15% HP and permanently increase Light-type skill power by 30.

entries.zh: 蜡泪在身上层层叠叠凝固成了铠甲的形状，火焰也不再随时会灭，而是稳定明亮的光柱，足以照亮整条长廊。作为蜡烛精灵，它们能在最黑的夜里给出最亮的光，这让它们非常满足。
entries.en: Tears of wax coagulate into the shape of a armor, and the flame will no longer be extinguished at any time. Instead, it is a stable light column that brightens the entire gallery. As candle spirits, they can give the brightest light in the darkest night, which makes them very satisfying.
