entries.zh: “洛克洛克，告诉我， 谁是林中最甜的果？” “是你，是你，比蜜更甜，比血更红， 比玛丽女王手心的那颗还要圆”。 “那为什么没洛克来摘我？” “别急，别急，会有风来摘。”
entries.en: "Locklock, tell me, who's the sweetest fruit in the woods?" "You, sweeter than honey, more red than blood, more round than the one of Mary's hands." "Why didn't Locke pick me up?" "Don't worry.

entries.zh: 蜜果骸的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Honeyfruit Husk fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己的聚能获得 选择 ：偷取敌方3能量。
entries.en: Your Gather Energy gains Choice: steal 3 energy from the opponent.

entries.zh: “洛克洛克，告诉我， 我还甜吗？” “比从前更甜，比糖更黏。” “那我还圆吗？” “比从前更圆，比月更满。” “洛克洛克，告诉我， 腐朽的果还有人摘吗？”
entries.en: "Rocklock, tell me, am I still sweet?" "Sweeter than ever, more sticky than sugar." "So am I rounder?" "More round than ever, more full than the moon." "Locklock, tell me, is there anyone who picks the rotten fruit?"

entries.zh: 原本只是农场里普通的稻草人，因为被洛克们日复一日地打招呼、聊天、玩猜拳，某天清晨它动了动指头，发现自己可以从木架上走下来。最喜欢猜拳，因为这是它学会的第一件事。
entries.en: It was just a normal scarecrow on the farm, because Lockers greeted him day after day, chatting and playing boxing, and one morning it moved its finger and found itself walking down from a wooden rack. It's the first thing it learned.

entries.zh: 稻草人的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Scarecrow fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己防御应对成功时，敌方获得 萌化 。
entries.en: After your successful defensive response, inflict Cutification on the opponent.

entries.zh: 在被洛克们陪伴了足够久之后，“想要保护这里”的心情终于强大到改变了它的身体。稻草变得紧实如肌肉，布裹的拳头沉重有力，现在没有任何飞禽敢靠近它守护的农场，但对洛克们，它永远温柔。据说猜拳会故意输给洛克。
entries.en: After long enough to be accompanied by the Lockers, the feeling of “wanting to protect this place” was so strong that it changed its body. The straw became as tight as the muscles, the fists were heavy and powerful, and now no bird dared to approach the farm it guarded, but for Lockers, it was always gentle. It was said that guesswork would lose deliberately to Locke.

entries.zh: 身体会散发烤栗子一样的香甜气味，同行的另一名研究员舔过之后中毒几日没有好转。有洛克曾研究过不同天气和环境里其粘液的味道变化，立志写出《栗鼠粘液美味大全》。
entries.en: The body smells like chestnuts, and another fellow researcher licks it for days and does not get better. Locke has studied the taste of his slime in different weather and environment, and he writes "The Chemster's slime is delicious."

entries.zh: 栗鼠的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Chestnut Mouse fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 每受到1次技能攻击（不含连击），敌方获得1层 棘刺印记 。
entries.en: For every 1 skill attack you take, excluding extra hits, inflict 1 Thorn Mark on the opponent.

entries.zh: 会嗅来嗅去寻找花蜜，吃的花蜜越多，鼻子分泌的粘液越香甜，并且带着花香的味道。会用鼻子把身上的毒刺都涂满香甜粘液。毛毛舔过它们却不会中毒，真奇怪。
entries.en: Sniffing to find nectar, eating more nectar, the sweeter the slime from the nose, and the smell of the flowers. Sniffs all the poisons on your body with sweet viscos. It's strange that hair licks them without poisoning.

entries.zh: 天气暖和的时候，不由自主地犯困，常常在睡铃丛生的区域睡觉，柔软的绒毛吸附了睡铃的香气。入夜后香气越发浓郁，常常看到它身边也围着一圈睡得很沉的精灵。
entries.en: When the weather warms up, they make their own traps, often sleep in bed-belled areas, soft fur snores with the smell of sleeping bells. After night, the scent becomes more intense and it is often seen around a circle of sleepy elves.

entries.zh: 睡铃雪影娃娃的蛋 来源：参与活动「花园里的秘密礼物」
entries.en: Sleepbell Snowshadow Doll egg. Source: Take part in the Secret Gift in the Garden event.

entries.zh: 王国入夜后，进入战斗时获得全技能能耗+2，回合结束时自己回复5%生命和1能量。
entries.en: After nightfall in the kingdom, enter battle with all skill energy costs increased by 2. At the end of the turn, restore 5% HP and 1 energy.

entries.zh: 宝藏小狐是一种从容的精灵，即使被其他精灵咬到，也可以保持冷静。它大大的眼睛中，蕴含着深邃的平静。
entries.en: A treasure fox is a stupendous elf, who can remain calm even if bitten by other jinns. In its large eyes there is a deep calm.

entries.zh: 宝藏小狐果实 来源：活动获取
entries.en: Little Treasure Fox fruit. Source: Event reward.

entries.zh: 在场时，识破精灵的变化效果，解除其伪装。
entries.en: While on the field, reveal creatures' transformation effects and remove their disguises.

entries.zh: 只有看到虫系精灵的时候会双眼放光，经常出现在虫群附近，爪子摩挲着没见过的虫，嘴巴里嘟嘟囔囔说着什么。实习研究员遇到不认识的虫都会去给它看看。直到学院反复重申：野外考察作业务必独立完成。
entries.en: It's only when you see the elves of worms that they shine their eyes, often near the bugs, with claws in their mouths that don't even know them. The interns show them to them when they meet the bugs they don't know. Until the college repeats: the field study must be done independently.

entries.zh: 迷雾森林曾经的原住民，如今已在卡洛西亚大陆几乎绝迹。胸口嵌着一颗黄色宝石，据说封着一股来历不明的力量。它们沉默寡言，独自穿行于林间的雾气之中，遇到别的精灵便远远绕开，一整个白天都说不上一句话。
entries.en: The natives of the mist forests are now virtually extinct on the land of Carocia. A yellow stone is embedded in their chests, allegedly containing an unknown force. They walk alone through the fog between the trees and meet other elves, and they cannot speak a word throughout the day.

entries.zh: 诅咒狼灵的蛋 来源：完成「月涌狂想」赛季作业
entries.en: Cursed Wolf Spirit egg. Source: Complete the Moon Surge Rhapsody seasonal assignment.

entries.zh: 获得自己击败的精灵的特性，每次攻击后自己失去5%生命。
entries.en: Gain the trait of creatures you defeat. Lose 5% HP after each attack.

entries.zh: 在有月亮的夜里，光芒会顺着它们胸前毛发的边缘缓缓流淌。它开始学会踏着月光潜行，落地几乎无声。仍是独来独往，很少与其他精灵哪怕是同族并肩行动，即便在同一片林子里遇见，也只是遥遥对望一眼便各自离开。
entries.en: On the night of the moon, the light flows along the edges of their hair on their chests. It begins to learn to walk by the moon and land almost silently. It remains so alone that it rarely acts side by side with other elves, even if they meet in the same forest, but looks at each other and leaves.

entries.zh: 独自行走的离群之狼，月缺时它力量最弱，只是安静地趴在某块山石上休息。月圆那一夜，它会从月光最亮的地方走出来。当你看见银月狼王的时候，它已经看了你很久了，如果挥手打招呼的话，它也只是远远的点头致意。
entries.en: The lone wolf who walks alone has the weakest power when the moon is short, but just sits quietly on a rock. On the night of the full moon, it comes out from the brightest part of the moon. When you see the Silver Moon Wolf, it looks at you for a long time, and if you wave to greet him, it just nods away.

entries.zh: 月光下很难看到新月鹭，它们会融入月光在水面的倒影里，啄水里的月光。月亮躲进云里时，才发现岸边一直站着一只缩着脖子的新月鹭，好像刚才什么都没发生。
entries.en: It's hard to see a new moon in the moonlight, and they'll fit into the reflection of the moon on the surface, and they'll peck the moon in the water. When the moon hides in the clouds, it's just that the shore has been standing around a new moon with its neck shrunk, as if nothing had happened.

entries.zh: 新月鹭的果实 来源：月涌通行证获得
entries.en: Crescent Heron fruit. Source: Moon Surge Pass reward.

entries.zh: 若上回合双方有精灵使用翼系技能，本回合自己携带的冰系技能威力+100%。
entries.en: If either side used a Wing-type skill last turn, your carried Ice-type skills gain +100% power this turn.

entries.zh: 月辉鹭蹲在水面的月亮倒影上，一动不动，就像在孵月亮。有的洛克相信月亮发光不是因为月亮自己会发光，是因为有月辉鹭蹲着把光芒传输给月亮，也有洛克持相反态度。
entries.en: The moon's beetle sits on the reflection of the moon on the surface, as if it were hatching. Some Locke believes that the moon glows not because the moon itself shines, but because there are moons beams to pass the light to the moon and Locke has the opposite attitude.

entries.zh: 月使鹭纳出没的地方，天上的月亮只剩一道细弧。月光全在它们身上，它们是这片湖区最亮的夜晚光源。等到它们换羽的日子，羽毛上的月光会跟着脱落，洒回天上，月亮又会重新变圆。
entries.en: And the moon brings forth its land, and there is only a fine arc of the moon in the sky. The moonlight is all over them, and they are the brightest light of the night in this lake region. And when they change feathers, the moon on their feathers will fall down, spilling back into the sky, and the moon will re-emerge.

entries.zh: 洛克走过湿地时，会让热团团带路。只有热团团走过的路面踩上去暖和，别的精灵也会沿着这条路暖身子，久而久之就形成了新的路线。热团团不知道这些，缩一团歇着呢。
entries.en: When Locke walks through the wetlands, he lets the heat packs lead the way. Only the road passed by the heat group steps on and warms up, and other elves warm themselves along it, creating a new route for a long time. The heat group doesn't know about this.

entries.zh: 热团团的果实 来源：月涌通行证获得
entries.en: Heat Puff fruit. Source: Moon Surge Pass reward.

entries.zh: 若上回合双方有精灵使用火系技能，本回合自己携带的虫系技能威力+100%。
entries.en: If either side used a Fire-type skill last turn, your carried Bug-type skills gain +100% power this turn.

entries.zh: 牧民说只要焰米龙飞过的地方草就长得快，露水干得早，播种能提前半个月，沿线的牧民从小就知道，踩温热地面走夜路不冻脚。焰米龙不知道这些，它们心里只有自己的球。
entries.en: The herdsmen say that as long as the fireworks fly through the local grass, the dew is dry early, the seeding can take half a month ahead, and the herders along the route know from their childhood that they will not freeze to the night by stepping on the warm ground. They are unaware of this, and they have only their own balls in mind.

entries.zh: 传说最早的村镇都挨着圣凯布米龙每天路过的路线建起来，洛克们沿着它留下的温热痕迹耕种、修路。地图上的路，最初就是这么画下来的。如今大部分洛克都不记得这些路是从哪来的，只知道这条路一直比别处暖和。
entries.en: Legend has it that the first towns and villages were built next to every day's routes of St. Cabemirón, where Locke cultivated and built roads along the warm signs they left behind. The road on the map was drawn from the beginning. Most of Locke today does not remember where these roads came from, but only knows that they have been warmer than anywhere else.

entries.zh: 章脑丸思考的时候，半透明的身体里会有一小串光顺着神经一节一节亮过去，它们总是成群漂在近岸的浅水里，小脑袋一起明明灭灭，那是它们在聊天。
entries.en: When cerebral pills are thought, there will be a small stream of light in the semi-transparent body that will follow a section on nerves. They will always drift into shallow waters near shore and their little heads will disappear together. That's what they talk about.

entries.zh: 章脑丸的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Octobrain Orb fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己携带技能的基础能耗，变为上回合双方使用的技能能耗之和。
entries.en: The base energy cost of your carried skills becomes the sum of the energy costs of the skills both sides used last turn.

entries.zh: 极聪明的精灵，无数光点从四周向智辉章脑汇聚，又从它这里散回四周，族群里所有的所见所感，最终都汇入它的脑中。它们偏爱有洛克生活的水域，能理解洛克说话的语气。
entries.en: The brilliant elves, who gather countless light points from all around and spread them back to all around, end up in their minds with everything they see. They prefer the waters where Locke lives and understand Locke's tone of speech.

entries.zh: 皇家研究院的旧标本室里，有一只已经风干很久的虫。某天夜里，值班研究员听见木架上传来一声轻轻的"嗒"，回头看时，标本针孔里空空如也。从那以后，未完虫学会了绕开所有尖锐的东西走路，遇到危险就地一躺，装作标本。
entries.en: In the old collection room of the Royal Institute, there was a long-dry bug. On one night, the fellows heard a light "tuck" coming from the wooden rack and looked back and the needle hole was empty. Since then, the worms have learned to walk around all sharp things, lying on the ground in danger and pretending to be specimens.

entries.zh: 未完虫的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Unfinished Bug fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 自己队伍中的其他精灵，在力竭1回合后会变为未完虫。
entries.en: Other creatures on your team become Unfinished Bug 1 turn after becoming exhausted.

entries.zh: 玳龟自己也搞不懂头骨里的球体是什么，魔法学院图书馆里有本旧书写过一句话：这世界被一只很大的龟驮着，那只龟又被更大的龟驮着，一路往下，数不到头。玳龟不识字，它只是每天慢慢地驮着自己的小球晃悠。
entries.en: The turtle itself does not know what the sphere is in its skull, and there's an old book in the library of the Academy of Magic that says: "The world is covered by a giant turtle, and it's surrounded by a bigger turtle, down all the way, with no head to count. The turtle is illiterate, and it just slowly hangs around its own little ball every day."

entries.zh: 玳龟的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Hawksbill Turtle fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 每受到1次攻击伤害，敌方获得3层 星陨印记 。
entries.en: For every 1 damaging attack you take, inflict 3 Meteor Marks on the opponent.

entries.zh: 研究员检测玳塔胸腔中层层嵌套的幻系能量时，往内每深入一层，能量结构就更复杂，直到探测器承受不住而中断记录。而那本书记载乌龟塔理论的书从此被移出寓言分类，重新归档为待验证的世界模型。
entries.en: When researchers detect the illusional energy that is embedded in the inner layer of the chest cavity, the energy structure becomes more complex every layer deep inside until the probe is unable to withstand and interrupt its records. The book documenting the turtle tower theory has since been moved out of the pseudo-classification and re-archived as a world model to be validated.

entries.zh: 据说它们最早是地系研究院造出来测风用的，如今已经形成了自己的族群。它们的身体极轻，风一起头顶的杯子便"咔哒咔哒"地转起来，风一停又落回地面。
entries.en: They are said to have formed their own communities, which were first created by the Institute of Earth Studies. Their bodies are so light that the cups above their heads turn up and the wind stops and falls back on the ground.

entries.zh: 量风碗的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Wind-Measuring Bowl fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 携带的技能每累计 传动 8，自己获得1层 风起印记 。
entries.en: For every cumulative 8 Transmission across your carried skills, gain 1 Rising Wind Mark.

entries.zh: 测风蝉知道风要从哪边来，也知道风要停多久。研究院早就换上了新一代的电子测风仪，那些造它们的老工程师大多也已经退休了。它们每天照旧停在山口和楼顶，等待着风来，像是在等一个再也不会来的洛克下班。
entries.en: Wind gauges know where the wind is coming from, and how long it's going to last. The Institute has already changed to a new generation of electronic wind gauges, and most of the old engineers who built them have retired. They stop at the mountain entrance and on the roof every day, waiting for the wind, like a Locke who never comes back.

entries.zh: 洛克大道上打翻的垃圾桶、面包店里少了一半的糕点、驻地里凭空消失的徽章，十有八九是这些小家伙干的。它们从不单独行动，三两成群蹲在街角盯梢，看见落单的精灵和洛克便一拥而上。
entries.en: Half the trash cans on Locke Avenue, half of the pastries in the bakery, and eight-hundred-and-a-half of the badges disappeared from the premises. They never acted alone. Thirty or two groups of them sit around the corner and see single elves and Locke.

entries.zh: 小浣蛋的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Little Raccoon Rascal fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 入场时自己未携带的技能位置会变为敌方最近使用过的技能，且能耗-2。
entries.en: On entry, empty skill slots become the opponent's most recently used skill, with energy cost reduced by 2.

entries.zh: 每一群小浣蛋背后都跟着一只黑手浣熊，翻垃圾桶它先翻，新鲜的垃圾它先吃。黑手浣熊对体型更大的精灵大哥很有礼貌低头哈腰，尾巴摇得飞起，转头就打个手势让小浣蛋们偷偷去掏大哥的家底。
entries.en: Each group of raccoons follows a black-handed raccoon behind their backs, flips it through the trash can, and eats it freshly. The raccoons are polite to larger elf brothers, bows their heads down, shakes their tails up, turns them around with a hand gesture that allows the raccoons to steal from their brother's house.

entries.zh: 洛克走过废弃的旧宅，忽然听到铃声在耳边响起，回头却什么也看不见，大多是幽铃藏在墙角恶作剧。它们并不真的想吓着谁，只是喜欢看洛克东张西望找不着的样子。
entries.en: Locke walked past the old house, and suddenly heard bells ringing in his ears, but looked back and couldn't see anything. Most of them were pranks hidden in the corner. They didn't really want to scare anybody, they just liked to see Lockerton looking out.

entries.zh: 幽铃的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Ghost Bell fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 初始能量为0，首次入场前敌方每聚能1次，回复5能量（可突破上限），在场时自己回复的能量-4。
entries.en: Start with 0 energy. Before your first entry, restore 5 energy for every 1 opposing use of Gather Energy; this can exceed the cap. While on the field, your energy restoration is reduced by 4.

entries.zh: 成长后恶作剧也升了级，它会招呼一群幽铃埋伏在旧宅子的各个角落，等洛克推门进来，就四处发出声音，把洛克吵得团团转，自己却都不露面。被吓的洛克若是不生气，它们便会觉得有点没意思，悻悻地散去。
entries.en: Grown-up pranks rise up, and they'll greet a bunch of phantom bells in every corner of the old mansion, and when Locke comes in, he makes noises, squeals around Locke, and he doesn't show himself. If Locke is not angry, they'll find it a little boring and dissipating.

entries.zh: 传说它是远古时期坠入卡洛西亚大陆的陨石，被充满魔力的土地赋予了生命。在它身边能测到一片明显异常的引力场，随手扔出的石子也会不由自主地朝它靠拢，所幸大多个体性格温和，是学者们研究地外星体的重要来源。
entries.en: The legend is that it was a meteorite that fell into the land of Karosia in ancient times, and was given life by magic-filled land. It had been able to detect an apparently abnormal gravitational field around it, and the stones thrown with its hands were bound to it uncontrollably, fortunately most of them being of a moderate individual character, which was an important source for scholars to study extraterrestrials.

entries.en: Starry Eyes fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.en: For every 1 Meteor Mark on the opponent, gain +10% physical defence.

entries.zh: 布灵的样子是一只手工缝的小熊，真正的它其实是从熊头顶露出来的那一小团黄色能量，布偶只是它给自己找的一个不那么显眼的壳。据说它的家乡是一片被黑暗吃掉过的星空，所以它到现在都怕黑。
entries.en: Bring looks like a hand-sewn bear, and the real thing is that little yellow energy comes out of its head, and the puppet is just a less visible shell that it finds itself. It is said to be home to a star sky eaten by darkness, so it's still afraid of dark.

entries.zh: 布灵的果实 来源：完成赛季作业挑战课题
entries.en: Buling fruit. Source: Complete a seasonal assignment challenge task.

entries.zh: 己方精灵每使用过1个不同系别的技能，自己入场时获得双攻+10%。
entries.en: On entry, gain +10% to both attack stats for every 1 different skill type previously used by an allied creature.

entries.zh: 布灵布灵对太阳和月亮没什么感觉，它们家乡的星空曾经比这里的更亮更大，可惜后来都熄灭了。它们真正着迷的是洛造光源，天一黑，它们会从街角、屋檐下、井盖缝里一个个悄悄冒出来，围着灯柱看很久很久。
entries.en: Brimbrin has little sense of the sun and the moon, and the stars in their homes used to be brighter than here, but unfortunately they have all gone out. They're really fascinated by the L.A. Light source, and it's dark, and they come out of the corner of the street, under the roof, in the hole of the well for a long time, around the lamppost.

entries.zh: 身上带着淡淡的果实香气，做事依然一板一眼。秋收的时节，它会帮着把作物一筐筐搬进粮仓，清点码齐，摘果实的时候会把歪斜的树枝一根根修剪整齐，如果小洛克在秋天里看到方方的的树冠，那大多出自果实立方人之手。
entries.en: It's still a piece of fruit. During the autumn harvest, it helps to move a crop into the grain barn, counting and picking the fruits, cutting the slanting branches together, and if little Locke sees the crown on the side in the fall, most of it comes from the hands of a fruit-cube man.

entries.zh: 造成物伤，若上回合双方有精灵使用火系技能，偷取敌方3能量。

entries.zh: 造成物伤， 应对状态 ：自己获得物攻+100%。

entries.zh: 造成魔伤， 应对状态 ：下次技能无需 蓄力 。

entries.en: Your next skill requires no Charging. This skill can be used while Charging. Choice: reduce this use's energy cost by 1, or interrupt when responding to Defence and stun the opponent next turn.

entries.zh: 自己获得随机16层 属性增益 ， 巧变 ：幻系攻击技能。

entries.en: Change the weather to Thunder for 8 turns.

entries.en: Deal physical damage. While this skill is in slot 1 or 3, it costs 2 less energy. Transmission 1.

entries.zh: 造成高额物理伤害，自己下回合获得眩晕。

Exchange HP percentages with the opponent.

entries.zh: 造成魔伤，此技能位置不会改变。
entries.en: Deal magical damage. This skill's position cannot change.
